# UurtjeFactuurtje Fuller Application Implementation Plan

## Overview

Build a sandboxed native macOS time-tracking application with a SwiftPM domain/storage library and an Xcode SwiftUI host. Typed library operations own all SQLite access; the window, menu bar and lifecycle callbacks share one observable workspace and ordered intent queue. Preserve durable data through validated transactions, private-copy journal recovery and explicit review of uncertain time rather than inventing billable intervals.

This is a code-bearing design, not an implementation. All twelve staged slices are approved; the earlier prose-only slice designs are research inputs, not locked code. The final manifest-selected tree byte-matches the canonical FINAL STATE fences. Planning preserves slice boundaries and uses the explicit stage manifests.

Source design: `.rpiv/artifacts/designs/2026-11-06_16-48-30_uurtjefactuurtje-fuller-application.md`. Inherit all twelve approved slices 1:1; use only each phase's manifest-selected payloads. Code fences below are complete file contents: create or replace, never concatenate. References to “Slice N” in inherited criteria mean Phase N.

## Desired End State

The public domain foundation supports concrete value use immediately after Slice 1:

```swift
import Foundation
import LibraryStore

let project = Project(id: UUID(), name: "Client", hourlyRate: Decimal(100), currencyCode: "EUR")
let task = TaskRecord(id: UUID(), projectID: project.id, name: "Implementation")
let morning = try EntryInterval(startAt: 1_700_000_000, endAt: 1_700_003_600)
let afternoon = try EntryInterval(startAt: morning.endAt, endAt: morning.endAt + 3_600)
assert(!morning.overlaps(afternoon))
assert(NameKey.make("  CAFÉ  ") == NameKey.make("cafe\u{301}"))
```

Slice 5 adds typed editing through the owned library:

```swift
let library = try Library.open(at: libraryDirectory)
let id = UUID()
let committed = try await library.perform(.saveProject(
    id: id, name: "Client", rate: Decimal(100), currency: "EUR",
    confirmedPreviousCurrency: nil))
assert(committed.projects.contains { $0.id == id })
let withTask = try await library.perform(.createTask(
    id: UUID(), projectID: id, parentID: nil, name: "Implementation"))
assert(withTask.tasks.count == committed.tasks.count + 1)
```

`libraryDirectory` is the caller's Foundation-resolved sandbox application-support directory plus `UurtjeFactuurtje`; the host supplies it. Later slices extend these actual approved call sites, without inventing signatures ahead of their checkpoints. From the user perspective, one app window and menu bar observe the same committed state; editing a current rate immediately updates reports, and uncertain time always enters review rather than confirmed totals.

## What We're NOT Doing

- Benchmarks or latency targets; backup UI, backup scheduling, synchronization, export or invoices.
- Persistent undo logs, historical rates, automatic currency conversion, multiple timers, plugins or multiple writer processes.
- App Store submission, notarization automation, launch-at-login, older-OS compatibility or external dependencies.
- Automatic migration of a hypothetical existing unsandboxed install: no app/data has yet been shipped. Changing the chosen bundle ID later requires explicit container migration.
- Unspecified future schema migrations. Schema 1 initializes only genuinely absent libraries; newer versions fail closed. Future migration code must retain a consistent SQLite-backup copy first.

## Execution Contract

All twelve phases execute sequentially, on committed predecessor trees. No code phases run in parallel. `depends_on` records the predecessor chain, including semantic dependencies without shared files. Do not select terminal source early. Phase-local verification uses the current stage; final whole-plan baseline and signed/hardware release checks belong to Phase 12. Historical design test results are not results for this plan.

```swift
import Foundation

public enum WarningThreshold: Int64, Sendable, CaseIterable {
    case none = 0, eighty = 80, hundred = 100
}

public struct Project: Identifiable, Equatable, Sendable {
    public let id: UUID
    public let name: String
    public let hourlyRate: Decimal
    public let currencyCode: String
    public let isArchived: Bool

    public init(id: UUID, name: String, hourlyRate: Decimal, currencyCode: String,
                isArchived: Bool = false) {
        self.id = id
        self.name = name
        self.hourlyRate = hourlyRate
        self.currencyCode = currencyCode
        self.isArchived = isArchived
    }
}

public struct TaskRecord: Identifiable, Equatable, Sendable {
    public let id: UUID
    public let projectID: UUID
    public let parentTaskID: UUID?
    public let name: String
    public let budgetSeconds: Int64?
    public let lastWarnedThreshold: WarningThreshold

    public init(id: UUID, projectID: UUID, parentTaskID: UUID? = nil, name: String,
                budgetSeconds: Int64? = nil, lastWarnedThreshold: WarningThreshold = .none) {
        self.id = id
        self.projectID = projectID
        self.parentTaskID = parentTaskID
        self.name = name
        self.budgetSeconds = budgetSeconds
        self.lastWarnedThreshold = lastWarnedThreshold
    }
}

public struct TimeEntry: Identifiable, Equatable, Sendable {
    public let id: UUID
    public let taskID: UUID
    public let startAt: Int64
    public let endAt: Int64?

    public init(id: UUID, taskID: UUID, startAt: Int64, endAt: Int64?) {
        self.id = id
        self.taskID = taskID
        self.startAt = startAt
        self.endAt = endAt
    }
}

public struct ActiveTimer: Equatable, Sendable {
    public let entryID: UUID
    public let checkpointAt: Int64

    public init(entryID: UUID, checkpointAt: Int64) {
        self.entryID = entryID
        self.checkpointAt = checkpointAt
    }
}

public struct PendingSleepInterval: Identifiable, Equatable, Sendable {
    public let id: UUID
    public let taskID: UUID
    public let sleepAt: Int64
    public let wakeAt: Int64?

    public init(id: UUID, taskID: UUID, sleepAt: Int64, wakeAt: Int64?) {
        self.id = id
        self.taskID = taskID
        self.sleepAt = sleepAt
        self.wakeAt = wakeAt
    }
}

// Values can represent untrusted input; persistence validates the complete snapshot.
public struct LibrarySnapshot: Equatable, Sendable {
    public let schemaVersion: Int64
    public let revision: Int64
    public let projects: [Project]
    public let tasks: [TaskRecord]
    public let entries: [TimeEntry]
    public let activeTimer: ActiveTimer?
    public let pendingSleepIntervals: [PendingSleepInterval]

    public init(schemaVersion: Int64, revision: Int64, projects: [Project], tasks: [TaskRecord],
                entries: [TimeEntry], activeTimer: ActiveTimer?,
                pendingSleepIntervals: [PendingSleepInterval]) {
        self.schemaVersion = schemaVersion
        self.revision = revision
        self.projects = projects
        self.tasks = tasks
        self.entries = entries
        self.activeTimer = activeTimer
        self.pendingSleepIntervals = pendingSleepIntervals
    }
}

public enum IntervalError: Error, Equatable, Sendable {
    case nonPositiveDuration
    case durationOverflow
}

public struct EntryInterval: Equatable, Sendable {
    public let startAt: Int64
    public let endAt: Int64
    public var durationSeconds: Int64 { endAt - startAt }

    public init(startAt: Int64, endAt: Int64) throws {
        guard endAt > startAt else { throw IntervalError.nonPositiveDuration }
        guard !endAt.subtractingReportingOverflow(startAt).overflow else {
            throw IntervalError.durationOverflow
        }
        self.startAt = startAt
        self.endAt = endAt
    }

    public func overlaps(_ other: EntryInterval) -> Bool {
        startAt < other.endAt && other.startAt < endAt
    }

    public func intersection(_ other: EntryInterval) -> EntryInterval? {
        guard overlaps(other) else { return nil }
        return try? EntryInterval(startAt: max(startAt, other.startAt), endAt: min(endAt, other.endAt))
    }
}

public enum NameKey {
    public static func make(_ name: String) -> String {
        name.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
            .precomposedStringWithCanonicalMapping
            .folding(options: [.caseInsensitive], locale: Locale(identifier: "en_US_POSIX"))
            .precomposedStringWithCanonicalMapping
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import Testing
@testable import LibraryStore

@Test func recordValuesPreserveFieldsAndDefaults() async {
    let project = Project(id: UUID(), name: "Client", hourlyRate: Decimal(string: "123.456789")!, currencyCode: "EUR")
    let task = TaskRecord(id: UUID(), projectID: project.id, name: "Work")
    let entry = TimeEntry(id: UUID(), taskID: task.id, startAt: 10, endAt: nil)
    let active = ActiveTimer(entryID: entry.id, checkpointAt: 20)
    let pending = PendingSleepInterval(id: UUID(), taskID: task.id, sleepAt: 1, wakeAt: nil)
    let snapshot = LibrarySnapshot(schemaVersion: 1, revision: 4, projects: [project], tasks: [task],
                                   entries: [entry], activeTimer: active, pendingSleepIntervals: [pending])
    let copy = await Task.detached { snapshot }.value
    #expect(copy == snapshot)
    #expect(copy.projects[0].hourlyRate == Decimal(string: "123.456789")!)
    #expect(!project.isArchived)
    #expect(task.parentTaskID == nil && task.budgetSeconds == nil)
    #expect(task.lastWarnedThreshold == .none)
    #expect(WarningThreshold.allCases.map(\.rawValue) == [0, 80, 100])
    #expect(snapshot.entries[0].endAt == nil)
    #expect(snapshot.pendingSleepIntervals[0].wakeAt == nil)
}

@Test func nameKeysFoldCaseAndCanonicalUnicodeWithoutRemovingAccents() {
    #expect(NameKey.make("  CAFÉ\n") == NameKey.make("cafe\u{301}"))
    #expect(NameKey.make("Straße") == NameKey.make("STRASSE"))
    #expect(NameKey.make("café") != NameKey.make("cafe"))
    #expect(NameKey.make("A B") != NameKey.make("AB"))
    #expect(NameKey.make(" \n\t") == "")
}

@Test func intervalsAreHalfOpenAndIntersectSymmetrically() throws {
    let first = try EntryInterval(startAt: 10, endAt: 20)
    let adjacent = try EntryInterval(startAt: 20, endAt: 30)
    let crossing = try EntryInterval(startAt: 15, endAt: 25)
    #expect(first.durationSeconds == 10)
    #expect(!first.overlaps(adjacent))
    #expect(!adjacent.overlaps(first))
    #expect(first.intersection(adjacent) == nil)
    #expect(first.overlaps(first))
    #expect(first.intersection(first) == first)
    #expect(first.intersection(crossing) == (try EntryInterval(startAt: 15, endAt: 20)))
    #expect(first.intersection(crossing) == crossing.intersection(first))
}

@Test func intervalsRejectInvalidDurationWithoutOverflow() throws {
    #expect(throws: IntervalError.nonPositiveDuration) { try EntryInterval(startAt: 1, endAt: 1) }
    #expect(throws: IntervalError.nonPositiveDuration) { try EntryInterval(startAt: 2, endAt: 1) }
    #expect(throws: IntervalError.durationOverflow) { try EntryInterval(startAt: .min, endAt: .max) }
    let negativeEpoch = try EntryInterval(startAt: -10, endAt: 0)
    #expect(negativeEpoch.durationSeconds == 10)
    let largest = try EntryInterval(startAt: 0, endAt: .max)
    #expect(largest.durationSeconds == .max)
}
```

## Phase 2: Snapshot validation

### Overview

Complete pure validation, inline budget invariants; no BudgetRules or SQLite. Requires Phase 1 committed.

### Changes Required:

#### 1. Sources/LibraryStore/Validation.swift

**File**: `Sources/LibraryStore/Validation.swift`
**Changes**: Create with the complete approved Phase 2 payload.
**Payload source**: Architecture → Staged replacements → Slice 2; CREATE.

```swift
import Foundation

public struct Violation: Equatable, Sendable {
    public enum Code: String, Sendable {
        case metadata, duplicateID, project, task, hierarchy, siblingName
        case ownership, interval, overlap, timer, pending, allocation, warning
    }
    public let code: Code
    public let recordID: UUID?
    public init(_ code: Code, _ recordID: UUID? = nil) {
        self.code = code
        self.recordID = recordID
    }
}

public enum LibraryError: Error, Equatable, Sendable {
    case invalid([Violation])
}

public enum SnapshotValidator {
    public static func validate(_ snapshot: LibrarySnapshot, now: Int64? = nil) throws {
        let problems = violations(in: snapshot, now: now)
        if !problems.isEmpty { throw LibraryError.invalid(problems) }
    }

    public static func violations(in s: LibrarySnapshot, now: Int64? = nil) -> [Violation] {
        var errors: [Violation] = []
        func add(_ code: Violation.Code, _ id: UUID? = nil) { errors.append(Violation(code, id)) }
        func unique(_ ids: [UUID]) -> Bool { Set(ids).count == ids.count }
        guard unique(s.projects.map(\.id)), unique(s.tasks.map(\.id)),
              unique(s.entries.map(\.id)), unique(s.pendingSleepIntervals.map(\.id)) else {
            return [Violation(.duplicateID)]
        }
        if s.schemaVersion != 1 || s.revision < 0 { add(.metadata) }
        let projects = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: s.projects.map { ($0.id, $0) })
        let tasks = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: s.tasks.map { ($0.id, $0) })
        let currencies = Set(Locale.commonISOCurrencyCodes)
        func validName(_ name: String) -> Bool {
            !NameKey.make(name).isEmpty && name == name.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
                && !name.contains("\0")
        }
        for p in s.projects {
            if !validName(p.name) || p.hourlyRate.isNaN || p.hourlyRate < 0
                || !currencies.contains(p.currencyCode) { add(.project, p.id) }
        }
        struct Sibling: Hashable { let project: UUID; let parent: UUID?; let name: String }
        var siblings = Set<Sibling>()
        var children: [UUID: [UUID]] = [:]
        for t in s.tasks {
            if projects[t.projectID] == nil || !validName(t.name)
                || t.budgetSeconds.map({ $0 <= 0 }) == true { add(.task, t.id) }
            if !siblings.insert(Sibling(project: t.projectID, parent: t.parentTaskID,
                                        name: NameKey.make(t.name))).inserted { add(.siblingName, t.id) }
            if let parent = t.parentTaskID {
                if parent == t.id || tasks[parent]?.projectID != t.projectID { add(.hierarchy, t.id) }
                children[parent, default: []].append(t.id)
            }
        }
        // Iterative walks accept arbitrary depth without recursive stack growth.
        for t in s.tasks {
            var seen = Set<UUID>()
            var cursor: UUID? = t.id
            while let id = cursor {
                if !seen.insert(id).inserted { add(.hierarchy, t.id); break }
                cursor = tasks[id]?.parentTaskID
            }
        }
        if errors.contains(where: { $0.code == .hierarchy || $0.code == .task }) { return errors }
        func isLeaf(_ id: UUID) -> Bool { tasks[id] != nil && children[id, default: []].isEmpty }
        var intervals: [(UUID, EntryInterval)] = []
        var usage: [UUID: Decimal] = [:]
        for e in s.entries {
            if !isLeaf(e.taskID) { add(.ownership, e.id) }
            let end = e.endAt ?? s.activeTimer?.checkpointAt
            if let end {
                if e.endAt != nil, let now, end > now { add(.interval, e.id) }
                if end == e.startAt && e.endAt == nil { continue }
                if let interval = try? EntryInterval(startAt: e.startAt, endAt: end) {
                    intervals.append((e.id, interval))
                    var cursor: UUID? = e.taskID
                    while let id = cursor {
                        usage[id, default: 0] += Decimal(interval.durationSeconds)
                        cursor = tasks[id]?.parentTaskID
                    }
                } else { add(.interval, e.id) }
            } else { add(.timer, e.id) }
        }
        intervals.sort { $0.1.startAt < $1.1.startAt }
        var furthest: Int64?
        for (id, interval) in intervals {
            if let end = furthest, interval.startAt < end { add(.overlap, id) }
            furthest = max(furthest ?? interval.endAt, interval.endAt)
        }
        let open = s.entries.filter { $0.endAt == nil }
        if let timer = s.activeTimer {
            if open.count != 1 || open.first?.id != timer.entryID
                || open.first.map({ timer.checkpointAt < $0.startAt }) == true { add(.timer) }
            if let entry = open.first, let task = tasks[entry.taskID], projects[task.projectID]?.isArchived == true {
                add(.timer, entry.id)
            }
            // Reserve the entire open interval, not only its confirmed checkpoint prefix.
            if let entry = open.first,
               s.entries.contains(where: { $0.endAt != nil && $0.id != entry.id && $0.endAt! > entry.startAt }) {
                add(.overlap, entry.id)
            }
        } else if !open.isEmpty { add(.timer) }
        let unknown = s.pendingSleepIntervals.filter { $0.wakeAt == nil }
        if unknown.count > 1 || (!unknown.isEmpty && s.activeTimer != nil) { add(.pending) }
        for p in s.pendingSleepIntervals {
            if !isLeaf(p.taskID) { add(.ownership, p.id) }
            if let end = p.wakeAt, (try? EntryInterval(startAt: p.sleepAt, endAt: end)) == nil {
                add(.pending, p.id)
            }
        }
        for t in s.tasks {
            var expected = WarningThreshold.none
            if let budget = t.budgetSeconds {
                var allocated: Decimal = 0
                var frontier = children[t.id, default: []]
                while let id = frontier.popLast(), let descendant = tasks[id] {
                    if let amount = descendant.budgetSeconds { allocated += Decimal(amount) }
                    else { frontier.append(contentsOf: children[id, default: []]) }
                }
                if allocated > Decimal(budget) { add(.allocation, t.id) }
                let used = usage[t.id, default: 0]
                if used >= Decimal(budget) { expected = .hundred }
                else if used * 100 >= Decimal(budget) * 80 { expected = .eighty }
            }
            if t.lastWarnedThreshold != expected { add(.warning, t.id) }
        }
        return errors
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import Testing
@testable import LibraryStore

private let projectID = UUID()
private let leafID = UUID()
private func project(rate: Decimal = 100, currency: String = "EUR", name: String = "Client") -> Project {
    Project(id: projectID, name: name, hourlyRate: rate, currencyCode: currency)
}
private func task(_ id: UUID = leafID, parent: UUID? = nil, name: String = "Work",
                  budget: Int64? = nil, warning: WarningThreshold = .none) -> TaskRecord {
    TaskRecord(id: id, projectID: projectID, parentTaskID: parent, name: name,
               budgetSeconds: budget, lastWarnedThreshold: warning)
}
private func snapshot(projects: [Project] = [project()], tasks: [TaskRecord] = [task()],
                      entries: [TimeEntry] = [], active: ActiveTimer? = nil,
                      pending: [PendingSleepInterval] = [], version: Int64 = 1,
                      revision: Int64 = 0) -> LibrarySnapshot {
    LibrarySnapshot(schemaVersion: version, revision: revision, projects: projects,
                    tasks: tasks, entries: entries, activeTimer: active, pendingSleepIntervals: pending)
}
private func codes(_ s: LibrarySnapshot, now: Int64 = 1000) -> Set<Violation.Code> {
    Set(SnapshotValidator.violations(in: s, now: now).map(\.code))
}
private func entry(_ start: Int64, _ end: Int64?, owner: UUID = leafID) -> TimeEntry {
    TimeEntry(id: UUID(), taskID: owner, startAt: start, endAt: end)
}
```

### Success Criteria:

#### Automated Verification:
- [ ] `swift test --filter 'LibraryStoreTests'` compiles validation with the locked foundation; all eight validation tests pass without SQLite or app files.
- [ ] Tests cover schema/revision rejection, duplicate IDs before dictionary creation, invalid Decimal/currency/names, missing and cross-project references, cycles and canonical Unicode sibling collisions.
- [ ] Tests cover leaf-only ownership, signed/overflowing/zero durations, adjacency, global overlap, exact active/open correspondence, zero-prefix active entries, open-tail reservation and durable horizons after clock rollback.
- [ ] Tests cover pending sleep leaf references, positive known duration, one unknown wake, unknown/active exclusion, nearest-budget frontier equality/excess, warning bands at 80/100 and downward rearming.
#### Manual Verification:
- [ ] Inspect validation: no mutation, I/O, SQL or implicit clock reads; warning usage excludes pending sleep and uses only the durable checkpoint for open entries. Structural load validation omits the optional wall-clock bound so valid stopped history remains readable after clock rollback. Inspect the documented caller contract (not later command implementations): new input requires a sampled-time bound, whereas rollback review may use the prior durable checkpoint. This is an intentional refinement of DESIGN.md:461's future-entry check: that check belongs at the input boundary, not unconditional load validation, because stored history cannot become corrupt when the clock moves.
- [ ] Inspect boundaries: storage-class and canonical TEXT/UUID decoding, SQLite schema/integrity checks and filesystem recovery belong to Slices 3–4, not this value validator. Later commands reconcile warning bands before calling this validator.
- [ ] Confirm iterative hierarchy/frontier traversal has no arbitrary depth cap; complete validation is intentionally unoptimized, with no benchmark or latency claim.

## Phase 3: SQLite transactions

### Overview

Internal SQLite storage and receipts; no lease, timer gate, migration/correction receipts or reconciliation. Requires Phase 2 committed.

### Changes Required:

#### 1. Sources/LibraryStore/Storage.swift

**Changes**: Create with the complete approved Phase 3 payload.

```swift
import Foundation
import SQLite3
import Darwin

// Internal until Slice 4 has supplied the process lock and private-copy installation.
enum StorageError: Error, Equatable {
    case sqlite(Int32, String)
    case invalidStorage(String)
    case unsupportedSchema(Int64)
    case revisionOverflow
    case commitIndeterminate
    case unavailable
    case injectedFailure
}

struct Committed<Value: Sendable>: Sendable {
    let value: Value
    let snapshot: LibrarySnapshot
}

enum CommitFault: Sendable { case none, beforeCommit, commitRejected, acknowledgementLost }

private let transient = unsafeBitCast(-1, to: sqlite3_destructor_type.self)

final class SQLConnection {
    private var db: OpaquePointer?

    init(privatePath: String) throws {
        var opened: OpaquePointer?
        let rc = sqlite3_open_v2(privatePath, &opened, SQLITE_OPEN_READWRITE | SQLITE_OPEN_NOMUTEX, nil)
        guard rc == SQLITE_OK, let opened else {
            let message = opened.map { String(cString: sqlite3_errmsg($0)) } ?? "cannot open database"
            if let opened { sqlite3_close_v2(opened) }
            throw StorageError.sqlite(rc, message)
        }
        db = opened
        sqlite3_extended_result_codes(opened, 1)
    }

    deinit { close() }
    func close() { if let db { sqlite3_close_v2(db); self.db = nil } }
    var autocommit: Bool { db.map { sqlite3_get_autocommit($0) != 0 } ?? true }
    fileprivate func allowOnlyCommandDML(_ enabled: Bool) throws {
        let db = try handle()
        let rc: Int32
        if !enabled {
            rc = sqlite3_set_authorizer(db, nil, nil)
        } else {
            rc = sqlite3_set_authorizer(db, { _, action, _, _, _, _ in
                switch action {
                case SQLITE_SELECT, SQLITE_READ, SQLITE_INSERT, SQLITE_UPDATE, SQLITE_DELETE,
                     SQLITE_FUNCTION, SQLITE_RECURSIVE: return SQLITE_OK
                default: return SQLITE_DENY
                }
            }, nil)
        }
        guard rc == SQLITE_OK else { throw failure(rc) }
    }
    private func handle() throws -> OpaquePointer { guard let db else { throw StorageError.unavailable }; return db }
    private func failure(_ rc: Int32) -> StorageError {
        .sqlite(rc, db.map { String(cString: sqlite3_errmsg($0)) } ?? "closed")
    }
    func exec(_ sql: String) throws {
        let db = try handle()
        let rc = sqlite3_exec(db, sql, nil, nil, nil)
        guard rc == SQLITE_OK else { throw failure(rc) }
    }
    func rows<T>(_ sql: String, _ body: (OpaquePointer) throws -> T) throws -> [T] {
        let db = try handle()
        var statement: OpaquePointer?
        let rc = sqlite3_prepare_v2(db, sql, -1, &statement, nil)
        guard rc == SQLITE_OK, let statement else { throw failure(rc) }
        defer { sqlite3_finalize(statement) }
        var values: [T] = []
        while true {
            let step = sqlite3_step(statement)
            if step == SQLITE_DONE { return values }
            guard step == SQLITE_ROW else { throw failure(step) }
            values.append(try body(statement))
        }
    }
    func run(_ sql: String, _ bindings: [SQLValue]) throws {
        let db = try handle()
        var statement: OpaquePointer?
        let rc = sqlite3_prepare_v2(db, sql, -1, &statement, nil)
        guard rc == SQLITE_OK, let statement else { throw failure(rc) }
        defer { sqlite3_finalize(statement) }
        guard sqlite3_bind_parameter_count(statement) == Int32(bindings.count) else {
            throw StorageError.invalidStorage("binding count")
        }
        for (offset, value) in bindings.enumerated() {
            let i = Int32(offset + 1)
            let result: Int32
            switch value {
            case .null: result = sqlite3_bind_null(statement, i)
            case .integer(let n): result = sqlite3_bind_int64(statement, i, n)
            case .text(let text):
                guard !text.contains("\0"), text.utf8.count <= Int(Int32.max) else {
                    throw StorageError.invalidStorage("invalid bound text")
                }
                result = text.withCString { sqlite3_bind_text(statement, i, $0, Int32(text.utf8.count), transient) }
            }
            guard result == SQLITE_OK else { throw failure(result) }
        }
        let step = sqlite3_step(statement)
        guard step == SQLITE_DONE else { throw failure(step) }
    }
}

enum SQLValue { case null, integer(Int64), text(String) }

private func integer(_ s: OpaquePointer, _ i: Int32) throws -> Int64 {
    guard sqlite3_column_type(s, i) == SQLITE_INTEGER else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("expected integer") }
    return sqlite3_column_int64(s, i)
}
private func text(_ s: OpaquePointer, _ i: Int32) throws -> String {
    guard sqlite3_column_type(s, i) == SQLITE_TEXT, let p = sqlite3_column_text(s, i) else {
        throw StorageError.invalidStorage("expected text")
    }
    let bytes = UnsafeBufferPointer(start: p, count: Int(sqlite3_column_bytes(s, i)))
    guard let value = String(bytes: bytes, encoding: .utf8), !value.contains("\0") else {
        throw StorageError.invalidStorage("invalid text")
    }
    return value
}
private func optionalInteger(_ s: OpaquePointer, _ i: Int32) throws -> Int64? {
    sqlite3_column_type(s, i) == SQLITE_NULL ? nil : try integer(s, i)
}
private func uuid(_ s: OpaquePointer, _ i: Int32) throws -> UUID {
    let raw = try text(s, i)
    guard let value = UUID(uuidString: raw), value.uuidString.lowercased() == raw else {
        throw StorageError.invalidStorage("noncanonical UUID")
    }
    return value
}
private func optionalUUID(_ s: OpaquePointer, _ i: Int32) throws -> UUID? {
    sqlite3_column_type(s, i) == SQLITE_NULL ? nil : try uuid(s, i)
}

// NSDecimalString produces a non-exponent, locale-independent, exact canonical form.
func canonicalRate(_ rate: Decimal) throws -> String {
    guard !rate.isNaN, rate >= 0 else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("invalid rate") }
    var value = rate
    return NSDecimalString(&value, Locale(identifier: "en_US_POSIX"))
}
private func rate(_ s: OpaquePointer, _ i: Int32) throws -> Decimal {
    let raw = try text(s, i)
    guard let parsed = Decimal(string: raw, locale: Locale(identifier: "en_US_POSIX")),
          try canonicalRate(parsed) == raw else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("noncanonical rate") }
    return parsed
}

// Exact CREATE statements make the greenfield schema an explicit allowlist, including
// constraints and indexes; unknown triggers, views, or schema variations fail closed.
private let schema: [(String, String, String)] = [
    ("table", "library_metadata", "CREATE TABLE library_metadata (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (schema_version >= 1), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision >= 0))"),
    ("table", "projects", "CREATE TABLE projects (id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), hourly_rate TEXT NOT NULL, currency_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(currency_code) = 3), is_archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_archived IN (0, 1)))"),
    ("table", "tasks", "CREATE TABLE tasks (id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, parent_task_id TEXT, name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), budget_seconds INTEGER CHECK (budget_seconds > 0), last_warned_threshold INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (last_warned_threshold IN (0, 80, 100)), UNIQUE (id, project_id), FOREIGN KEY (parent_task_id, project_id) REFERENCES tasks(id, project_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, CHECK (parent_task_id IS NULL OR parent_task_id <> id))"),
    ("table", "time_entries", "CREATE TABLE time_entries (id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, start_at INTEGER NOT NULL, end_at INTEGER, CHECK (end_at IS NULL OR end_at > start_at))"),
    ("table", "active_timer", "CREATE TABLE active_timer (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), entry_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES time_entries(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, checkpoint_at INTEGER NOT NULL)"),
    ("table", "pending_sleep_intervals", "CREATE TABLE pending_sleep_intervals (id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, sleep_at INTEGER NOT NULL, wake_at INTEGER, CHECK (wake_at IS NULL OR wake_at > sleep_at))"),
    ("index", "tasks_by_parent", "CREATE INDEX tasks_by_parent ON tasks(project_id, parent_task_id)"),
    ("index", "entries_by_task_start", "CREATE INDEX entries_by_task_start ON time_entries(task_id, start_at)"),
    ("index", "entries_by_start", "CREATE INDEX entries_by_start ON time_entries(start_at)"),
    ("index", "one_open_entry", "CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_open_entry ON time_entries((1)) WHERE end_at IS NULL"),
    ("index", "sleep_by_task", "CREATE INDEX sleep_by_task ON pending_sleep_intervals(task_id)"),
    ("index", "one_unknown_wake", "CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_unknown_wake ON pending_sleep_intervals((1)) WHERE wake_at IS NULL")
]

private func checkSchema(_ db: SQLConnection) throws {
    let actual = try db.rows("SELECT type, name, sql FROM sqlite_schema WHERE sql IS NOT NULL ORDER BY type, name") {
        try [text($0, 0), text($0, 1), text($0, 2)]
    }
    let expected = schema.map { [$0.0, $0.1, $0.2] }.sorted { ($0[0], $0[1]) < ($1[0], $1[1]) }
    guard actual == expected else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("schema shape") }
}
private func configure(_ db: SQLConnection) throws {
    guard sqlite3_libversion_number() >= 3_009_000 else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("SQLite runtime too old") }
    try db.exec("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
    let journal = try db.rows("PRAGMA journal_mode=DELETE") { try text($0, 0) }
    try db.exec("PRAGMA synchronous=FULL")
    try db.exec("PRAGMA fullfsync=ON")
    let foreign = try db.rows("PRAGMA foreign_keys") { try integer($0, 0) }
    let synchronous = try db.rows("PRAGMA synchronous") { try integer($0, 0) }
    let flush = try db.rows("PRAGMA fullfsync") { try integer($0, 0) }
    guard journal == ["delete"], foreign == [1], synchronous == [2], flush == [1] else {
        throw StorageError.invalidStorage("required SQLite settings unavailable")
    }
}
private func checkIntegrity(_ db: SQLConnection) throws {
    let integrity = try db.rows("PRAGMA integrity_check") { try text($0, 0) }
    guard integrity == ["ok"] else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("integrity_check") }
    let foreign = try db.rows("PRAGMA foreign_key_check") { _ in true }
    guard foreign.isEmpty else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("foreign_key_check") }
}
func decodeSnapshot(_ db: SQLConnection) throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
    let meta = try db.rows("SELECT id, schema_version, revision FROM library_metadata") {
        try (integer($0, 0), integer($0, 1), integer($0, 2))
    }
    guard meta.count == 1, meta[0].0 == 1 else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("metadata singleton") }
    guard meta[0].1 == 1 else { throw StorageError.unsupportedSchema(meta[0].1) }
    let projects = try db.rows("SELECT id, name, hourly_rate, currency_code, is_archived FROM projects ORDER BY id") { s in
        let flag = try integer(s, 4)
        guard flag == 0 || flag == 1 else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("boolean") }
        return try Project(id: uuid(s, 0), name: text(s, 1), hourlyRate: rate(s, 2), currencyCode: text(s, 3), isArchived: flag == 1)
    }
    let tasks = try db.rows("SELECT id, project_id, parent_task_id, name, budget_seconds, last_warned_threshold FROM tasks ORDER BY id") { s in
        guard let warning = WarningThreshold(rawValue: try integer(s, 5)) else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("warning") }
        return try TaskRecord(id: uuid(s, 0), projectID: uuid(s, 1), parentTaskID: optionalUUID(s, 2), name: text(s, 3), budgetSeconds: optionalInteger(s, 4), lastWarnedThreshold: warning)
    }
    let entries = try db.rows("SELECT id, task_id, start_at, end_at FROM time_entries ORDER BY id") { s in
        try TimeEntry(id: uuid(s, 0), taskID: uuid(s, 1), startAt: integer(s, 2), endAt: optionalInteger(s, 3))
    }
    let timers = try db.rows("SELECT id, entry_id, checkpoint_at FROM active_timer") { s in
        try (integer(s, 0), ActiveTimer(entryID: uuid(s, 1), checkpointAt: integer(s, 2)))
    }
    guard timers.count <= 1, timers.first.map({ $0.0 == 1 }) ?? true else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("timer singleton") }
    let pending = try db.rows("SELECT id, task_id, sleep_at, wake_at FROM pending_sleep_intervals ORDER BY id") { s in
        try PendingSleepInterval(id: uuid(s, 0), taskID: uuid(s, 1), sleepAt: integer(s, 2), wakeAt: optionalInteger(s, 3))
    }
    let snapshot = LibrarySnapshot(schemaVersion: meta[0].1, revision: meta[0].2, projects: projects, tasks: tasks, entries: entries, activeTimer: timers.first?.1, pendingSleepIntervals: pending)
    return snapshot
}

func load(_ db: SQLConnection) throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
    let snapshot = try decodeSnapshot(db)
    try SnapshotValidator.validate(snapshot)
    return snapshot
}

func checkPrivateDatabase(_ db: SQLConnection) throws {
    try checkSchema(db)
    try configure(db)
    try checkIntegrity(db)
    _ = try load(db)
}

// The caller must own a private, same-generation database/journal pair. Never
// call this initializer with an authoritative library; Slice 4 supplies that boundary.
actor Storage {
    private let connection: SQLConnection
    private let privateDatabasePath: String
    private var poisoned = false

    init(privateDatabaseAt url: URL) throws {
        let db = try SQLConnection(privatePath: url.path)
        try checkSchema(db)
        try configure(db)
        try checkIntegrity(db)
        _ = try load(db)
        connection = db
        privateDatabasePath = url.path
    }

    // Only isolated test/working paths: creation requires a genuinely absent file.
    static func createPrivateDatabase(at url: URL) throws {
        let fd = open(url.path, O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_WRONLY, S_IRUSR | S_IWUSR)
        guard fd >= 0 else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("cannot exclusively create private database") }
        Darwin.close(fd)
        let db = try SQLConnection(privatePath: url.path)
        try configure(db)
        try db.exec("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        do {
            for (_, _, statement) in schema { try db.exec(statement) }
            try db.exec("INSERT INTO library_metadata (id, schema_version, revision) VALUES (1, 1, 0)")
            try db.exec("COMMIT")
        } catch {
            try? db.exec("ROLLBACK")
            throw error
        }
    }

    func close() {
        poisoned = true
        connection.close()
    }

    func snapshot() throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
        guard !poisoned else { throw StorageError.unavailable }
        return try load(connection)
    }

    // Internal only; commands must leave the complete snapshot structurally valid.
    // No await occurs between BEGIN and COMMIT; no public raw-SQL surface is exported.
    func transact<Value: Sendable>(fault: CommitFault = .none,
        _ apply: @Sendable (SQLConnection, LibrarySnapshot) throws -> Value) throws -> Committed<Value> {
        guard !poisoned else { throw StorageError.unavailable }
        try connection.exec("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        var commitStarted = false
        do {
            let before = try load(connection)
            guard before.revision < .max else { throw StorageError.revisionOverflow }
            try connection.allowOnlyCommandDML(true)
            let value: Value
            do {
                value = try apply(connection, before)
            }
            catch {
                try connection.allowOnlyCommandDML(false)
                throw error
            }
            try connection.allowOnlyCommandDML(false)
            guard !connection.autocommit else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("command ended transaction") }
            // Commands cannot alter metadata; the store alone owns revision changes.
            let interim = try load(connection)
            guard interim.schemaVersion == before.schemaVersion, interim.revision == before.revision else {
                throw StorageError.invalidStorage("command changed metadata")
            }
            try connection.run("UPDATE library_metadata SET revision = ? WHERE id = 1 AND revision = ?", [.integer(before.revision + 1), .integer(before.revision)])
            let after = try load(connection)
            guard after.revision == before.revision + 1 else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("revision update") }
            if fault == .beforeCommit { throw StorageError.injectedFailure }
            // A separate reader produces a real SQLITE_BUSY from COMMIT in tests.
            let blocker: SQLConnection?
            if fault == .commitRejected {
                let reader = try SQLConnection(privatePath: privateDatabasePath)
                try reader.exec("BEGIN")
                _ = try reader.rows("SELECT revision FROM library_metadata") { _ in true }
                blocker = reader
            } else { blocker = nil }
            defer { blocker?.close() }
            commitStarted = true
            try connection.exec("COMMIT")
            if fault == .acknowledgementLost { throw StorageError.injectedFailure }
            return Committed(value: value, snapshot: after)
        } catch {
            if !connection.autocommit {
                do { try connection.exec("ROLLBACK") }
                catch { poisoned = true; connection.close(); throw StorageError.commitIndeterminate }
                throw error
            }
            if commitStarted {
                poisoned = true
                connection.close()
                throw StorageError.commitIndeterminate
            }
            throw error
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import SQLite3
import Testing
@testable import LibraryStore

private func privateURL() throws -> URL {
    let dir = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString, isDirectory: true)
    try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: dir, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
    return dir.appendingPathComponent("private.sqlite")
}
private func makePrivate() throws -> URL {
    let url = try privateURL()
    try Storage.createPrivateDatabase(at: url)
    return url
}
private func withRaw(_ url: URL, _ body: (SQLConnection) throws -> Void) throws {
    let db = try SQLConnection(privatePath: url.path)
    try body(db)
}
private func insertProject(_ db: SQLConnection, id: UUID, name: String = "Client", rate: String = "12.5") throws {
    try db.run("INSERT INTO projects (id,name,hourly_rate,currency_code,is_archived) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)", [.text(id.uuidString.lowercased()), .text(name), .text(rate), .text("EUR"), .integer(0)])
}

@Test func storageCreationChecksRuntimeAndSettings() async throws {
    let url = try makePrivate()
    defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: url.deletingLastPathComponent()) }
    #expect(sqlite3_libversion_number() >= 3_009_000)
    let store = try Storage(privateDatabaseAt: url)
    let empty = try await store.snapshot()
    #expect(empty.schemaVersion == 1 && empty.revision == 0 && empty.projects.isEmpty)
    #expect(throws: StorageError.self) { try Storage.createPrivateDatabase(at: url) }
    try withRaw(url) { db in
        let count = try db.rows("SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'") { sqlite3_column_int64($0, 0) }
        #expect(count == [6])
    }
}

@Test func committedSnapshotAndRollbackAreAtomic() async throws {
    let url = try makePrivate()
    defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: url.deletingLastPathComponent()) }
    let store = try Storage(privateDatabaseAt: url)
    let firstID = UUID()
    let result = try await store.transact { db, before in
        try insertProject(db, id: firstID)
        return before.revision
    }
    #expect(result.value == 0 && result.snapshot.revision == 1)
    #expect(result.snapshot.projects.first?.id == firstID)
    #expect(result.snapshot.projects.first?.hourlyRate == Decimal(string: "12.5")!)
    let badID = UUID()
    await #expect(throws: StorageError.self) {
        try await store.transact { db, _ in try insertProject(db, id: badID, name: "  ") }
    }
    #expect(try await store.snapshot() == result.snapshot)
    // SQL CHECK prevents the blank name even before domain validation.
}

@Test func domainFailureAndMetadataTamperingRollBack() async throws {
    let url = try makePrivate()
    defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: url.deletingLastPathComponent()) }
    let store = try Storage(privateDatabaseAt: url)
    let id = UUID()
    await #expect(throws: LibraryError.self) {
        try await store.transact { db, _ in try insertProject(db, id: id, name: " Client ") }
    }
    await #expect(throws: StorageError.invalidStorage("command changed metadata")) {
        try await store.transact { db, _ in try db.exec("UPDATE library_metadata SET revision=99") }
    }
    let snapshot = try await store.snapshot()
    #expect(snapshot.revision == 0 && snapshot.projects.isEmpty)
}

@Test func commitFaultsDoNotReplayOrPublishSuccess() async throws {
    let url = try makePrivate()
    defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: url.deletingLastPathComponent()) }
    let store = try Storage(privateDatabaseAt: url)
    let a = UUID(), b = UUID(), c = UUID()
    await #expect(throws: StorageError.injectedFailure) {
        try await store.transact(fault: .beforeCommit) { db, _ in try insertProject(db, id: a) }
    }
    do {
        _ = try await store.transact(fault: .commitRejected) { db, _ in try insertProject(db, id: b) }
        Issue.record("Expected SQLite COMMIT to fail while a reader holds a lock")
    } catch let StorageError.sqlite(code, _) {
        #expect(code & 0xff == SQLITE_BUSY)
    } catch { Issue.record("Unexpected error: \(error)") }
    #expect(try await store.snapshot().revision == 0)
    await #expect(throws: StorageError.commitIndeterminate) {
        try await store.transact(fault: .acknowledgementLost) { db, _ in try insertProject(db, id: c) }
    }
    await #expect(throws: StorageError.unavailable) { try await store.snapshot() }
    // Reopening confirms these controlled test outcomes; a real operation has no
    // durable receipt, so revision alone cannot prove an ambiguous operation succeeded.
    let reopened = try Storage(privateDatabaseAt: url)
    let state = try await reopened.snapshot()
    #expect(state.revision == 1 && state.projects.map(\.id) == [c])
}

@Test func schemaAndUnsupportedVersionsFailClosedOnPrivateCopies() throws {
    let versionURL = try makePrivate()
    defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: versionURL.deletingLastPathComponent()) }
    try withRaw(versionURL) { try $0.exec("UPDATE library_metadata SET schema_version=2") }
    #expect(throws: StorageError.unsupportedSchema(2)) { try Storage(privateDatabaseAt: versionURL) }
    try withRaw(versionURL) { db in
        let version = try db.rows("SELECT schema_version FROM library_metadata") { sqlite3_column_int64($0, 0) }
        #expect(version == [2])
    }
    let missing = try makePrivate()
    defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: missing.deletingLastPathComponent()) }
    try withRaw(missing) { try $0.exec("DROP INDEX one_open_entry") }
    #expect(throws: StorageError.invalidStorage("schema shape")) { try Storage(privateDatabaseAt: missing) }
    let singleton = try makePrivate()
    defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: singleton.deletingLastPathComponent()) }
    try withRaw(singleton) { try $0.exec("DELETE FROM library_metadata") }
    #expect(throws: StorageError.invalidStorage("metadata singleton")) { try Storage(privateDatabaseAt: singleton) }
}

@Test func malformedRowsAndCanonicalTextAreRejected() throws {
    let invalidRates = ["12x", "1.0", "01", "1e1", "NaN", "12345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890"]
    for raw in invalidRates {
        let url = try makePrivate()
        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: url.deletingLastPathComponent()) }
        try withRaw(url) { try insertProject($0, id: UUID(), rate: raw) }
        #expect(throws: StorageError.self) { try Storage(privateDatabaseAt: url) }
    }
    let invalidUUID = try makePrivate()
    defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: invalidUUID.deletingLastPathComponent()) }
    try withRaw(invalidUUID) { db in
        try db.run("INSERT INTO projects VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)", [.text(UUID().uuidString), .text("Client"), .text("0"), .text("EUR"), .integer(0)])
    }
    #expect(throws: StorageError.invalidStorage("noncanonical UUID")) { try Storage(privateDatabaseAt: invalidUUID) }
    let wrongClass = try makePrivate()
    defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: wrongClass.deletingLastPathComponent()) }
    try withRaw(wrongClass) { db in
        try insertProject(db, id: UUID())
        try db.exec("UPDATE projects SET hourly_rate = X'3132'")
    }
    #expect(throws: StorageError.invalidStorage("expected text")) { try Storage(privateDatabaseAt: wrongClass) }
    #expect(try canonicalRate(Decimal(string: "0.00000000000000000001")!) == "0.00000000000000000001")
    #expect(try canonicalRate(Decimal(string: "12345678901234567890123456789012345678")!) == "12345678901234567890123456789012345678")
}

@Test func commandCannotEndTransactionOrTruncateText() async throws {
```

### Success Criteria:

#### Automated Verification:
- [ ] `swift test --filter LibraryStoreTests` compiles and passes the foundation, validation and storage tests.
- [ ] Tests check the linked SQLite runtime and settings, six-table shape, metadata singleton, schema mismatch and unsupported version rejection, canonical UUID/rate text and SQLite storage classes, failing integrity and foreign-key checks, and revision overflow.
- [ ] Tests show committed snapshot/revision, SQL and domain rollback, embedded-NUL and transaction-control rejection, metadata tampering rejection, failure before commit, actual SQLITE_BUSY on COMMIT with rollback, and ambiguous acknowledgement with no automatic replay and poisoned handle.
#### Manual Verification:
- [ ] Inspect the internal-only storage boundary: no public normal open or raw SQL, no use of authoritative database/journal; Slice 4 must add process exclusion and private-copy recovery and restart-safe installation before application opening.
- [ ] Inspect committed snapshots and full structural validation; rollback-safe stored history is not rejected solely for appearing future-dated.
- [ ] Confirm real full-flush, APFS backup and restore, power-loss behavior and actual I/O-error recovery remain release gates, not claims established by injected tests.

## Phase 4: Durable library recovery

### Overview

Lease, recovery and validated Library opening; no later operation forwarding. Requires Phase 3 committed.

### Changes Required:

#### 1. Sources/LibraryStore/Recovery.swift

**File**: `Sources/LibraryStore/Recovery.swift`
**Changes**: Create with the complete approved Phase 4 payload.
**Payload source**: Architecture → Staged replacements → Slice 4; CREATE.

```swift
import Foundation
import Darwin
import CryptoKit

public enum LibraryOpenError: Error, Equatable, Sendable {
    case busy
    case unsafeState(String)
    case filesystem(String, Int32)
}

// The stable lock inode is never renamed or removed. This excludes cooperating
// app instances, not external tools or a restore performed while the app runs.
final class LibraryLease: @unchecked Sendable {
    private let fd: Int32
    init(directory: URL) throws {
        let path = directory.appendingPathComponent(".library-lock").path
        let descriptor = open(path, O_RDWR | O_CREAT | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC, 0o600)
        guard descriptor >= 0 else { throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("open lock", errno) }
        var info = stat()
        guard fstat(descriptor, &info) == 0, (info.st_mode & S_IFMT) == S_IFREG, info.st_nlink == 1 else {
            close(descriptor)
            throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("invalid lock file")
        }
        guard flock(descriptor, LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB) == 0 else {
            let code = errno
            close(descriptor)
            if code == EWOULDBLOCK { throw LibraryOpenError.busy }
            throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("lock", code)
        }
        fd = descriptor
    }
    deinit { close(fd) }
}

// Recovery fault hooks are internal and are not part of the app's public API.
enum RecoveryPoint: String, CaseIterable, Sendable {
    case intent, copiedOriginal, copiedWorking, validated, ready, journalRetired
    case publicationCopied, published, intentRemoved, readyRemoved
}

enum Recovery {
    private static var manager: FileManager { .default }
    private static let main = "library.sqlite"
    private static let journal = "library.sqlite-journal"
    private static let work = ".recovery-work"
    private static let intent = ".recovery-intent"
    private static let intentTemp = ".recovery-intent.tmp"
    private static let ready = ".recovery-ready"
    private static let readyTemp = ".recovery-ready.tmp"
    private static let publication = ".recovery-publish"

    private static func child(_ root: URL, _ name: String) -> URL { root.appendingPathComponent(name) }
    private static func status(_ url: URL) throws -> stat? {
        var result = stat()
        if lstat(url.path, &result) == 0 { return result }
        if errno == ENOENT { return nil }
        throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("stat \(url.lastPathComponent)", errno)
    }
    private static func regular(_ url: URL) throws -> Bool {
        guard let result = try status(url) else { return false }
        guard (result.st_mode & S_IFMT) == S_IFREG, result.st_nlink == 1 else {
            throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("not a single-link regular file: \(url.lastPathComponent)")
        }
        return true
    }
    private static func directory(_ url: URL) throws {
        guard let result = try status(url), (result.st_mode & S_IFMT) == S_IFDIR else {
            throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("not a directory: \(url.lastPathComponent)")
        }
    }
    private static func sync(_ url: URL, directory _: Bool = false) throws {
        let fd = Darwin.open(url.path, O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC)
        guard fd >= 0 else { throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("open for sync", errno) }
        defer { close(fd) }
        // On macOS F_FULLFSYNC requests a device flush; fsync also persists directory metadata.
        guard fsync(fd) == 0 else { throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("fsync", errno) }
        guard fcntl(fd, F_FULLFSYNC) == 0 else { throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("fullfsync", errno) }
    }
    private static func ensureDirectory(_ url: URL) throws {
        if try status(url) != nil { try directory(url); return }
        let parent = url.deletingLastPathComponent()
        guard parent.path != url.path else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("missing filesystem root") }
        try ensureDirectory(parent)
        try makeDirectory(url)
    }
    private static func makeDirectory(_ url: URL) throws {
        guard mkdir(url.path, 0o700) == 0 else { throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("mkdir", errno) }
        try sync(url.deletingLastPathComponent(), directory: true)
    }
    private static func remove(_ url: URL) throws {
        if try status(url) != nil { try manager.removeItem(at: url) }
    }
    private static func copy(_ from: URL, _ to: URL) throws {
        guard try regular(from), try status(to) == nil else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("copy source or destination") }
        try manager.copyItem(at: from, to: to)
        guard try regular(to) else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("missing copy") }
        try sync(to)
        try sync(to.deletingLastPathComponent(), directory: true)
    }
    private static func same(_ first: URL, _ second: URL) throws -> Bool {
        guard try regular(first), try regular(second) else { return false }
        return try Data(contentsOf: first, options: .mappedIfSafe) == Data(contentsOf: second, options: .mappedIfSafe)
    }
    private static func digest(_ url: URL) throws -> String {
        guard try regular(url) else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("missing recovery artifact") }
        let handle = try FileHandle(forReadingFrom: url)
        defer { try? handle.close() }
        var hash = SHA256()
        while let data = try handle.read(upToCount: 65536), !data.isEmpty { hash.update(data: data) }
        return hash.finalize().map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
    }
    private static func writeMarker(_ value: String, at url: URL) throws {
        let fd = Darwin.open(url.path, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC, 0o600)
        guard fd >= 0 else { throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("create marker", errno) }
        defer { close(fd) }
        let bytes = Array(value.utf8)
        try bytes.withUnsafeBytes { buffer in
            var offset = 0
            while offset < buffer.count {
                let count = Darwin.write(fd, buffer.baseAddress!.advanced(by: offset), buffer.count - offset)
                if count < 0 && errno == EINTR { continue }
                guard count > 0 else { throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("write marker", errno) }
                offset += count
            }
        }
        guard fsync(fd) == 0, fcntl(fd, F_FULLFSYNC) == 0 else {
            throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("sync marker", errno)
        }
        try sync(url.deletingLastPathComponent(), directory: true)
    }
    private static func marker(_ url: URL) throws -> String? {
        guard try regular(url) else { return nil }
        let data = try Data(contentsOf: url)
        guard data.count < 512, let value = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) else {
            throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("invalid marker")
        }
        return value
    }
    private static func sidecars(_ root: URL) throws {
        let names = try manager.contentsOfDirectory(atPath: root.path)
        guard !names.contains(where: { $0.hasPrefix("library.sqlite-") && $0 != journal }) else {
            throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("unsupported SQLite sidecar")
        }
    }
    private static func crashPoint(_ point: RecoveryPoint, _ fault: (@Sendable (RecoveryPoint) throws -> Void)?) throws {
        try fault?(point)
    }

    // Validation happens only on a disposable copy and all SQLite handles close
    // before either the candidate or the canonical path can be renamed.
    private static func validate(_ url: URL) throws {
        let db = try SQLConnection(privatePath: url.path)
        try checkPrivateDatabase(db)
        db.close()
        guard !(try regular(URL(fileURLWithPath: url.path + "-journal"))) else {
            throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("candidate still has a journal")
        }
        try sync(url)
        try sync(url.deletingLastPathComponent(), directory: true)
    }

    static func open(at root: URL, fault: (@Sendable (RecoveryPoint) throws -> Void)? = nil) throws -> Storage {
        // Foundation resolves the sandbox container. Callers must not move or restore
        // the directory while any cooperating app instance owns its lock.
        try ensureDirectory(root)
        let lease = try LibraryLease(directory: root)
        try sync(root, directory: true)
        let db = child(root, main), jrnl = child(root, journal), workspace = child(root, work)
        let intentURL = child(root, intent), readyURL = child(root, ready), tempURL = child(root, readyTemp)
        let publishURL = child(root, publication)
        let original = child(workspace, "original"), candidateDir = child(workspace, "candidate")
        let originalDB = child(original, main), originalJournal = child(original, journal)
        let candidate = child(candidateDir, main)
        try sidecars(root)

        func install(_ record: String) throws -> Storage {
            let parts = record.split(separator: "\n", omittingEmptySubsequences: false).map(String.init)
            guard parts.count == 5, parts[4].isEmpty,
                  ["create", "existing", "existing+journal"].contains(parts[0]) else {
                throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("unknown ready marker")
            }
            let state = parts[0] + "\n"
            if let prior = try marker(intentURL) {
                guard prior == (state == "create\n" ? "create\n" : "existing\n") else {
                    throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("conflicting intent")
                }
            }
            try directory(workspace); try directory(original); try directory(candidateDir)
            guard try digest(candidate) == parts[1],
                  try (state == "create\n" ? parts[2] == "-" : digest(originalDB) == parts[2]),
                  try (state == "existing+journal\n" ? digest(originalJournal) == parts[3] : parts[3] == "-") else {
                throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("recovery artifact identity mismatch")
            }
            guard try regular(candidate), !(try regular(child(candidateDir, journal))) else {
                throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("missing or journalled candidate")
            }
            let exists = try regular(db), hasJournal = try regular(jrnl)
            if state == "create\n" {
                guard !hasJournal, try (!exists || same(db, candidate)) else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("creation conflict") }
            } else {
                guard try regular(originalDB), exists,
                      try (same(db, originalDB) || same(db, candidate)) else {
                    throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("main generation conflict")
                }
                if state == "existing+journal\n" {
                    guard try regular(originalJournal) else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("missing original journal") }
                    if hasJournal, !(try same(jrnl, originalJournal)) { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("journal generation conflict") }
                    if hasJournal, !(try same(db, originalDB)) { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("new main paired with old journal") }
                } else if hasJournal { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("unexpected journal") }
            }
            // Validate a copy, never mutate the immutable candidate while ready is present.
            let check = child(workspace, "check")
            try remove(check); try makeDirectory(check)
            let checkDB = child(check, main)
            try copy(candidate, checkDB); try validate(checkDB)
            if hasJournal { try remove(jrnl); try sync(root, directory: true) }
            try crashPoint(.journalRetired, fault)
            try remove(publishURL)
            try copy(candidate, publishURL)
            try crashPoint(.publicationCopied, fault)
            guard rename(publishURL.path, db.path) == 0 else { throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("publish", errno) }
            try sync(root, directory: true)
            try crashPoint(.published, fault)
            guard try same(db, candidate) else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("published database mismatch") }
            try remove(intentURL); try sync(root, directory: true)
            try crashPoint(.intentRemoved, fault)
            try remove(readyURL); try sync(root, directory: true)
            try crashPoint(.readyRemoved, fault)
            // The validated canonical file is now authorized for SQLite writes.
            return try Storage(privateDatabaseAt: db, lease: lease)
        }

        if let state = try marker(readyURL) { return try install(state) }

        let sourceExists = try regular(db), journalExists = try regular(jrnl)
        guard sourceExists || !journalExists else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("orphan journal") }
        if let prior = try marker(intentURL) {
            guard prior == "create\n" || prior == "existing\n" else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("unknown intent") }
            guard (prior == "existing\n") == sourceExists else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("intent conflicts with library") }
        } else {
            // Without an intent, an orphan workspace plus missing main could contain
            // the only surviving data: never silently initialize over it.
            guard try (sourceExists || status(workspace) == nil) else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("orphan recovery workspace") }
            let temporary = child(root, intentTemp)
            try remove(temporary)
            try writeMarker(sourceExists ? "existing\n" : "create\n", at: temporary)
            guard rename(temporary.path, intentURL.path) == 0 else { throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("publish intent", errno) }
            try sync(root, directory: true)
        }
        try crashPoint(.intent, fault)
        try remove(workspace); try remove(tempURL); try remove(publishURL)
        try sync(root, directory: true)
        try makeDirectory(workspace); try makeDirectory(original); try makeDirectory(candidateDir)
        if sourceExists {
            try copy(db, originalDB)
            if journalExists { try copy(jrnl, originalJournal) }
        }
        try crashPoint(.copiedOriginal, fault)
        if sourceExists {
            try copy(originalDB, candidate)
            if journalExists { try copy(originalJournal, child(candidateDir, journal)) }
        } else {
            try Storage.createPrivateDatabase(at: candidate)
        }
        try crashPoint(.copiedWorking, fault)
        try validate(candidate)
        try crashPoint(.validated, fault)
        try sync(original, directory: true); try sync(candidateDir, directory: true)
        try sync(workspace, directory: true)
        let state = sourceExists ? (journalExists ? "existing+journal\n" : "existing\n") : "create\n"
        let record = state + (try digest(candidate)) + "\n" + (sourceExists ? try digest(originalDB) : "-") + "\n" + (journalExists ? try digest(originalJournal) : "-") + "\n"
        try writeMarker(record, at: tempURL)
        guard rename(tempURL.path, readyURL.path) == 0 else { throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("publish ready marker", errno) }
        try sync(root, directory: true)
        try crashPoint(.ready, fault)
        return try install(record)
    }
}

public actor Library {
    private let storage: Storage
    private init(storage: Storage) { self.storage = storage }
    public static func open(at directory: URL) throws -> Library { Library(storage: try Recovery.open(at: directory)) }
    public func snapshot() async throws -> LibrarySnapshot { try await storage.snapshot() }
    public func close() async { await storage.close() }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import Darwin
import SQLite3
import Testing
import XCTest
@testable import LibraryStore

final class RecoveryCrashProbe: XCTestCase {
    func testCrash() {
        let env = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment
        if let path = env["UF_LOCK_ROOT"] {
            do { _ = try Recovery.open(at: URL(fileURLWithPath: path)); Darwin._exit(91) }
            catch LibraryOpenError.busy { Darwin._exit(90) }
            catch { Darwin._exit(92) }
        }
        guard let path = env["UF_CRASH_ROOT"], let name = env["UF_CRASH_POINT"],
              let point = RecoveryPoint(rawValue: name) else { return }
        do {
            _ = try Recovery.open(at: URL(fileURLWithPath: path)) { if $0 == point { Darwin._exit(86) } }
            Darwin._exit(87)
        } catch { Darwin._exit(88) }
    }
}

private enum Stop: Error { case injected }
private func recoveryDirectory() -> URL {
    FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString, isDirectory: true)
}

        db = sqlite3.connect(sys.argv[1])
        db.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=DELETE')
        db.execute('PRAGMA cache_size=1')
        db.execute('PRAGMA cache_spill=ON')
```

```swift
import Foundation
import SQLite3
import Darwin

// Internal storage errors; applications open authoritative libraries through Library.
enum StorageError: Error, Equatable {
    case sqlite(Int32, String)
    case invalidStorage(String)
    case unsupportedSchema(Int64)
    case revisionOverflow
    case commitIndeterminate
    case unavailable
    case injectedFailure
}

struct Committed<Value: Sendable>: Sendable {
    let value: Value
    let snapshot: LibrarySnapshot
}

enum CommitFault: Sendable { case none, beforeCommit, commitRejected, acknowledgementLost }

private let transient = unsafeBitCast(-1, to: sqlite3_destructor_type.self)

final class SQLConnection {
    private var db: OpaquePointer?
    var lease: LibraryLease?

    init(privatePath: String) throws {
        var opened: OpaquePointer?
        let rc = sqlite3_open_v2(privatePath, &opened, SQLITE_OPEN_READWRITE | SQLITE_OPEN_NOMUTEX, nil)
        guard rc == SQLITE_OK, let opened else {
            let message = opened.map { String(cString: sqlite3_errmsg($0)) } ?? "cannot open database"
            if let opened { sqlite3_close_v2(opened) }
            throw StorageError.sqlite(rc, message)
        }
        db = opened
        sqlite3_extended_result_codes(opened, 1)
    }

    deinit { close() }
    func close() { if let db { sqlite3_close_v2(db); self.db = nil } }
    var autocommit: Bool { db.map { sqlite3_get_autocommit($0) != 0 } ?? true }
    fileprivate func allowOnlyCommandDML(_ enabled: Bool) throws {
        let db = try handle()
        let rc: Int32
        if !enabled {
            rc = sqlite3_set_authorizer(db, nil, nil)
        } else {
            rc = sqlite3_set_authorizer(db, { _, action, _, _, _, _ in
                switch action {
                case SQLITE_SELECT, SQLITE_READ, SQLITE_INSERT, SQLITE_UPDATE, SQLITE_DELETE,
                     SQLITE_FUNCTION, SQLITE_RECURSIVE: return SQLITE_OK
                default: return SQLITE_DENY
                }
            }, nil)
        }
        guard rc == SQLITE_OK else { throw failure(rc) }
    }
    private func handle() throws -> OpaquePointer { guard let db else { throw StorageError.unavailable }; return db }
    private func failure(_ rc: Int32) -> StorageError {
        .sqlite(rc, db.map { String(cString: sqlite3_errmsg($0)) } ?? "closed")
    }
    func exec(_ sql: String) throws {
        let db = try handle()
        let rc = sqlite3_exec(db, sql, nil, nil, nil)
        guard rc == SQLITE_OK else { throw failure(rc) }
    }
    func rows<T>(_ sql: String, _ body: (OpaquePointer) throws -> T) throws -> [T] {
        let db = try handle()
        var statement: OpaquePointer?
        let rc = sqlite3_prepare_v2(db, sql, -1, &statement, nil)
        guard rc == SQLITE_OK, let statement else { throw failure(rc) }
        defer { sqlite3_finalize(statement) }
        var values: [T] = []
        while true {
            let step = sqlite3_step(statement)
            if step == SQLITE_DONE { return values }
            guard step == SQLITE_ROW else { throw failure(step) }
            values.append(try body(statement))
        }
    }
    func run(_ sql: String, _ bindings: [SQLValue]) throws {
        let db = try handle()
        var statement: OpaquePointer?
        let rc = sqlite3_prepare_v2(db, sql, -1, &statement, nil)
        guard rc == SQLITE_OK, let statement else { throw failure(rc) }
        defer { sqlite3_finalize(statement) }
        guard sqlite3_bind_parameter_count(statement) == Int32(bindings.count) else {
            throw StorageError.invalidStorage("binding count")
        }
        for (offset, value) in bindings.enumerated() {
            let i = Int32(offset + 1)
            let result: Int32
            switch value {
            case .null: result = sqlite3_bind_null(statement, i)
            case .integer(let n): result = sqlite3_bind_int64(statement, i, n)
            case .text(let text):
                guard !text.contains("\0"), text.utf8.count <= Int(Int32.max) else {
                    throw StorageError.invalidStorage("invalid bound text")
                }
                result = text.withCString { sqlite3_bind_text(statement, i, $0, Int32(text.utf8.count), transient) }
            }
            guard result == SQLITE_OK else { throw failure(result) }
        }
        let step = sqlite3_step(statement)
        guard step == SQLITE_DONE else { throw failure(step) }
    }
}

enum SQLValue { case null, integer(Int64), text(String) }

private func integer(_ s: OpaquePointer, _ i: Int32) throws -> Int64 {
    guard sqlite3_column_type(s, i) == SQLITE_INTEGER else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("expected integer") }
    return sqlite3_column_int64(s, i)
}
private func text(_ s: OpaquePointer, _ i: Int32) throws -> String {
    guard sqlite3_column_type(s, i) == SQLITE_TEXT, let p = sqlite3_column_text(s, i) else {
        throw StorageError.invalidStorage("expected text")
    }
    let bytes = UnsafeBufferPointer(start: p, count: Int(sqlite3_column_bytes(s, i)))
    guard let value = String(bytes: bytes, encoding: .utf8), !value.contains("\0") else {
        throw StorageError.invalidStorage("invalid text")
    }
    return value
}
private func optionalInteger(_ s: OpaquePointer, _ i: Int32) throws -> Int64? {
    sqlite3_column_type(s, i) == SQLITE_NULL ? nil : try integer(s, i)
}
private func uuid(_ s: OpaquePointer, _ i: Int32) throws -> UUID {
    let raw = try text(s, i)
    guard let value = UUID(uuidString: raw), value.uuidString.lowercased() == raw else {
        throw StorageError.invalidStorage("noncanonical UUID")
    }
    return value
}
private func optionalUUID(_ s: OpaquePointer, _ i: Int32) throws -> UUID? {
    sqlite3_column_type(s, i) == SQLITE_NULL ? nil : try uuid(s, i)
}

// NSDecimalString produces a non-exponent, locale-independent, exact canonical form.
func canonicalRate(_ rate: Decimal) throws -> String {
    guard !rate.isNaN, rate >= 0 else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("invalid rate") }
    var value = rate
    return NSDecimalString(&value, Locale(identifier: "en_US_POSIX"))
}
private func rate(_ s: OpaquePointer, _ i: Int32) throws -> Decimal {
    let raw = try text(s, i)
    guard let parsed = Decimal(string: raw, locale: Locale(identifier: "en_US_POSIX")),
          try canonicalRate(parsed) == raw else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("noncanonical rate") }
    return parsed
}

// Exact CREATE statements make the greenfield schema an explicit allowlist, including
// constraints and indexes; unknown triggers, views, or schema variations fail closed.
private let schema: [(String, String, String)] = [
    ("table", "library_metadata", "CREATE TABLE library_metadata (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (schema_version >= 1), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision >= 0))"),
    ("table", "projects", "CREATE TABLE projects (id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), hourly_rate TEXT NOT NULL, currency_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(currency_code) = 3), is_archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_archived IN (0, 1)))"),
    ("table", "tasks", "CREATE TABLE tasks (id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, parent_task_id TEXT, name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), budget_seconds INTEGER CHECK (budget_seconds > 0), last_warned_threshold INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (last_warned_threshold IN (0, 80, 100)), UNIQUE (id, project_id), FOREIGN KEY (parent_task_id, project_id) REFERENCES tasks(id, project_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, CHECK (parent_task_id IS NULL OR parent_task_id <> id))"),
    ("table", "time_entries", "CREATE TABLE time_entries (id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, start_at INTEGER NOT NULL, end_at INTEGER, CHECK (end_at IS NULL OR end_at > start_at))"),
    ("table", "active_timer", "CREATE TABLE active_timer (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), entry_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES time_entries(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, checkpoint_at INTEGER NOT NULL)"),
    ("table", "pending_sleep_intervals", "CREATE TABLE pending_sleep_intervals (id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, sleep_at INTEGER NOT NULL, wake_at INTEGER, CHECK (wake_at IS NULL OR wake_at > sleep_at))"),
    ("index", "tasks_by_parent", "CREATE INDEX tasks_by_parent ON tasks(project_id, parent_task_id)"),
    ("index", "entries_by_task_start", "CREATE INDEX entries_by_task_start ON time_entries(task_id, start_at)"),
    ("index", "entries_by_start", "CREATE INDEX entries_by_start ON time_entries(start_at)"),
    ("index", "one_open_entry", "CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_open_entry ON time_entries((1)) WHERE end_at IS NULL"),
    ("index", "sleep_by_task", "CREATE INDEX sleep_by_task ON pending_sleep_intervals(task_id)"),
    ("index", "one_unknown_wake", "CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_unknown_wake ON pending_sleep_intervals((1)) WHERE wake_at IS NULL")
]

private func checkSchema(_ db: SQLConnection) throws {
    let actual = try db.rows("SELECT type, name, sql FROM sqlite_schema WHERE sql IS NOT NULL ORDER BY type, name") {
        try [text($0, 0), text($0, 1), text($0, 2)]
    }
    let expected = schema.map { [$0.0, $0.1, $0.2] }.sorted { ($0[0], $0[1]) < ($1[0], $1[1]) }
    guard actual == expected else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("schema shape") }
}
private func configure(_ db: SQLConnection) throws {
    guard sqlite3_libversion_number() >= 3_009_000 else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("SQLite runtime too old") }
    try db.exec("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
    let journal = try db.rows("PRAGMA journal_mode=DELETE") { try text($0, 0) }
    try db.exec("PRAGMA synchronous=FULL")
    try db.exec("PRAGMA fullfsync=ON")
    let foreign = try db.rows("PRAGMA foreign_keys") { try integer($0, 0) }
    let synchronous = try db.rows("PRAGMA synchronous") { try integer($0, 0) }
    let flush = try db.rows("PRAGMA fullfsync") { try integer($0, 0) }
    guard journal == ["delete"], foreign == [1], synchronous == [2], flush == [1] else {
        throw StorageError.invalidStorage("required SQLite settings unavailable")
    }
}
private func checkIntegrity(_ db: SQLConnection) throws {
    let integrity = try db.rows("PRAGMA integrity_check") { try text($0, 0) }
    guard integrity == ["ok"] else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("integrity_check") }
    let foreign = try db.rows("PRAGMA foreign_key_check") { _ in true }
    guard foreign.isEmpty else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("foreign_key_check") }
}
func decodeSnapshot(_ db: SQLConnection) throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
    let meta = try db.rows("SELECT id, schema_version, revision FROM library_metadata") {
        try (integer($0, 0), integer($0, 1), integer($0, 2))

    guard meta.count == 1, meta[0].0 == 1 else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("metadata singleton") }
    guard meta[0].1 == 1 else { throw StorageError.unsupportedSchema(meta[0].1) }

        let flag = try integer(s, 4)
        guard flag == 0 || flag == 1 else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("boolean") }

    }
    let tasks = try db.rows("SELECT id, project_id, parent_task_id, name, budget_seconds, last_warned_threshold FROM tasks ORDER BY id") { s in
        guard let warning = WarningThreshold(rawValue: try integer(s, 5)) else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("warning") }
        return try TaskRecord(id: uuid(s, 0), projectID: uuid(s, 1), parentTaskID: optionalUUID(s, 2), name: text(s, 3), budgetSeconds: optionalInteger(s, 4), lastWarnedThreshold: warning)
    }
    let entries = try db.rows("SELECT id, task_id, start_at, end_at FROM time_entries ORDER BY id") { s in

    }

        try PendingSleepInterval(id: uuid(s, 0), taskID: uuid(s, 1), sleepAt: integer(s, 2), wakeAt: optionalInteger(s, 3))
    }
    let snapshot = LibrarySnapshot(schemaVersion: meta[0].1, revision: meta[0].2, projects: projects, tasks: tasks, entries: entries, activeTimer: timers.first?.1, pendingSleepIntervals: pending)
```
