```swift
func load(_ db: SQLConnection) throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
    let snapshot = try decodeSnapshot(db)
    try SnapshotValidator.validate(snapshot)
    return snapshot
}

func checkPrivateDatabase(_ db: SQLConnection) throws {
    try checkSchema(db)
    try configure(db)
    try checkIntegrity(db)
    _ = try load(db)
}

// Internal initializer: callers supply a private working database, or an authoritative
// database only after Recovery validates and installs it under the retained lease.
actor Storage {
    private let connection: SQLConnection
    private let privateDatabasePath: String
    private var poisoned = false

    init(privateDatabaseAt url: URL, lease: LibraryLease? = nil) throws {
        let db = try SQLConnection(privatePath: url.path)
        try checkSchema(db)
        try configure(db)
        try checkIntegrity(db)
        _ = try load(db)
        connection = db
        privateDatabasePath = url.path
        db.lease = lease
    }

    // Only isolated test/working paths: creation requires a genuinely absent file.
    static func createPrivateDatabase(at url: URL) throws {
        let fd = open(url.path, O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_WRONLY, S_IRUSR | S_IWUSR)
        guard fd >= 0 else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("cannot exclusively create private database") }
        Darwin.close(fd)
        let db = try SQLConnection(privatePath: url.path)
        try configure(db)
        try db.exec("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        do {
            for (_, _, statement) in schema { try db.exec(statement) }
            try db.exec("INSERT INTO library_metadata (id, schema_version, revision) VALUES (1, 1, 0)")
            try db.exec("COMMIT")
        } catch {
            try? db.exec("ROLLBACK")
            throw error
        }
    }

    func close() {
        poisoned = true
        connection.close()
        connection.lease = nil
    }

    func snapshot() throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
        guard !poisoned else { throw StorageError.unavailable }
        return try load(connection)
    }

    // Internal only; commands must leave the complete snapshot structurally valid.
    // No await occurs between BEGIN and COMMIT; no public raw-SQL surface is exported.
    func transact<Value: Sendable>(fault: CommitFault = .none,
        _ apply: @Sendable (SQLConnection, LibrarySnapshot) throws -> Value) throws -> Committed<Value> {
        guard !poisoned else { throw StorageError.unavailable }
        try connection.exec("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        var commitStarted = false
        do {
            let before = try load(connection)
            guard before.revision < .max else { throw StorageError.revisionOverflow }
            try connection.allowOnlyCommandDML(true)
            let value: Value
            do {
                value = try apply(connection, before)
            }
            catch {
                try connection.allowOnlyCommandDML(false)
                throw error
            }
            try connection.allowOnlyCommandDML(false)
            guard !connection.autocommit else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("command ended transaction") }
            // Commands cannot alter metadata; the store alone owns revision changes.
            let interim = try load(connection)
            guard interim.schemaVersion == before.schemaVersion, interim.revision == before.revision else {
                throw StorageError.invalidStorage("command changed metadata")
            }
            try connection.run("UPDATE library_metadata SET revision = ? WHERE id = 1 AND revision = ?", [.integer(before.revision + 1), .integer(before.revision)])
            let after = try load(connection)
            guard after.revision == before.revision + 1 else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("revision update") }
            if fault == .beforeCommit { throw StorageError.injectedFailure }
            // A separate reader produces a real SQLITE_BUSY from COMMIT in tests.
            let blocker: SQLConnection?
            if fault == .commitRejected {
                let reader = try SQLConnection(privatePath: privateDatabasePath)
                try reader.exec("BEGIN")
                _ = try reader.rows("SELECT revision FROM library_metadata") { _ in true }
                blocker = reader
            } else { blocker = nil }
            defer { blocker?.close() }
            commitStarted = true
            try connection.exec("COMMIT")
            if fault == .acknowledgementLost { throw StorageError.injectedFailure }
            return Committed(value: value, snapshot: after)
        } catch {
            if !connection.autocommit {
                do { try connection.exec("ROLLBACK") }
                catch { poisoned = true; connection.close(); throw StorageError.commitIndeterminate }
                throw error
            }
            if commitStarted {
                poisoned = true
                connection.close()
                throw StorageError.commitIndeterminate
            }
            throw error
        }
    }
}
```

### Success Criteria:

#### Automated Verification:
- [ ] `swift test --filter LibraryStoreTests` compiles and passes the foundation, validation, storage and recovery tests using only approved Slices 1–3 plus this Slice 4 manifest; no later source files are present.
- [ ] Abrupt subprocess exits at every recovery checkpoint restart successfully for fresh, populated existing, and hot-journal libraries, without publishing uncommitted rows.
- [ ] Unsupported schemas, invalid databases, malformed markers, unexpected sidecars, orphan journals and substituted/conflicting recovery generations fail closed without replacing the rejected data.
- [ ] Same-process and second-process opens are excluded while the library is owned; opening succeeds after explicit close, and the public Library open/snapshot/close lifecycle rejects snapshots after close.
- [ ] Later commits survive reopening after marker clearance, and incomplete temporary markers do not cause data loss.

#### Manual Verification:
- [ ] Inspect Recovery.swift: acquire the stable lease before classification/copying, validate disposable same-generation copies before publication, retain original artifacts through failed validation, verify ready-marker digests and conflicting intent/main/journal guards, and refuse an orphan workspace with no main or intent.
- [ ] Inspect Storage.swift: only lease retention, ownership-bound initialization, explicit close release and boundary comments differ from approved Slice 3; no later command, timer, budget, migration or correction dependencies are introduced. Library exposes only open, snapshot and close at this stage.
- [ ] Inspect file/directory fsync and F_FULLFSYNC barriers and restart classification after journal retirement, publication and marker removal. Subprocess interruption is not power-loss proof; signed sandbox, target-hardware APFS/power-loss and stopped-app Arq/Time Machine restore acceptance belong to Slice 12.

```swift
import Foundation

public enum CommandError: Error, Equatable, Sendable, LocalizedError {
    case missingRecord, archivedProject, migrationRequired, recoveryRequired
    case currencyConfirmationRequired(String), currencyChanged
    public var errorDescription: String? {
        switch self {
        case .missingRecord: "The record no longer exists. Reopen the form."
        case .archivedProject: "Restore this project before editing its tasks."
        case .migrationRequired: "Adding a child to a task with time requires Generic migration."
        case .recoveryRequired: "Existing timer or sleep state needs review before editing."
        case .currencyConfirmationRequired: "Confirm currency relabeling; this does not convert the rate."
        case .currencyChanged: "The project currency changed. Reopen the form and confirm again."

        }
    }
}

public enum WorkspaceCommand: Sendable {
    case saveProject(id: UUID, name: String, rate: Decimal, currency: String, confirmedPreviousCurrency: String?)
    case setArchived(id: UUID, archived: Bool)
    case createTask(id: UUID, projectID: UUID, parentID: UUID?, name: String)
    case renameTask(id: UUID, name: String)
}

extension Storage {
    func perform(_ command: WorkspaceCommand, fault: CommitFault = .none) throws -> Committed<Bool> {
        try transact(fault: fault) { db, before in
            guard before.activeTimer == nil, before.pendingSleepIntervals.isEmpty else {
                throw CommandError.recoveryRequired
            }
            func key(_ id: UUID) -> SQLValue { .text(id.uuidString.lowercased()) }
            func name(_ value: String) -> SQLValue {
                .text(value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines))
            }
            switch command {
            case let .saveProject(id, title, rate, currency, confirmed):
                let old = before.projects.first { $0.id == id }
                if let confirmed, old?.currencyCode != confirmed { throw CommandError.currencyChanged }
                if let old, old.currencyCode != currency,
                   before.entries.contains(where: { entry in before.tasks.contains { $0.id == entry.taskID && $0.projectID == id } }),
                   confirmed != old.currencyCode {
                    throw CommandError.currencyConfirmationRequired(old.currencyCode)
                }
                let values: [SQLValue] = [name(title), .text(try canonicalRate(rate)), .text(currency)]
                if old != nil {
                    try db.run("UPDATE projects SET name=?,hourly_rate=?,currency_code=? WHERE id=?", values + [key(id)])
                } else {
                    try db.run("INSERT INTO projects(name,hourly_rate,currency_code,id) VALUES (?,?,?,?)", values + [key(id)])
                }
            case let .setArchived(id, archived):
                guard before.projects.contains(where: { $0.id == id }) else { throw CommandError.missingRecord }
                try db.run("UPDATE projects SET is_archived=? WHERE id=?", [.integer(archived ? 1 : 0), key(id)])
            case let .createTask(id, projectID, parentID, title):
                guard let project = before.projects.first(where: { $0.id == projectID }) else { throw CommandError.missingRecord }
                guard !project.isArchived else { throw CommandError.archivedProject }
                if let parentID {
                    guard before.tasks.contains(where: { $0.id == parentID && $0.projectID == projectID }) else {
                        throw CommandError.missingRecord
                    }
                    if before.entries.contains(where: { $0.taskID == parentID }) {
                        throw CommandError.migrationRequired
                    }
                }
                try db.run("INSERT INTO tasks(id,project_id,parent_task_id,name) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                           [key(id), key(projectID), parentID.map(key) ?? .null, name(title)])
            case let .renameTask(id, title):
                guard let task = before.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == id }),
                      let project = before.projects.first(where: { $0.id == task.projectID }) else { throw CommandError.missingRecord }
                guard !project.isArchived else { throw CommandError.archivedProject }
                try db.run("UPDATE tasks SET name=? WHERE id=?", [name(title), key(id)])

            }
            return true
        }
    }
}

public enum RateInput {
    public static func parse(_ text: String, locale: Locale = .current) -> Decimal? {
        let input = text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        let separator = locale.decimalSeparator ?? "."
        let parts = input.components(separatedBy: separator)
        guard (1...2).contains(parts.count),
              parts.allSatisfy({ !$0.isEmpty && $0.unicodeScalars.allSatisfy { $0.properties.generalCategory == .decimalNumber } }) else { return nil }
        let canonical = parts.map { $0.map { String($0.wholeNumberValue!) }.joined() }.joined(separator: ".")
        guard let value = Decimal(string: canonical, locale: Locale(identifier: "en_US_POSIX")),
              !value.isNaN, value >= 0 else { return nil }
        // Reject silent Decimal precision loss, while allowing redundant zeroes in user input.
        func normalized(_ string: String) -> String {
            let pieces = string.split(separator: ".", omittingEmptySubsequences: false)
            let whole = String(pieces[0].drop(while: { $0 == "0" }))
            let fraction = pieces.count == 2 ? String(String(pieces[1].reversed().drop(while: { $0 == "0" })).reversed()) : ""
            return (whole.isEmpty ? "0" : whole) + (fraction.isEmpty ? "" : "." + fraction)
        }
        guard let stored = try? canonicalRate(value), normalized(canonical) == normalized(stored) else { return nil }
        return value
    }
    public static func text(_ value: Decimal, locale: Locale = .current) -> String {
        (try? canonicalRate(value))?.replacingOccurrences(of: ".", with: locale.decimalSeparator ?? ".") ?? ""
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import Darwin
import CryptoKit

public enum LibraryOpenError: Error, Equatable, Sendable {
    case busy
    case unsafeState(String)
    case filesystem(String, Int32)
}

// The stable lock inode is never renamed or removed. This excludes cooperating
// app instances, not external tools or a restore performed while the app runs.
final class LibraryLease: @unchecked Sendable {
    private let fd: Int32
    init(directory: URL) throws {
        let path = directory.appendingPathComponent(".library-lock").path
        let descriptor = open(path, O_RDWR | O_CREAT | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC, 0o600)
        guard descriptor >= 0 else { throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("open lock", errno) }
        var info = stat()
        guard fstat(descriptor, &info) == 0, (info.st_mode & S_IFMT) == S_IFREG, info.st_nlink == 1 else {
            close(descriptor)
            throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("invalid lock file")
        }
        guard flock(descriptor, LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB) == 0 else {
            let code = errno
            close(descriptor)
            if code == EWOULDBLOCK { throw LibraryOpenError.busy }
            throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("lock", code)
        }
        fd = descriptor
    }
    deinit { close(fd) }
}

// Recovery fault hooks are internal and are not part of the app's public API.
enum RecoveryPoint: String, CaseIterable, Sendable {
    case intent, copiedOriginal, copiedWorking, validated, ready, journalRetired
    case publicationCopied, published, intentRemoved, readyRemoved
}

enum Recovery {
    private static var manager: FileManager { .default }
    private static let main = "library.sqlite"
    private static let journal = "library.sqlite-journal"
    private static let work = ".recovery-work"
    private static let intent = ".recovery-intent"
    private static let intentTemp = ".recovery-intent.tmp"
    private static let ready = ".recovery-ready"
    private static let readyTemp = ".recovery-ready.tmp"
    private static let publication = ".recovery-publish"

    private static func child(_ root: URL, _ name: String) -> URL { root.appendingPathComponent(name) }
    private static func status(_ url: URL) throws -> stat? {
        var result = stat()
        if lstat(url.path, &result) == 0 { return result }
        if errno == ENOENT { return nil }
        throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("stat \(url.lastPathComponent)", errno)
    }
    private static func regular(_ url: URL) throws -> Bool {
        guard let result = try status(url) else { return false }
        guard (result.st_mode & S_IFMT) == S_IFREG, result.st_nlink == 1 else {
            throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("not a single-link regular file: \(url.lastPathComponent)")
        }
        return true
    }
    private static func directory(_ url: URL) throws {
        guard let result = try status(url), (result.st_mode & S_IFMT) == S_IFDIR else {
            throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("not a directory: \(url.lastPathComponent)")
        }
    }
    private static func sync(_ url: URL, directory _: Bool = false) throws {
        let fd = Darwin.open(url.path, O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC)
        guard fd >= 0 else { throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("open for sync", errno) }
        defer { close(fd) }
        // On macOS F_FULLFSYNC requests a device flush; fsync also persists directory metadata.
        guard fsync(fd) == 0 else { throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("fsync", errno) }
        guard fcntl(fd, F_FULLFSYNC) == 0 else { throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("fullfsync", errno) }
    }
    private static func ensureDirectory(_ url: URL) throws {
        if try status(url) != nil { try directory(url); return }
        let parent = url.deletingLastPathComponent()
        guard parent.path != url.path else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("missing filesystem root") }
        try ensureDirectory(parent)
        try makeDirectory(url)
    }
    private static func makeDirectory(_ url: URL) throws {
        guard mkdir(url.path, 0o700) == 0 else { throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("mkdir", errno) }
        try sync(url.deletingLastPathComponent(), directory: true)
    }
    private static func remove(_ url: URL) throws {
        if try status(url) != nil { try manager.removeItem(at: url) }
    }
    private static func copy(_ from: URL, _ to: URL) throws {
        guard try regular(from), try status(to) == nil else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("copy source or destination") }
        try manager.copyItem(at: from, to: to)
        guard try regular(to) else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("missing copy") }
        try sync(to)
        try sync(to.deletingLastPathComponent(), directory: true)
    }
    private static func same(_ first: URL, _ second: URL) throws -> Bool {
        guard try regular(first), try regular(second) else { return false }
        return try Data(contentsOf: first, options: .mappedIfSafe) == Data(contentsOf: second, options: .mappedIfSafe)
    }
    private static func digest(_ url: URL) throws -> String {
        guard try regular(url) else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("missing recovery artifact") }
        let handle = try FileHandle(forReadingFrom: url)
        defer { try? handle.close() }
        var hash = SHA256()
        while let data = try handle.read(upToCount: 65536), !data.isEmpty { hash.update(data: data) }
        return hash.finalize().map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
    }
    private static func writeMarker(_ value: String, at url: URL) throws {
        let fd = Darwin.open(url.path, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC, 0o600)
        guard fd >= 0 else { throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("create marker", errno) }
        defer { close(fd) }
        let bytes = Array(value.utf8)
        try bytes.withUnsafeBytes { buffer in
            var offset = 0
            while offset < buffer.count {
                let count = Darwin.write(fd, buffer.baseAddress!.advanced(by: offset), buffer.count - offset)
                if count < 0 && errno == EINTR { continue }
                guard count > 0 else { throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("write marker", errno) }
                offset += count
            }
        }
        guard fsync(fd) == 0, fcntl(fd, F_FULLFSYNC) == 0 else {
            throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("sync marker", errno)
        }
        try sync(url.deletingLastPathComponent(), directory: true)
    }
    private static func marker(_ url: URL) throws -> String? {
        guard try regular(url) else { return nil }
        let data = try Data(contentsOf: url)
        guard data.count < 512, let value = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) else {
            throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("invalid marker")
        }
        return value
    }
    private static func sidecars(_ root: URL) throws {
        let names = try manager.contentsOfDirectory(atPath: root.path)
        guard !names.contains(where: { $0.hasPrefix("library.sqlite-") && $0 != journal }) else {
            throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("unsupported SQLite sidecar")
        }
    }
    private static func crashPoint(_ point: RecoveryPoint, _ fault: (@Sendable (RecoveryPoint) throws -> Void)?) throws {
        try fault?(point)
    }

    // Validation happens only on a disposable copy and all SQLite handles close
    // before either the candidate or the canonical path can be renamed.
    private static func validate(_ url: URL) throws {
        let db = try SQLConnection(privatePath: url.path)
        try checkPrivateDatabase(db)
        db.close()
        guard !(try regular(URL(fileURLWithPath: url.path + "-journal"))) else {
            throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("candidate still has a journal")
        }
        try sync(url)
        try sync(url.deletingLastPathComponent(), directory: true)
    }

    static func open(at root: URL, fault: (@Sendable (RecoveryPoint) throws -> Void)? = nil) throws -> Storage {
        // Foundation resolves the sandbox container. Callers must not move or restore
        // the directory while any cooperating app instance owns its lock.
        try ensureDirectory(root)
        let lease = try LibraryLease(directory: root)
        try sync(root, directory: true)
        let db = child(root, main), jrnl = child(root, journal), workspace = child(root, work)
        let intentURL = child(root, intent), readyURL = child(root, ready), tempURL = child(root, readyTemp)
        let publishURL = child(root, publication)
        let original = child(workspace, "original"), candidateDir = child(workspace, "candidate")
        let originalDB = child(original, main), originalJournal = child(original, journal)
        let candidate = child(candidateDir, main)
        try sidecars(root)

        func install(_ record: String) throws -> Storage {
            let parts = record.split(separator: "\n", omittingEmptySubsequences: false).map(String.init)
            guard parts.count == 5, parts[4].isEmpty,
                  ["create", "existing", "existing+journal"].contains(parts[0]) else {
                throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("unknown ready marker")
            }
            let state = parts[0] + "\n"
            if let prior = try marker(intentURL) {
                guard prior == (state == "create\n" ? "create\n" : "existing\n") else {
                    throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("conflicting intent")
                }
            }
            try directory(workspace); try directory(original); try directory(candidateDir)
            guard try digest(candidate) == parts[1],
                  try (state == "create\n" ? parts[2] == "-" : digest(originalDB) == parts[2]),
                  try (state == "existing+journal\n" ? digest(originalJournal) == parts[3] : parts[3] == "-") else {
                throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("recovery artifact identity mismatch")
            }
            guard try regular(candidate), !(try regular(child(candidateDir, journal))) else {
                throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("missing or journalled candidate")
            }
            let exists = try regular(db), hasJournal = try regular(jrnl)
            if state == "create\n" {
                guard !hasJournal, try (!exists || same(db, candidate)) else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("creation conflict") }

                if state == "existing+journal\n" {

            try crashPoint(.published, fault)

        } else {

        guard rename(tempURL.path, readyURL.path) == 0 else { throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("publish ready marker", errno) }
        try sync(root, directory: true)
        try crashPoint(.ready, fault)
        return try install(record)
    }
}

public actor Library {
    private let storage: Storage
    private init(storage: Storage) { self.storage = storage }
    public static func open(at directory: URL) throws -> Library { Library(storage: try Recovery.open(at: directory)) }
    public func snapshot() async throws -> LibrarySnapshot { try await storage.snapshot() }
    public func perform(_ command: WorkspaceCommand) async throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
        try await storage.perform(command).snapshot
    }
    public func close() async { await storage.close() }
}
```

```swift
        VStack(alignment: .leading) {
            if let error = model.error { Text(error).foregroundStyle(.red).textSelection(.enabled) }
            Button("New task…") {
                openWindow(id: "workspace")
                NSApp.activate()
                if let projectID = model.projects.first(where: { $0.id == model.selectedProject && !$0.isArchived })?.id
                    ?? model.projects.first(where: { !$0.isArchived })?.id {
                    model.newTask(project: projectID)
                }
            }.disabled(model.sheet != nil || model.blocked || model.isBusy || !model.projects.contains { !$0.isArchived })
            Button("New project…") {
                openWindow(id: "workspace")
                NSApp.activate()
                model.editProject()
            }.disabled(model.sheet != nil || model.blocked || model.isBusy)
            Button("Open UurtjeFactuurtje") { openWindow(id: "workspace"); NSApp.activate() }
            Button("Quit UurtjeFactuurtje") { NSApp.terminate(nil) }.keyboardShortcut("q")
        }.padding().frame(width: 380)
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import Observation
import LibraryStore

@MainActor @Observable final class WorkspaceModel {
    private(set) var snapshot: LibrarySnapshot?
    private(set) var isBusy = false
    private(set) var blocked = false
    var error: String?
    var sheet: EditorRoute?
    var showArchived = false
    var search = ""
    var selectedProject: UUID? {
        didSet { UserDefaults.standard.set(selectedProject?.uuidString, forKey: "selectedProject") }
    }
    private var library: Library?
    private(set) var libraryLocation = "Application Support/UurtjeFactuurtje/library.sqlite (inside the app sandbox)"
    var canRetryOpen: Bool { library == nil && !isBusy }
    private var tail: Task<Void, Never>?
    private var queued = 0

    init() {
        selectedProject = UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: "selectedProject").flatMap(UUID.init(uuidString:))
        retryOpen()
    }

    func retryOpen() {
        guard library == nil else { return }
        enqueue { model in
            do {
                let directory = try FileManager.default.url(for: .applicationSupportDirectory, in: .userDomainMask,
                                                           appropriateFor: nil, create: true).appendingPathComponent("UurtjeFactuurtje", isDirectory: true)
                model.libraryLocation = directory.appendingPathComponent("library.sqlite").path
                let library = try await Task.detached {
                    try Library.open(at: directory)
                }.value
                model.library = library
                model.snapshot = try await library.snapshot()
                model.blocked = model.snapshot?.activeTimer != nil || model.snapshot?.pendingSleepIntervals.isEmpty == false
                model.error = model.blocked ? "Existing timer or sleep state needs review. Editing is blocked until time recovery is available; no uncertain time is billed." : nil
            } catch { model.blocked = true; model.error = String(describing: error) }
        }
    }

    private func enqueue(_ operation: @escaping @MainActor (WorkspaceModel) async -> Void) {
        let previous = tail
        queued += 1
        isBusy = true
        tail = Task { @MainActor in
            await previous?.value
            await operation(self)
            queued -= 1
            isBusy = queued != 0
        }
    }

    func submit(_ command: WorkspaceCommand, next: EditorRoute? = nil) {
        enqueue { model in
            guard !model.blocked, let library = model.library else { return }
            do {
                model.snapshot = try await library.perform(command)
                model.sheet = next
                model.error = nil
            } catch let CommandError.currencyConfirmationRequired(previous) {
                model.sheet?.confirmCurrency = previous
            } catch {
                // A poisoned store cannot supply a snapshot: stop writes, never replay the form.
                if (try? await library.snapshot()) == nil { model.blocked = true }
                if let invalid = error as? LibraryError, case let .invalid(violations) = invalid {
                    model.error = violations.map {
                        switch $0.code {
                        case .siblingName: "Name: another task at this location has the same name."
                        case .project: "Project: enter a trimmed name, nonnegative rate and supported currency."
                        case .task: "Task: check the name and selected project."
                        default: "The edit was rejected (\($0.code.rawValue)). No changes were saved."
                        }
                    }.joined(separator: "\n")
                } else { model.error = (error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? String(describing: error) }
            }
        }
    }

    func editProject(_ project: Project? = nil) { error = nil; sheet = .project(project) }
    func newTask(project: UUID, parent: UUID? = nil) { error = nil; sheet = .task(nil, project: project, parent: parent) }
    func editTask(_ task: TaskRecord) { error = nil; sheet = .task(task, project: task.projectID, parent: task.parentTaskID) }
    func path(for task: TaskRecord) -> String {
        var names = [task.name]
        var parent = task.parentTaskID
        while let id = parent, let record = snapshot?.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == id }) {
            names.append(record.name); parent = record.parentTaskID
        }
        return names.reversed().joined(separator: " › ")
    }
    var projects: [Project] {
        (snapshot?.projects ?? []).filter { showArchived || !$0.isArchived }
            .sorted { $0.name.localizedStandardCompare($1.name) == .orderedAscending }
    }
    func tasks(project: UUID, parent: UUID?) -> [TaskRecord] {
        (snapshot?.tasks ?? []).filter { $0.projectID == project && $0.parentTaskID == parent }
            .sorted { $0.name.localizedStandardCompare($1.name) == .orderedAscending }
    }
}

struct EditorRoute: Identifiable {
    enum Kind { case project, task }
    let id: UUID
    let kind: Kind
    let isNew: Bool
    var projectID: UUID?
    var parentID: UUID?
    var name: String
    var rate: String
    var currency: String
    var confirmCurrency: String?
    var currencyAccepted = false
    var archiveRequested = false
    static func project(_ project: Project?) -> Self {
        Self(id: project?.id ?? UUID(), kind: .project, isNew: project == nil,
             name: project?.name ?? "", rate: RateInput.text(project?.hourlyRate ?? 0),
             currency: project?.currencyCode ?? Locale.current.currency?.identifier ?? "EUR")
    }
    static func task(_ task: TaskRecord?, project: UUID, parent: UUID?) -> Self {
        Self(id: task?.id ?? UUID(), kind: .task, isNew: task == nil,
             projectID: project, parentID: parent, name: task?.name ?? "", rate: "", currency: "")
    }
}
```

```swift
import SwiftUI
import LibraryStore

struct WorkspaceView: View {
    @Bindable var model: WorkspaceModel
    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack { TrackDetail(model: model) }
            .sheet(item: $model.sheet) { _ in ProjectTaskSheets(model: model).interactiveDismissDisabled(model.isBusy) }
            .frame(minWidth: 750, minHeight: 480)
    }
}

private struct TrackDetail: View {
    @Bindable var model: WorkspaceModel
    @AppStorage("expandedTaskIDs") private var expansion = ""
    private var expanded: Set<String> { Set(expansion.split(separator: ",").map(String.init)) }
    private func toggle(_ id: UUID) {
        var ids = expanded
        if !ids.insert(id.uuidString).inserted { ids.remove(id.uuidString) }
        expansion = ids.sorted().joined(separator: ",")
    }
    private func rows(_ project: Project) -> [(task: TaskRecord, depth: Int, path: String)] {
        var result: [(TaskRecord, Int, String)] = []
        var stack = model.tasks(project: project.id, parent: nil).reversed().map { ($0, 0, project.name) }
        while let (task, depth, prefix) = stack.popLast() {
            let path = prefix + " › " + task.name
            if model.search.isEmpty || path.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(model.search) { result.append((task, depth, path)) }
            if !model.search.isEmpty || expanded.contains(task.id.uuidString) {
                stack.append(contentsOf: model.tasks(project: project.id, parent: task.id).reversed().map { ($0, depth + 1, path) })
            }
        }
        return result
    }
    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading) {
            HStack {
                Picker("Project", selection: $model.selectedProject) {
                    Text("All projects").tag(nil as UUID?)
                    ForEach(model.projects) { project in Text(project.name).tag(Optional(project.id)) }
                }
                Toggle("Show archived projects", isOn: $model.showArchived)
            }.padding([.horizontal, .top])
            if let error = model.error {
                VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                    Text(error).foregroundStyle(.red)
                    Text("Library: " + model.libraryLocation)
                    Text("For a failed edit, retry Save only while editing remains enabled. If blocked after a save, quit and reopen, inspect the saved state before re-entering anything; do not replay blindly. To restore a backup, quit all app instances and restore the entire library directory, including any journal, using Time Machine or Arq. Never replace only one file while the app is running.")
                    Button("Retry library opening") { model.retryOpen() }.disabled(!model.canRetryOpen)
                }.textSelection(.enabled).padding(.horizontal)
            }
            if model.blocked { Text("Library unavailable or existing time needs review. Editing is blocked; no uncertain time is billed.").padding(.horizontal) }
            if model.isBusy { ProgressView().controlSize(.small).padding(.horizontal) }
            if model.snapshot?.projects.isEmpty == true {
                ContentUnavailableView {
                    Label("Track your first project", systemImage: "folder.badge.plus")
                } description: { Text("Create a project, then add a task.") } actions: {
                    Button("New project…") { model.editProject() }.disabled(model.blocked || model.isBusy)
                }
            } else {
                List {
                    ForEach(model.projects.filter { model.selectedProject == nil || $0.id == model.selectedProject }) { project in
                        Section {
                            ForEach(rows(project), id: \.task.id) { row in
                                HStack {
                                    if !model.tasks(project: project.id, parent: row.task.id).isEmpty {
                                        Button { toggle(row.task.id) } label: {
                                            Image(systemName: expanded.contains(row.task.id.uuidString) ? "chevron.down" : "chevron.right")
                                        }.buttonStyle(.plain).accessibilityLabel("Toggle subtasks of \(row.task.name)")
                                    }
                                    Text(model.search.isEmpty ? row.task.name : row.path)
                                    Spacer()
                                    Button("Edit…") { model.editTask(row.task) }
                                    Button("Add subtask…") { model.newTask(project: project.id, parent: row.task.id) }
                                }
                                .padding(.leading, CGFloat(min(row.depth, 12)) * 14)
                                .disabled(project.isArchived || model.blocked || model.isBusy)
                            }
                        } header: {
                            HStack {
                                Text(project.name + (project.isArchived ? " (Archived)" : ""))
                                Spacer()
                                Text("\(RateInput.text(project.hourlyRate)) \(project.currencyCode)/hour")
                                Button("Edit project…") { model.editProject(project) }
                                if project.isArchived { Button("Restore") { model.submit(.setArchived(id: project.id, archived: false)) } }
                                else { Button("New task…") { model.newTask(project: project.id) } }
                            }.disabled(model.blocked || model.isBusy)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        .navigationTitle("Track")
        .searchable(text: $model.search, prompt: "Search tasks")
        .toolbar { Button("New project…", systemImage: "folder.badge.plus") { model.editProject() }.disabled(model.blocked || model.isBusy) }
    }
}
```

```swift
import SwiftUI
import LibraryStore

struct ProjectTaskSheets: View {
    @Bindable var model: WorkspaceModel
    @State private var currencySearch = ""
    private var draft: Binding<EditorRoute> {
        Binding(get: { model.sheet! }, set: { model.sheet = $0 })
    }
    private var valid: Bool {
        guard let form = model.sheet, !NameKey.make(form.name).isEmpty, !form.name.contains("\0") else { return false }
        return form.kind == .task || RateInput.parse(form.rate) != nil
    }
    private func save() {
        guard let form = model.sheet else { return }
        if form.kind == .project, let rate = RateInput.parse(form.rate) {
            let first = form.isNew && model.snapshot?.projects.isEmpty == true
            model.submit(.saveProject(id: form.id, name: form.name, rate: rate, currency: form.currency,
                                      confirmedPreviousCurrency: form.currencyAccepted ? form.confirmCurrency : nil),
                         next: first ? .task(nil, project: form.id, parent: nil) : nil)
        } else if let projectID = form.projectID {
            if form.isNew { model.submit(.createTask(id: form.id, projectID: projectID, parentID: form.parentID, name: form.name)) }
            else { model.submit(.renameTask(id: form.id, name: form.name)) }
        }
    }
    var body: some View {
        if let form = model.sheet {
            ScrollView {
                Form {
                    Text(form.isNew ? "New \(form.kind == .project ? "project" : "task")" : "Edit \(form.kind == .project ? "project" : "task")").font(.headline)
                    TextField("Name", text: draft.name)
                    if form.kind == .project {
                        TextField("Hourly rate", text: draft.rate)
                        if RateInput.parse(form.rate) == nil { Text("Enter a nonnegative rate using your locale's decimal separator, without grouping.").foregroundStyle(.red) }
                        TextField("Find currency", text: $currencySearch)
                        Picker("Currency", selection: draft.currency) {
                            ForEach(Locale.commonISOCurrencyCodes.filter {
                                $0 == form.currency || currencySearch.isEmpty || $0.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(currencySearch)
                                    || (Locale.current.localizedString(forCurrencyCode: $0) ?? "").localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(currencySearch)
                            }.sorted(), id: \.self) { code in
                                Text("\(code) — \(Locale.current.localizedString(forCurrencyCode: code) ?? code)").tag(code)
                            }
                        }
                        Text("Changing this rate recalculates amounts for all previously tracked hours.")
                        Text("Changing currency relabels all project amounts; it does not convert the rate.")
                        if let previous = form.confirmCurrency {
                            Toggle("Relabel amounts from \(previous) to \(form.currency) without conversion", isOn: draft.currencyAccepted)
                        }
                        if !form.isNew, model.snapshot?.projects.first(where: { $0.id == form.id })?.isArchived == false {
                            Button("Archive project…", role: .destructive) { draft.wrappedValue.archiveRequested = true }
                            if form.archiveRequested {
                                Text("Archive this project? Historical time is preserved.")
                                Button("Confirm archive", role: .destructive) { model.submit(.setArchived(id: form.id, archived: true)) }.disabled(model.blocked)
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        if form.isNew {
                            Picker("Project", selection: Binding(get: { form.projectID! }, set: {
                                draft.wrappedValue.projectID = $0; draft.wrappedValue.parentID = nil
                            })) {
                                ForEach(model.projects.filter { !$0.isArchived }) { Text($0.name).tag($0.id) }
                            }
                            Picker("Parent", selection: draft.parentID) {
                                Text("No parent").tag(nil as UUID?)
                                ForEach((model.snapshot?.tasks ?? []).filter { $0.projectID == form.projectID }.sorted { $0.name < $1.name }) {
                                    Text(model.path(for: $0)).tag(Optional($0.id))
                                }
                            }
                        } else { Text("Project and parent cannot be changed.") }
                    }
                    if let error = model.error { Text(error).foregroundStyle(.red).textSelection(.enabled) }
                    if model.blocked {
                        Text("Library: " + model.libraryLocation).textSelection(.enabled)
                        Text("Copy your draft if needed, then quit and reopen. Inspect the saved state before re-entering anything; do not replay blindly. To restore a backup, quit all app instances and restore the entire library directory, including any journal, using Time Machine or Arq.").textSelection(.enabled)
                    }
                    HStack {
                        Button("Cancel") {
                            model.sheet = nil
                            if !model.blocked { model.error = nil }
                        }.keyboardShortcut(.cancelAction)
                        Spacer()
                        Button(form.isNew ? "Create" : "Save") { save() }
                            .keyboardShortcut(.defaultAction)
                            .disabled(model.blocked || !valid || (form.confirmCurrency != nil && !form.currencyAccepted))
                    }
                }.padding()
            }
            .frame(minWidth: 440, idealWidth: 500, minHeight: 320)
            .disabled(model.isBusy)
            .onChange(of: model.sheet?.currency) { _, _ in
                model.sheet?.currencyAccepted = false
                model.sheet?.confirmCurrency = nil
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## Phase 6: Global timer and lifecycle

### Overview

Timer, checkpoint, conservative sleep gating and durable quit; no migration or warning/review APIs. Requires Phase 5 committed.

### Changes Required:

#### 1. Sources/LibraryStore/Timer.swift

**File**: `Sources/LibraryStore/Timer.swift`
**Changes**: Create with the complete approved Phase 6 payload.
**Payload source**: Architecture → Staged replacements → Slice 6; CREATE.

```swift
import Foundation

public enum TimerCommand: Sendable {
    case start(taskID: UUID), stop, checkpoint, stopAtCheckpoint
}

public enum TimerError: Error, Equatable, Sendable, LocalizedError {
    case reviewRequired, missingTask, notALeaf, archivedProject, clockRollback
    public var errorDescription: String? {
        switch self {
        case .reviewRequired: "Time needs review; no uncertain gap was added."
        case .missingTask: "The task no longer exists."
        case .notALeaf: "Choose a leaf task to start."
        case .archivedProject: "Restore the project before starting its timer."
        case .clockRollback: "The clock moved behind saved time. Stop at the last saved checkpoint and review."
        }
    }
}

// A synchronous notification latch reaches storage before queued actor work resumes.
final class TimerGate: @unchecked Sendable {
    private let lock = NSLock()
    private var suspended = false
    private var generation: UInt64 = 0
    @discardableResult func suspend() -> UInt64 {
        lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }
        generation &+= 1
        suspended = true
        return generation
    }
    func currentGeneration() -> UInt64 { lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }; return generation }
    func reset(ifCurrent value: UInt64) {
        lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }
        if generation == value { suspended = false }
    }
    func sample(_ now: @Sendable () -> Int64) throws -> Int64 {
        lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }
        guard !suspended else { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
        return now()
    }
    func check() throws {
        lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }
        guard !suspended else { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
    }
}

extension Storage {
    // Process provenance is deliberately not reconstructed from persisted rows.
    func suspendTimer() throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
        timerNeedsReview = true
        return try snapshot()
    }

    func performTimer(_ command: TimerCommand, now: @Sendable () -> Int64 = {
        Int64(Date().timeIntervalSince1970.rounded(.down))
    }, fault: CommitFault = .none) throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
        let before = try snapshot()
        if let active = before.activeTimer, active.entryID != liveEntryID { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
        // Slice 6 cannot resolve any restored or pending sleep; Slice 10 owns that review.
        guard before.pendingSleepIntervals.isEmpty else { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
        let safeStop: Bool
        if case .stopAtCheckpoint = command { safeStop = true } else { safeStop = false }
        guard !timerNeedsReview || safeStop else { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
        do {
            let generation = timerGate.currentGeneration()
            let timestamp = safeStop ? before.activeTimer?.checkpointAt ?? 0 : try timerGate.sample(now)
            // Idempotent clicks and coalesced ticks do not create revisions.
            if case let .start(taskID) = command,
               before.entries.first(where: { $0.id == before.activeTimer?.entryID })?.taskID == taskID {
                if let active = before.activeTimer, timestamp < active.checkpointAt { throw TimerError.clockRollback }
                return before
            }
            if before.activeTimer == nil {
                switch command {
                case .stopAtCheckpoint: timerNeedsReview = false; timerGate.reset(ifCurrent: generation); return before
                case .stop, .checkpoint: return before
                case .start: break
                }
            }
            if let active = before.activeTimer, timestamp < active.checkpointAt { throw TimerError.clockRollback }
            if case .checkpoint = command, before.activeTimer?.checkpointAt == timestamp { return before }
            let result = try transact(fault: fault) { db, state in
                try applyTimerTransition(command, at: timestamp, db: db, state: state)
                return true
            }
            liveEntryID = result.snapshot.activeTimer?.entryID
            timerNeedsReview = false
            if safeStop { timerGate.reset(ifCurrent: generation) }
            return result.snapshot
        } catch {
            // Never extend through an interval after a failed save or reversed clock.
            timerNeedsReview = true
            throw error
        }
    }
}

// Shared by timer commands and atomic Create & Start; callers own gates and commit.
func applyTimerTransition(_ command: TimerCommand, at timestamp: Int64,
                          db: SQLConnection, state: LibrarySnapshot) throws {
    func key(_ id: UUID) -> SQLValue { .text(id.uuidString.lowercased()) }
if case let .start(taskID) = command {
    guard let task = state.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == taskID }),
          let project = state.projects.first(where: { $0.id == task.projectID }) else { throw TimerError.missingTask }
    guard !project.isArchived else { throw TimerError.archivedProject }
    guard !state.tasks.contains(where: { $0.parentTaskID == taskID }) else { throw TimerError.notALeaf }
    // Existing history can appear future-dated after clock rollback.
    guard !state.entries.contains(where: { $0.endAt.map { $0 > timestamp } ?? false }) else {
        throw TimerError.clockRollback
    }
}
if case .checkpoint = command {
    try db.run("UPDATE active_timer SET checkpoint_at=? WHERE id=1", [.integer(timestamp)])
} else {
    if let active = state.activeTimer, let entry = state.entries.first(where: { $0.id == active.entryID }) {
        try db.exec("DELETE FROM active_timer")
        if timestamp == entry.startAt {
            try db.run("DELETE FROM time_entries WHERE id=?", [key(entry.id)])
        } else {
            try db.run("UPDATE time_entries SET end_at=? WHERE id=?", [.integer(timestamp), key(entry.id)])
        }
    }
    if case let .start(taskID) = command {
        let id = UUID()
        try db.run("INSERT INTO time_entries VALUES (?,?,?,NULL)", [key(id), key(taskID), .integer(timestamp)])
        try db.run("INSERT INTO active_timer VALUES (1,?,?)", [key(id), .integer(timestamp)])
    }
}
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import Testing
@testable import LibraryStore

private func timerStore() async throws -> (Storage, URL, UUID, UUID, UUID) {
    let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
    let store = try Recovery.open(at: root)
    let p = UUID(), a = UUID(), b = UUID()
    _ = try await store.perform(.saveProject(id: p, name: "Client", rate: 10, currency: "EUR", confirmedPreviousCurrency: nil))
    for (id, name) in [(a, "A"), (b, "B")] {
        _ = try await store.perform(.createTask(id: id, projectID: p, parentID: nil, name: name))
    }
    return (store, root, p, a, b)
}

@Test func timerIdempotenceAtomicSwitchAndSameSecondDeletion() async throws {
    let (store, root, _, a, b) = try await timerStore()
    defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
    let start = try await store.performTimer(.start(taskID: a), now: { 100 })
    #expect(try await store.performTimer(.start(taskID: a), now: { 105 }) == start)
    let tick = try await store.performTimer(.checkpoint, now: { 110 })
    #expect(tick.activeTimer?.checkpointAt == 110)
    #expect(try await store.performTimer(.checkpoint, now: { 110 }) == tick)
    let switched = try await store.performTimer(.start(taskID: b), now: { 120 })
    #expect(switched.entries.first(where: { $0.taskID == a })?.endAt == 120)
    #expect(switched.entries.first(where: { $0.taskID == b })?.startAt == 120)
    #expect(switched.revision == tick.revision + 1)
    let stopped = try await store.performTimer(.stop, now: { 120 })
    #expect(stopped.activeTimer == nil && stopped.entries.count == 1)
    #expect(try await store.performTimer(.stop, now: { 130 }) == stopped)
    await store.close()
}

@Test func timerRollbackAndSleepNeverExtendUnknownGaps() async throws {
    let (store, root, _, a, _) = try await timerStore()
    defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
    _ = try await store.performTimer(.start(taskID: a), now: { 100 })
    let saved = try await store.performTimer(.checkpoint, now: { 110 })
    await #expect(throws: TimerError.clockRollback) { try await store.performTimer(.checkpoint, now: { 109 }) }
    #expect(try await store.snapshot() == saved)
    await #expect(throws: TimerError.reviewRequired) { try await store.performTimer(.stop, now: { 200 }) }
    let stopped = try await store.performTimer(.stopAtCheckpoint, now: { 999 })
    #expect(stopped.entries[0].endAt == 110)
    await #expect(throws: TimerError.clockRollback) { try await store.performTimer(.start(taskID: a), now: { 105 }) }
    _ = try await store.performTimer(.stopAtCheckpoint)
    _ = try await store.performTimer(.start(taskID: a), now: { 120 })
    _ = try await store.suspendTimer()
    await #expect(throws: TimerError.reviewRequired) { try await store.performTimer(.checkpoint, now: { 900 }) }
    let emptyTail = try await store.performTimer(.stopAtCheckpoint)

}
```

```swift
import AppKit
import LibraryStore

@MainActor final class AppDelegate: NSObject, NSApplicationDelegate {
    var model: WorkspaceModel?
    private var checkpointTimer: Timer?
    func applicationDidFinishLaunching(_ notification: Notification) {
        // Under normal awake scheduling 15 seconds stays below the 30-second bound.
        checkpointTimer = Timer(timeInterval: 15, repeats: true) { [weak self] _ in
            Task { @MainActor in self?.model?.checkpoint() }
        }
        if let checkpointTimer { RunLoop.main.add(checkpointTimer, forMode: .common) }
        NSWorkspace.shared.notificationCenter.addObserver(self, selector: #selector(willSleep), name: NSWorkspace.willSleepNotification, object: nil)
    }
    @objc private func willSleep(_ notification: Notification) {
        model?.suspendForSleep()
    }
    func applicationShouldTerminateAfterLastWindowClosed(_ sender: NSApplication) -> Bool { false }
    func applicationShouldTerminate(_ sender: NSApplication) -> NSApplication.TerminateReply {
        guard let model else { return .terminateCancel }
        model.requestQuit { sender.reply(toApplicationShouldTerminate: $0) }
        return .terminateLater
    }
    func applicationWillTerminate(_ notification: Notification) {
        checkpointTimer?.invalidate()
        NSWorkspace.shared.notificationCenter.removeObserver(self)
    }
}

extension WorkspaceModel {
    func confirmQuitPreservingRestoredTimer() -> Bool {
        let alert = NSAlert()
        alert.messageText = "Time still needs review"
        alert.informativeText = "Quit without resolving this restored timer? Its saved state remains unchanged for later review."
        alert.addButton(withTitle: "Cancel")
        alert.addButton(withTitle: "Quit Without Resolving")
        return alert.runModal() == .alertSecondButtonReturn
    }
    func confirmQuit() -> Bool {
        let alert = NSAlert()
        alert.messageText = "Quitting will stop time tracking"
        alert.informativeText = blocked ? "Time requires review. Normal quit cannot save it; cancel and inspect the library error." : timerPaused ? "Only time through the last saved checkpoint will be kept; no paused gap is added." : "Stop and save the running entry before quitting."
        alert.addButton(withTitle: "Cancel")
        alert.addButton(withTitle: "Stop & Quit")
        return alert.runModal() == .alertSecondButtonReturn
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import SQLite3
import Darwin

// Internal storage errors; applications open authoritative libraries through Library.
enum StorageError: Error, Equatable {
    case sqlite(Int32, String)
    case invalidStorage(String)
    case unsupportedSchema(Int64)
    case revisionOverflow
    case commitIndeterminate
    case unavailable
    case injectedFailure
}

struct Committed<Value: Sendable>: Sendable {
    let value: Value
    let snapshot: LibrarySnapshot
}

enum CommitFault: Sendable { case none, beforeCommit, commitRejected, acknowledgementLost }

private let transient = unsafeBitCast(-1, to: sqlite3_destructor_type.self)

final class SQLConnection {
    private var db: OpaquePointer?
    var lease: LibraryLease?

    init(privatePath: String) throws {
        var opened: OpaquePointer?
        let rc = sqlite3_open_v2(privatePath, &opened, SQLITE_OPEN_READWRITE | SQLITE_OPEN_NOMUTEX, nil)
        guard rc == SQLITE_OK, let opened else {
            let message = opened.map { String(cString: sqlite3_errmsg($0)) } ?? "cannot open database"
            if let opened { sqlite3_close_v2(opened) }
            throw StorageError.sqlite(rc, message)
        }
        db = opened
        sqlite3_extended_result_codes(opened, 1)
    }

    deinit { close() }
    func close() { if let db { sqlite3_close_v2(db); self.db = nil } }
    var autocommit: Bool { db.map { sqlite3_get_autocommit($0) != 0 } ?? true }
    fileprivate func allowOnlyCommandDML(_ enabled: Bool) throws {
        let db = try handle()
        let rc: Int32
        if !enabled {
            rc = sqlite3_set_authorizer(db, nil, nil)
        } else {
            rc = sqlite3_set_authorizer(db, { _, action, _, _, _, _ in
                switch action {
                case SQLITE_SELECT, SQLITE_READ, SQLITE_INSERT, SQLITE_UPDATE, SQLITE_DELETE,
                     SQLITE_FUNCTION, SQLITE_RECURSIVE: return SQLITE_OK
                default: return SQLITE_DENY
                }
            }, nil)
        }
        guard rc == SQLITE_OK else { throw failure(rc) }
    }
    private func handle() throws -> OpaquePointer { guard let db else { throw StorageError.unavailable }; return db }
    private func failure(_ rc: Int32) -> StorageError {
        .sqlite(rc, db.map { String(cString: sqlite3_errmsg($0)) } ?? "closed")
    }
    func exec(_ sql: String) throws {
        let db = try handle()
        let rc = sqlite3_exec(db, sql, nil, nil, nil)
        guard rc == SQLITE_OK else { throw failure(rc) }
    }
    func rows<T>(_ sql: String, _ body: (OpaquePointer) throws -> T) throws -> [T] {
        let db = try handle()
        var statement: OpaquePointer?
        let rc = sqlite3_prepare_v2(db, sql, -1, &statement, nil)
        guard rc == SQLITE_OK, let statement else { throw failure(rc) }
        defer { sqlite3_finalize(statement) }
        var values: [T] = []
        while true {
            let step = sqlite3_step(statement)
            if step == SQLITE_DONE { return values }
            guard step == SQLITE_ROW else { throw failure(step) }
            values.append(try body(statement))
        }
    }
    func run(_ sql: String, _ bindings: [SQLValue]) throws {
        let db = try handle()
        var statement: OpaquePointer?
        let rc = sqlite3_prepare_v2(db, sql, -1, &statement, nil)
        guard rc == SQLITE_OK, let statement else { throw failure(rc) }
        defer { sqlite3_finalize(statement) }
        guard sqlite3_bind_parameter_count(statement) == Int32(bindings.count) else {
            throw StorageError.invalidStorage("binding count")
        }
        for (offset, value) in bindings.enumerated() {
            let i = Int32(offset + 1)
            let result: Int32
            switch value {
            case .null: result = sqlite3_bind_null(statement, i)
            case .integer(let n): result = sqlite3_bind_int64(statement, i, n)
            case .text(let text):
                guard !text.contains("\0"), text.utf8.count <= Int(Int32.max) else {
                    throw StorageError.invalidStorage("invalid bound text")
                }
                result = text.withCString { sqlite3_bind_text(statement, i, $0, Int32(text.utf8.count), transient) }
            }
            guard result == SQLITE_OK else { throw failure(result) }
        }
        let step = sqlite3_step(statement)
        guard step == SQLITE_DONE else { throw failure(step) }
    }
}

enum SQLValue { case null, integer(Int64), text(String) }

private func integer(_ s: OpaquePointer, _ i: Int32) throws -> Int64 {
    guard sqlite3_column_type(s, i) == SQLITE_INTEGER else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("expected integer") }
    return sqlite3_column_int64(s, i)
}
private func text(_ s: OpaquePointer, _ i: Int32) throws -> String {
    guard sqlite3_column_type(s, i) == SQLITE_TEXT, let p = sqlite3_column_text(s, i) else {
        throw StorageError.invalidStorage("expected text")
    }
    let bytes = UnsafeBufferPointer(start: p, count: Int(sqlite3_column_bytes(s, i)))
    guard let value = String(bytes: bytes, encoding: .utf8), !value.contains("\0") else {
        throw StorageError.invalidStorage("invalid text")
    }
    return value
}
private func optionalInteger(_ s: OpaquePointer, _ i: Int32) throws -> Int64? {
    sqlite3_column_type(s, i) == SQLITE_NULL ? nil : try integer(s, i)
}
private func uuid(_ s: OpaquePointer, _ i: Int32) throws -> UUID {
    let raw = try text(s, i)
    guard let value = UUID(uuidString: raw), value.uuidString.lowercased() == raw else {
        throw StorageError.invalidStorage("noncanonical UUID")
    }
    return value
}
private func optionalUUID(_ s: OpaquePointer, _ i: Int32) throws -> UUID? {
    sqlite3_column_type(s, i) == SQLITE_NULL ? nil : try uuid(s, i)
}

// NSDecimalString produces a non-exponent, locale-independent, exact canonical form.
func canonicalRate(_ rate: Decimal) throws -> String {
    guard !rate.isNaN, rate >= 0 else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("invalid rate") }
    var value = rate
    return NSDecimalString(&value, Locale(identifier: "en_US_POSIX"))
}
private func rate(_ s: OpaquePointer, _ i: Int32) throws -> Decimal {
    let raw = try text(s, i)
    guard let parsed = Decimal(string: raw, locale: Locale(identifier: "en_US_POSIX")),
          try canonicalRate(parsed) == raw else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("noncanonical rate") }
    return parsed
}

// Exact CREATE statements make the greenfield schema an explicit allowlist, including
// constraints and indexes; unknown triggers, views, or schema variations fail closed.
private let schema: [(String, String, String)] = [
    ("table", "library_metadata", "CREATE TABLE library_metadata (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (schema_version >= 1), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision >= 0))"),
    ("table", "projects", "CREATE TABLE projects (id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), hourly_rate TEXT NOT NULL, currency_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(currency_code) = 3), is_archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_archived IN (0, 1)))"),
    ("table", "tasks", "CREATE TABLE tasks (id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, parent_task_id TEXT, name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), budget_seconds INTEGER CHECK (budget_seconds > 0), last_warned_threshold INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (last_warned_threshold IN (0, 80, 100)), UNIQUE (id, project_id), FOREIGN KEY (parent_task_id, project_id) REFERENCES tasks(id, project_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, CHECK (parent_task_id IS NULL OR parent_task_id <> id))"),
    ("table", "time_entries", "CREATE TABLE time_entries (id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, start_at INTEGER NOT NULL, end_at INTEGER, CHECK (end_at IS NULL OR end_at > start_at))"),
    ("table", "active_timer", "CREATE TABLE active_timer (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), entry_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES time_entries(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, checkpoint_at INTEGER NOT NULL)"),
    ("table", "pending_sleep_intervals", "CREATE TABLE pending_sleep_intervals (id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, sleep_at INTEGER NOT NULL, wake_at INTEGER, CHECK (wake_at IS NULL OR wake_at > sleep_at))"),
    ("index", "tasks_by_parent", "CREATE INDEX tasks_by_parent ON tasks(project_id, parent_task_id)"),
    ("index", "entries_by_task_start", "CREATE INDEX entries_by_task_start ON time_entries(task_id, start_at)"),
    ("index", "entries_by_start", "CREATE INDEX entries_by_start ON time_entries(start_at)"),
    ("index", "one_open_entry", "CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_open_entry ON time_entries((1)) WHERE end_at IS NULL"),
    ("index", "sleep_by_task", "CREATE INDEX sleep_by_task ON pending_sleep_intervals(task_id)"),
    ("index", "one_unknown_wake", "CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_unknown_wake ON pending_sleep_intervals((1)) WHERE wake_at IS NULL")
]

private func checkSchema(_ db: SQLConnection) throws {
    let actual = try db.rows("SELECT type, name, sql FROM sqlite_schema WHERE sql IS NOT NULL ORDER BY type, name") {
        try [text($0, 0), text($0, 1), text($0, 2)]
    }
    let expected = schema.map { [$0.0, $0.1, $0.2] }.sorted { ($0[0], $0[1]) < ($1[0], $1[1]) }
    guard actual == expected else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("schema shape") }
}
private func configure(_ db: SQLConnection) throws {
    guard sqlite3_libversion_number() >= 3_009_000 else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("SQLite runtime too old") }
    try db.exec("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
    let journal = try db.rows("PRAGMA journal_mode=DELETE") { try text($0, 0) }
    try db.exec("PRAGMA synchronous=FULL")
    try db.exec("PRAGMA fullfsync=ON")
    let foreign = try db.rows("PRAGMA foreign_keys") { try integer($0, 0) }
    let synchronous = try db.rows("PRAGMA synchronous") { try integer($0, 0) }
    let flush = try db.rows("PRAGMA fullfsync") { try integer($0, 0) }
    guard journal == ["delete"], foreign == [1], synchronous == [2], flush == [1] else {
        throw StorageError.invalidStorage("required SQLite settings unavailable")
    }
}
private func checkIntegrity(_ db: SQLConnection) throws {
    let integrity = try db.rows("PRAGMA integrity_check") { try text($0, 0) }
    guard integrity == ["ok"] else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("integrity_check") }
    let foreign = try db.rows("PRAGMA foreign_key_check") { _ in true }
    guard foreign.isEmpty else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("foreign_key_check") }
}
func decodeSnapshot(_ db: SQLConnection) throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
    let meta = try db.rows("SELECT id, schema_version, revision FROM library_metadata") {
        try (integer($0, 0), integer($0, 1), integer($0, 2))
    }
    guard meta.count == 1, meta[0].0 == 1 else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("metadata singleton") }
    guard meta[0].1 == 1 else { throw StorageError.unsupportedSchema(meta[0].1) }
    let projects = try db.rows("SELECT id, name, hourly_rate, currency_code, is_archived FROM projects ORDER BY id") { s in
        let flag = try integer(s, 4)
        guard flag == 0 || flag == 1 else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("boolean") }
        return try Project(id: uuid(s, 0), name: text(s, 1), hourlyRate: rate(s, 2), currencyCode: text(s, 3), isArchived: flag == 1)
    }
    let tasks = try db.rows("SELECT id, project_id, parent_task_id, name, budget_seconds, last_warned_threshold FROM tasks ORDER BY id") { s in
        guard let warning = WarningThreshold(rawValue: try integer(s, 5)) else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("warning") }
        return try TaskRecord(id: uuid(s, 0), projectID: uuid(s, 1), parentTaskID: optionalUUID(s, 2), name: text(s, 3), budgetSeconds: optionalInteger(s, 4), lastWarnedThreshold: warning)
    }
    let entries = try db.rows("SELECT id, task_id, start_at, end_at FROM time_entries ORDER BY id") { s in
        try TimeEntry(id: uuid(s, 0), taskID: uuid(s, 1), startAt: integer(s, 2), endAt: optionalInteger(s, 3))
    }
    let timers = try db.rows("SELECT id, entry_id, checkpoint_at FROM active_timer") { s in
        try (integer(s, 0), ActiveTimer(entryID: uuid(s, 1), checkpointAt: integer(s, 2)))
    }
    guard timers.count <= 1, timers.first.map({ $0.0 == 1 }) ?? true else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("timer singleton") }
    let pending = try db.rows("SELECT id, task_id, sleep_at, wake_at FROM pending_sleep_intervals ORDER BY id") { s in
        try PendingSleepInterval(id: uuid(s, 0), taskID: uuid(s, 1), sleepAt: integer(s, 2), wakeAt: optionalInteger(s, 3))
    }
    let snapshot = LibrarySnapshot(schemaVersion: meta[0].1, revision: meta[0].2, projects: projects, tasks: tasks, entries: entries, activeTimer: timers.first?.1, pendingSleepIntervals: pending)
    return snapshot
}

func load(_ db: SQLConnection) throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
    let snapshot = try decodeSnapshot(db)
    try SnapshotValidator.validate(snapshot)
    return snapshot
}

func checkPrivateDatabase(_ db: SQLConnection) throws {
    try checkSchema(db)
    try configure(db)
    try checkIntegrity(db)
    _ = try load(db)
}

// Internal initializer: callers supply a private working database, or an authoritative
// database only after Recovery validates and installs it under the retained lease.
actor Storage {
    private let connection: SQLConnection
    private let privateDatabasePath: String
    private var poisoned = false
    nonisolated let timerGate = TimerGate()
    var liveEntryID: UUID?
    var timerNeedsReview = false

    init(privateDatabaseAt url: URL, lease: LibraryLease? = nil) throws {
        let db = try SQLConnection(privatePath: url.path)
        try checkSchema(db)
        try configure(db)
        try checkIntegrity(db)
        _ = try load(db)
        connection = db
        privateDatabasePath = url.path
        db.lease = lease
    }

    // Only isolated test/working paths: creation requires a genuinely absent file.
    static func createPrivateDatabase(at url: URL) throws {
        let fd = open(url.path, O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_WRONLY, S_IRUSR | S_IWUSR)
        guard fd >= 0 else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("cannot exclusively create private database") }
        Darwin.close(fd)
        let db = try SQLConnection(privatePath: url.path)
        try configure(db)
        try db.exec("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        do {
            for (_, _, statement) in schema { try db.exec(statement) }
            try db.exec("INSERT INTO library_metadata (id, schema_version, revision) VALUES (1, 1, 0)")
            try db.exec("COMMIT")
        } catch {
            try? db.exec("ROLLBACK")
            throw error
        }
    }

    func close() {
        poisoned = true
        connection.close()
        connection.lease = nil
    }

    func snapshot() throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
        guard !poisoned else { throw StorageError.unavailable }
        return try load(connection)
    }

    // Internal only; commands must leave the complete snapshot structurally valid.
    // No await occurs between BEGIN and COMMIT; no public raw-SQL surface is exported.
    func transact<Value: Sendable>(fault: CommitFault = .none,
        _ apply: @Sendable (SQLConnection, LibrarySnapshot) throws -> Value) throws -> Committed<Value> {
        guard !poisoned else { throw StorageError.unavailable }
        try connection.exec("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        var commitStarted = false
        do {
            let before = try load(connection)
            guard before.revision < .max else { throw StorageError.revisionOverflow }
            try connection.allowOnlyCommandDML(true)
            let value: Value
            do {
                value = try apply(connection, before)
            }
            catch {
                try connection.allowOnlyCommandDML(false)
                throw error
            }
            try connection.allowOnlyCommandDML(false)
            guard !connection.autocommit else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("command ended transaction") }
            // Commands cannot alter metadata; the store alone owns revision changes.
            let interim = try load(connection)
            guard interim.schemaVersion == before.schemaVersion, interim.revision == before.revision else {
                throw StorageError.invalidStorage("command changed metadata")
            }
            try connection.run("UPDATE library_metadata SET revision = ? WHERE id = 1 AND revision = ?", [.integer(before.revision + 1), .integer(before.revision)])
            let after = try load(connection)
            guard after.revision == before.revision + 1 else { throw StorageError.invalidStorage("revision update") }
            if fault == .beforeCommit { throw StorageError.injectedFailure }
            // A separate reader produces a real SQLITE_BUSY from COMMIT in tests.
            let blocker: SQLConnection?
            if fault == .commitRejected {
                let reader = try SQLConnection(privatePath: privateDatabasePath)
                try reader.exec("BEGIN")
                _ = try reader.rows("SELECT revision FROM library_metadata") { _ in true }
                blocker = reader
            } else { blocker = nil }
            defer { blocker?.close() }
            commitStarted = true
            try connection.exec("COMMIT")
            if fault == .acknowledgementLost { throw StorageError.injectedFailure }
            return Committed(value: value, snapshot: after)
        } catch {
            if !connection.autocommit {
                do { try connection.exec("ROLLBACK") }
                catch { poisoned = true; connection.close(); throw StorageError.commitIndeterminate }
                throw error
            }
            if commitStarted {
                poisoned = true
                connection.close()
                throw StorageError.commitIndeterminate
            }
            throw error
        }
    }
}
```
