```swift
    private static func status(_ url: URL) throws -> stat? {
        var result = stat()
        if lstat(url.path, &result) == 0 { return result }
        if errno == ENOENT { return nil }
        throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("stat \(url.lastPathComponent)", errno)
    }

        guard let result = try status(url) else { return false }
        guard (result.st_mode & S_IFMT) == S_IFREG, result.st_nlink == 1 else {

                guard !hasJournal, try (!exists || same(db, candidate)) else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("creation conflict") }
            } else {
                guard try regular(originalDB), exists,
                      try (same(db, originalDB) || same(db, candidate)) else {
                    throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("main generation conflict")
                }
                if state == "existing+journal\n" {
                    guard try regular(originalJournal) else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("missing original journal") }
                    if hasJournal, !(try same(jrnl, originalJournal)) { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("journal generation conflict") }
                    if hasJournal, !(try same(db, originalDB)) { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("new main paired with old journal") }
                } else if hasJournal { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("unexpected journal") }
            }
            // Validate a copy, never mutate the immutable candidate while ready is present.
            let check = child(workspace, "check")
            try remove(check); try makeDirectory(check)
            let checkDB = child(check, main)
            try copy(candidate, checkDB); try validate(checkDB)
            if hasJournal { try remove(jrnl); try sync(root, directory: true) }
            try crashPoint(.journalRetired, fault)
            try remove(publishURL)
            try copy(candidate, publishURL)
            try crashPoint(.publicationCopied, fault)
            guard rename(publishURL.path, db.path) == 0 else { throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("publish", errno) }
            try sync(root, directory: true)
            try crashPoint(.published, fault)
            guard try same(db, candidate) else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("published database mismatch") }
            try remove(intentURL); try sync(root, directory: true)
            try crashPoint(.intentRemoved, fault)
            try remove(readyURL); try sync(root, directory: true)
            try crashPoint(.readyRemoved, fault)
            // The validated canonical file is now authorized for SQLite writes.
            return try Storage(privateDatabaseAt: db, lease: lease)
        }

        if let state = try marker(readyURL) { return try install(state) }

        let sourceExists = try regular(db), journalExists = try regular(jrnl)
        guard sourceExists || !journalExists else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("orphan journal") }
        if let prior = try marker(intentURL) {
            guard prior == "create\n" || prior == "existing\n" else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("unknown intent") }
            guard (prior == "existing\n") == sourceExists else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("intent conflicts with library") }
        } else {
            // Without an intent, an orphan workspace plus missing main could contain
            // the only surviving data: never silently initialize over it.
            guard try (sourceExists || status(workspace) == nil) else { throw LibraryOpenError.unsafeState("orphan recovery workspace") }
            let temporary = child(root, intentTemp)
            try remove(temporary)
            try writeMarker(sourceExists ? "existing\n" : "create\n", at: temporary)
            guard rename(temporary.path, intentURL.path) == 0 else { throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("publish intent", errno) }
            try sync(root, directory: true)
        }
        try crashPoint(.intent, fault)
        try remove(workspace); try remove(tempURL); try remove(publishURL)
        try sync(root, directory: true)
        try makeDirectory(workspace); try makeDirectory(original); try makeDirectory(candidateDir)
        if sourceExists {
            try copy(db, originalDB)
            if journalExists { try copy(jrnl, originalJournal) }
        }
        try crashPoint(.copiedOriginal, fault)
        if sourceExists {
            try copy(originalDB, candidate)
            if journalExists { try copy(originalJournal, child(candidateDir, journal)) }
        } else {
            try Storage.createPrivateDatabase(at: candidate)
        }
        try crashPoint(.copiedWorking, fault)
        try validate(candidate)
        try crashPoint(.validated, fault)
        try sync(original, directory: true); try sync(candidateDir, directory: true)
        try sync(workspace, directory: true)
        let state = sourceExists ? (journalExists ? "existing+journal\n" : "existing\n") : "create\n"
        let record = state + (try digest(candidate)) + "\n" + (sourceExists ? try digest(originalDB) : "-") + "\n" + (journalExists ? try digest(originalJournal) : "-") + "\n"
        try writeMarker(record, at: tempURL)
        guard rename(tempURL.path, readyURL.path) == 0 else { throw LibraryOpenError.filesystem("publish ready marker", errno) }
        try sync(root, directory: true)
        try crashPoint(.ready, fault)
        return try install(record)
    }
}

public actor Library {
    private let storage: Storage
    private init(storage: Storage) { self.storage = storage }
    public static func open(at directory: URL) throws -> Library { Library(storage: try Recovery.open(at: directory)) }
    public func snapshot() async throws -> LibrarySnapshot { try await storage.snapshot() }
    public func perform(_ command: WorkspaceCommand) async throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
        try await storage.perform(command).snapshot
    }
    public func performTimer(_ command: TimerCommand) async throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
        try await storage.performTimer(command)
    }
    // Called synchronously from the sleep notification so queued intents fail closed.
    public nonisolated func signalSleep() { storage.timerGate.suspend() }
    public func suspendTimer() async throws -> LibrarySnapshot { try await storage.suspendTimer() }
    public func createTask(id: UUID, projectID: UUID, parentID: UUID?, name: String,
                           confirmMigration: Bool, start: Bool) async throws -> TaskCreation {
        try await storage.createTask(id: id, projectID: projectID, parentID: parentID, name: name,
                                     confirmMigration: confirmMigration, start: start)
    }
    public func undoTaskMigration() async throws -> LibrarySnapshot { try await storage.undoTaskMigration() }
}

extension Library {
    public func close() async { await storage.close() }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation

public enum TimerCommand: Sendable {
    case start(taskID: UUID), stop, checkpoint, stopAtCheckpoint
}

public enum TimerError: Error, Equatable, Sendable, LocalizedError {
    case reviewRequired, missingTask, notALeaf, archivedProject, clockRollback
    public var errorDescription: String? {
        switch self {
        case .reviewRequired: "Time needs review; no uncertain gap was added."
        case .missingTask: "The task no longer exists."
        case .notALeaf: "Choose a leaf task to start."
        case .archivedProject: "Restore the project before starting its timer."
        case .clockRollback: "The clock moved behind saved time. Stop at the last saved checkpoint and review."
        }
    }
}

// A synchronous notification latch reaches storage before queued actor work resumes.
final class TimerGate: @unchecked Sendable {
    private let lock = NSLock()
    private var suspended = false
    private var generation: UInt64 = 0
    @discardableResult func suspend() -> UInt64 {
        lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }
        generation &+= 1
        suspended = true
        return generation
    }
    func currentGeneration() -> UInt64 { lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }; return generation }
    func reset(ifCurrent value: UInt64) {
        lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }
        if generation == value { suspended = false }
    }
    func sample(_ now: @Sendable () -> Int64) throws -> Int64 {
        lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }
        guard !suspended else { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
        return now()
    }
    func check() throws {
        lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }
        guard !suspended else { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
    }
}

extension Storage {
    // Process provenance is deliberately not reconstructed from persisted rows.
    func suspendTimer() throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
        timerNeedsReview = true
        return try snapshot()
    }

    func performTimer(_ command: TimerCommand, now: @Sendable () -> Int64 = {
        Int64(Date().timeIntervalSince1970.rounded(.down))
    }, fault: CommitFault = .none) throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
        let before = try snapshot()
        if let active = before.activeTimer, active.entryID != liveEntryID { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
        // Slice 6 cannot resolve any restored or pending sleep; Slice 10 owns that review.
        guard before.pendingSleepIntervals.isEmpty else { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
        let safeStop: Bool
        if case .stopAtCheckpoint = command { safeStop = true } else { safeStop = false }
        guard !timerNeedsReview || safeStop else { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
        do {
            let generation = timerGate.currentGeneration()
            let timestamp = safeStop ? before.activeTimer?.checkpointAt ?? 0 : try timerGate.sample(now)
            // Idempotent clicks and coalesced ticks do not create revisions.
            if case let .start(taskID) = command,
               before.entries.first(where: { $0.id == before.activeTimer?.entryID })?.taskID == taskID {
                if let active = before.activeTimer, timestamp < active.checkpointAt { throw TimerError.clockRollback }
                return before
            }
            if before.activeTimer == nil {
                switch command {
                case .stopAtCheckpoint: timerNeedsReview = false; timerGate.reset(ifCurrent: generation); return before
                case .stop, .checkpoint: return before
                case .start: break
                }
            }
            if let active = before.activeTimer, timestamp < active.checkpointAt { throw TimerError.clockRollback }
            if case .checkpoint = command, before.activeTimer?.checkpointAt == timestamp { return before }
            let result = try transact(fault: fault) { db, state in
                try applyTimerTransition(command, at: timestamp, db: db, state: state)
                return true
            }
            liveEntryID = result.snapshot.activeTimer?.entryID
            timerNeedsReview = false
            if safeStop { timerGate.reset(ifCurrent: generation) }
            return result.snapshot
        } catch {
            // Never extend through an interval after a failed save or reversed clock.
            timerNeedsReview = true
            throw error
        }
    }
}

// Shared by timer commands and atomic Create & Start; callers own gates and commit.
func applyTimerTransition(_ command: TimerCommand, at timestamp: Int64,
                          db: SQLConnection, state: LibrarySnapshot) throws {
    func key(_ id: UUID) -> SQLValue { .text(id.uuidString.lowercased()) }
if case let .start(taskID) = command {
    guard let task = state.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == taskID }),
          let project = state.projects.first(where: { $0.id == task.projectID }) else { throw TimerError.missingTask }
    guard !project.isArchived else { throw TimerError.archivedProject }
    guard !state.tasks.contains(where: { $0.parentTaskID == taskID }) else { throw TimerError.notALeaf }
    // Existing history can appear future-dated after clock rollback.
    guard !state.entries.contains(where: { $0.endAt.map { $0 > timestamp } ?? false }) else {
        throw TimerError.clockRollback
    }
}
if case .checkpoint = command {
    try db.run("UPDATE active_timer SET checkpoint_at=? WHERE id=1", [.integer(timestamp)])
} else {
    if let active = state.activeTimer, let entry = state.entries.first(where: { $0.id == active.entryID }) {
        try db.exec("DELETE FROM active_timer")
        if timestamp == entry.startAt {
            try db.run("DELETE FROM time_entries WHERE id=?", [key(entry.id)])
        } else {
            try db.run("UPDATE time_entries SET end_at=? WHERE id=?", [.integer(timestamp), key(entry.id)])
        }
    }
    if case let .start(taskID) = command {
        let id = UUID()
        try db.run("INSERT INTO time_entries VALUES (?,?,?,NULL)", [key(id), key(taskID), .integer(timestamp)])
        try db.run("INSERT INTO active_timer VALUES (1,?,?)", [key(id), .integer(timestamp)])
    }
}
}
```

```swift
import SwiftUI
import LibraryStore

struct ProjectTaskSheets: View {
    @Bindable var model: WorkspaceModel
    @State private var currencySearch = ""
    private var draft: Binding<EditorRoute> {
        Binding(get: { model.sheet! }, set: { model.sheet = $0 })
    }
    private var valid: Bool {
        guard let form = model.sheet, !NameKey.make(form.name).isEmpty, !form.name.contains("\0") else { return false }
        return form.kind == .task || RateInput.parse(form.rate) != nil
    }
    private var needsMigration: Bool {
        guard let form = model.sheet, form.isNew, let parent = form.parentID else { return false }
        return model.snapshot?.entries.contains { $0.taskID == parent } == true ||
            model.snapshot?.pendingSleepIntervals.contains { $0.taskID == parent } == true
    }
    private var taskReady: Bool {
        !needsMigration || (model.sheet?.migrationAccepted == true && NameKey.make(model.sheet?.name ?? "") != NameKey.make("Generic"))
    }
    private func save() {
        guard let form = model.sheet else { return }
        if form.kind == .project, let rate = RateInput.parse(form.rate) {
            let first = form.isNew && model.snapshot?.projects.isEmpty == true
            model.submit(.saveProject(id: form.id, name: form.name, rate: rate, currency: form.currency,
                                      confirmedPreviousCurrency: form.currencyAccepted ? form.confirmCurrency : nil),
                         next: first ? .task(nil, project: form.id, parent: nil) : nil)
        } else if form.projectID != nil {
            if form.isNew { model.createTask(start: false) }
            else { model.submit(.renameTask(id: form.id, name: form.name)) }
        }
    }
    var body: some View {
        if let form = model.sheet {
            ScrollView {
                Form {
                    Text(form.isNew ? "New \(form.kind == .project ? "project" : "task")" : "Edit \(form.kind == .project ? "project" : "task")").font(.headline)
                    TextField("Name", text: draft.name)
                    if form.kind == .project {
                        TextField("Hourly rate", text: draft.rate)
                        if RateInput.parse(form.rate) == nil { Text("Enter a nonnegative rate using your locale's decimal separator, without grouping.").foregroundStyle(.red) }
                        TextField("Find currency", text: $currencySearch)
                        Picker("Currency", selection: draft.currency) {
                            ForEach(Locale.commonISOCurrencyCodes.filter {
                                $0 == form.currency || currencySearch.isEmpty || $0.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(currencySearch)
                                    || (Locale.current.localizedString(forCurrencyCode: $0) ?? "").localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(currencySearch)
                            }.sorted(), id: \.self) { code in
                                Text("\(code) — \(Locale.current.localizedString(forCurrencyCode: code) ?? code)").tag(code)
                            }
                        }
                        Text("Changing this rate recalculates amounts for all previously tracked hours.")
                        Text("Changing currency relabels all project amounts; it does not convert the rate.")
                        if let previous = form.confirmCurrency {
                            Toggle("Relabel amounts from \(previous) to \(form.currency) without conversion", isOn: draft.currencyAccepted)
                        }
                        if !form.isNew, model.snapshot?.projects.first(where: { $0.id == form.id })?.isArchived == false {
                            Button("Archive project…", role: .destructive) { draft.wrappedValue.archiveRequested = true }
                            if form.archiveRequested {
                                Text("Archive this project? Historical time is preserved.")
                                Button("Confirm archive", role: .destructive) { model.submit(.setArchived(id: form.id, archived: true)) }.disabled(model.blocked)
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        if form.isNew {
                            Picker("Project", selection: Binding(get: { form.projectID! }, set: {
                                draft.wrappedValue.projectID = $0; draft.wrappedValue.parentID = nil
                            })) {
                                ForEach(model.projects.filter { !$0.isArchived }) { Text($0.name).tag($0.id) }
                            }
                            Picker("Parent", selection: draft.parentID) {
                                Text("No parent").tag(nil as UUID?)
                                ForEach((model.snapshot?.tasks ?? []).filter { $0.projectID == form.projectID }.sorted { $0.name < $1.name }) {
                                    Text(model.path(for: $0)).tag(Optional($0.id))
                                }
                            }
                            if needsMigration {
                                Text("Existing entries and pending sleep will move to an ordinary, unbudgeted Generic child. The parent's total and budget stay unchanged; its running timer continues on Generic unless you choose Create & Start.")
                                Toggle("Move existing time to Generic", isOn: draft.migrationAccepted)
                                if NameKey.make(form.name) == NameKey.make("Generic") {
                                    Text("Choose another child name; Generic is needed for existing time.").foregroundStyle(.red)
                                }
                            }
                        } else { Text("Project and parent cannot be changed.") }
                    }
                    if let error = model.error { Text(error).foregroundStyle(.red).textSelection(.enabled) }
                    if model.blocked {
                        Text("Library: " + model.libraryLocation).textSelection(.enabled)
                        Text("Copy your draft if needed, then quit and reopen. Inspect the saved state before re-entering anything; do not replay blindly. To restore a backup, quit all app instances and restore the entire library directory, including any journal, using Time Machine or Arq.").textSelection(.enabled)
                    }
                    HStack {
                        Button("Cancel") {
                            model.sheet = nil
                            if !model.blocked { model.error = nil }
                        }.keyboardShortcut(.cancelAction)
                        Spacer()
                        if form.kind == .task && form.isNew {
                            Button("Create & Start") { model.createTask(start: true) }
                                .disabled(model.blocked || model.timerPaused || !valid || !taskReady)
                        }
                        Button(form.isNew ? "Create" : "Save") { save() }
                            .keyboardShortcut(.defaultAction)
                            .disabled(model.blocked || !valid || !taskReady || (form.confirmCurrency != nil && !form.currencyAccepted))
                    }
                }.padding()
            }
            .frame(minWidth: 440, idealWidth: 500, minHeight: 320)
            .disabled(model.isBusy)
            .onChange(of: model.sheet?.parentID) { _, _ in model.sheet?.migrationAccepted = false }
            .onChange(of: model.sheet?.currency) { _, _ in
                model.sheet?.currencyAccepted = false
                model.sheet?.confirmCurrency = nil
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import Observation
import AppKit
import LibraryStore

@MainActor @Observable final class WorkspaceModel {
    private(set) var snapshot: LibrarySnapshot?
    private(set) var isBusy = false
    private(set) var blocked = false
    private var uncertainSave = false
    private(set) var migrationMessage: String?
    private(set) var canUndoMigration = false
    var error: String?
    var sheet: EditorRoute?
    var showArchived = false
    var search = ""
    var selectedProject: UUID? {
        didSet { UserDefaults.standard.set(selectedProject?.uuidString, forKey: "selectedProject") }
    }
    private var library: Library?
    private(set) var timerPaused = false
    private(set) var terminating = false
    private(set) var sleepObserved = false
    private var sleepGeneration: UInt64 = 0
    private var checkpointQueued = false
    var runningEntry: TimeEntry? { snapshot?.entries.first { $0.id == snapshot?.activeTimer?.entryID } }
    var timerLabel: String {
        guard let entry = runningEntry,
              let task = snapshot?.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == entry.taskID }) else { return "Choose a task to start" }
        let project = snapshot?.projects.first(where: { $0.id == task.projectID })?.name ?? ""
        return project + " › " + path(for: task) + (timerPaused || blocked ? " — paused for review" : " — running")
    }
    func elapsed(at date: Date) -> String {
        guard let entry = runningEntry, let checkpoint = snapshot?.activeTimer?.checkpointAt else { return "00:00:00" }
        let end = timerPaused || blocked ? checkpoint : max(checkpoint, Int64(date.timeIntervalSince1970.rounded(.down)))
        let seconds = end.subtractingReportingOverflow(entry.startAt)
        guard !seconds.overflow else { return "Duration requires review" }
        return String(format: "%02lld:%02lld:%02lld", seconds.partialValue / 3600, seconds.partialValue % 3600 / 60, seconds.partialValue % 60)
    }
    var recentTasks: [TaskRecord] {
        guard let snapshot else { return [] }
        let ordered = snapshot.entries.sorted { $0.startAt > $1.startAt }.map(\.taskID)
        var seen = Set<UUID>()
        return ordered.compactMap { id in
            guard seen.insert(id).inserted,
                  let task = snapshot.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == id }),
                  !snapshot.tasks.contains(where: { $0.parentTaskID == id }),
                  snapshot.projects.contains(where: { $0.id == task.projectID && !$0.isArchived }) else { return nil }
            return task
        }.prefix(8).map { $0 }
    }
    private(set) var libraryLocation = "Application Support/UurtjeFactuurtje/library.sqlite (inside the app sandbox)"
    var canRetryOpen: Bool { library == nil && !isBusy }
    private var tail: Task<Void, Never>?
    private var queued = 0

    init() {
        selectedProject = UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: "selectedProject").flatMap(UUID.init(uuidString:))
        retryOpen()
    }

    func retryOpen() {
        guard library == nil else { return }
        enqueue { model in
            do {
                let directory = try FileManager.default.url(for: .applicationSupportDirectory, in: .userDomainMask,
                                                           appropriateFor: nil, create: true).appendingPathComponent("UurtjeFactuurtje", isDirectory: true)
                model.libraryLocation = directory.appendingPathComponent("library.sqlite").path
                let library = try await Task.detached {
                    try Library.open(at: directory)
                }.value
                model.library = library
                model.snapshot = try await library.snapshot()
                // Restored time has no process provenance and cannot be edited here.
                model.blocked = model.snapshot?.activeTimer != nil || model.snapshot?.pendingSleepIntervals.isEmpty == false
                model.timerPaused = model.blocked
                model.error = model.timerPaused ? "Existing timer or sleep state needs review. Tracking is paused; no uncertain time is billed." : nil
            } catch { model.blocked = true; model.error = String(describing: error) }
        }
    }

    private func enqueue(_ operation: @escaping @MainActor (WorkspaceModel) async -> Void) {
        let previous = tail
        queued += 1
        isBusy = true
        tail = Task { @MainActor in
            await previous?.value
            await operation(self)
            queued -= 1
            isBusy = queued != 0
        }
    }

    func submit(_ command: WorkspaceCommand, next: EditorRoute? = nil) {
        enqueue { model in
            guard !model.blocked, !model.terminating, let library = model.library else { return }
            do {
                model.snapshot = try await library.perform(command)
                model.sheet = next
                model.error = nil
            } catch let CommandError.currencyConfirmationRequired(previous) {
                model.sheet?.confirmCurrency = previous
            } catch {
                // A poisoned store cannot supply a snapshot: stop writes, never replay the form.
                if (try? await library.snapshot()) == nil { model.blocked = true; model.uncertainSave = true }
                if error is TimerError { model.timerPaused = true }
                if let invalid = error as? LibraryError, case let .invalid(violations) = invalid {
                    model.error = violations.map {
                        switch $0.code {
                        case .siblingName: "Name: another task at this location has the same name."
                        case .project: "Project: enter a trimmed name, nonnegative rate and supported currency."
                        case .task: "Task: check the name and selected project."
                        default: "The edit was rejected (\($0.code.rawValue)). No changes were saved."
                        }
                    }.joined(separator: "\n")
                } else { model.error = (error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? String(describing: error) }
            }
        }
    }

    func createTask(start: Bool) {
        guard let form = sheet, let projectID = form.projectID else { return }
        enqueue { model in
            guard !model.blocked, !model.terminating, let library = model.library else { return }
            guard !start || !(model.timerPaused || model.sleepObserved) else { return }
            do {
                let result = try await library.createTask(id: form.id, projectID: projectID, parentID: form.parentID,
                    name: form.name, confirmMigration: form.migrationAccepted, start: start)
                model.snapshot = result.snapshot
                model.sheet = nil
                model.error = nil
                if let genericID = result.genericID,
                   let generic = result.snapshot.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == genericID }) {
                    model.migrationMessage = "Moved \(result.movedEntryCount) time entries and \(result.movedPendingCount) pending sleep intervals to \(model.path(for: generic)). " +
                        (start ? "Switched to the new child as requested. Undo requires the new child to have no time." : "The existing timer, if any, continues on Generic. The new child is stopped.")
                    model.canUndoMigration = true
                }
            } catch {
                if start { model.timerPaused = true }
                if (try? await library.snapshot()) == nil { model.blocked = true; model.uncertainSave = true }
                let detail = (error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? String(describing: error)
                model.error = start ? "Create & Start was not confirmed. Tracking paused. Last saved checkpoint: \(model.snapshot?.activeTimer?.checkpointAt.description ?? "none"). \(detail) Stop at saved checkpoint before restarting. If blocked, reopen and inspect; never replay blindly. Your draft is preserved." : detail
            }
        }
    }
    func undoTaskMigration() {
        enqueue { model in
            guard !model.blocked, !model.terminating, let library = model.library else { return }
            do {
                model.snapshot = try await library.undoTaskMigration()
                model.migrationMessage = nil
                model.canUndoMigration = false
                model.error = nil
            } catch {
                if (try? await library.snapshot()) == nil { model.blocked = true; model.uncertainSave = true }
                model.error = (error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? String(describing: error)
            }
        }
    }

    func editProject(_ project: Project? = nil) { error = nil; sheet = .project(project) }
    func newTask(project: UUID, parent: UUID? = nil) { error = nil; sheet = .task(nil, project: project, parent: parent) }
    func editTask(_ task: TaskRecord) { error = nil; sheet = .task(task, project: task.projectID, parent: task.parentTaskID) }
    func path(for task: TaskRecord) -> String {
        var names = [task.name]
        var parent = task.parentTaskID
        while let id = parent, let record = snapshot?.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == id }) {
            names.append(record.name); parent = record.parentTaskID
        }
        return names.reversed().joined(separator: " › ")
    }
    var projects: [Project] {
        (snapshot?.projects ?? []).filter { showArchived || !$0.isArchived }
            .sorted { $0.name.localizedStandardCompare($1.name) == .orderedAscending }
    }
    func tasks(project: UUID, parent: UUID?) -> [TaskRecord] {
        (snapshot?.tasks ?? []).filter { $0.projectID == project && $0.parentTaskID == parent }
            .sorted { $0.name.localizedStandardCompare($1.name) == .orderedAscending }
    }

    func timer(_ command: TimerCommand) {
        guard !terminating else { return }
        let generation = sleepGeneration
        enqueue { model in
            guard generation == model.sleepGeneration else { return }
            _ = await model.applyTimer(command)
        }
    }
    private func applyTimer(_ command: TimerCommand) async -> Bool {
        guard !blocked, let library else { return false }
        let safeStop: Bool
        if case .stopAtCheckpoint = command { safeStop = true } else { safeStop = false }
        guard !(timerPaused || sleepObserved) || safeStop else { return false }
        let generation = sleepGeneration
        do {
            snapshot = try await library.performTimer(command)
            if safeStop && generation == sleepGeneration { sleepObserved = false }
            timerPaused = sleepObserved
            if !sleepObserved { error = nil }
            return true
        } catch {
            timerPaused = true
            if (try? await library.snapshot()) == nil { blocked = true; uncertainSave = true }
            self.error = "Tracking paused. Last saved checkpoint: \(snapshot?.activeTimer?.checkpointAt.description ?? "none"). Attempted action: \(String(describing: command)). \((error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? String(describing: error)) Stop at saved checkpoint before restarting. If blocked, reopen and inspect; never replay blindly."
            return false
        }
    }
    func checkpoint() {
        guard !checkpointQueued, !terminating else { return }
        checkpointQueued = true
        enqueue { model in
            defer { model.checkpointQueued = false }
            guard !model.timerPaused, !model.blocked, model.runningEntry != nil else { return }
            _ = await model.applyTimer(.checkpoint)
        }
    }
    var needsTimeReview: Bool {
        timerPaused || !(snapshot?.pendingSleepIntervals.isEmpty ?? true)
    }
    // The latch is taken synchronously so an intent already queued cannot sample after sleep.
    func suspendForSleep() {
        guard let library else { return }
        library.signalSleep()
        sleepGeneration &+= 1
        sleepObserved = true
        timerPaused = true
        enqueue { model in
            guard let library = model.library else { return }
            do { model.snapshot = try await library.suspendTimer() }
            catch { await model.recoveryFailure(error, library: library) }
        }
    }
    private func recoveryFailure(_ error: Error, library: Library) async {
        if (try? await library.snapshot()) == nil { blocked = true }
        timerPaused = true
        self.error = "Tracking paused. " + ((error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? String(describing: error))
    }
    func requestQuit(_ reply: @escaping @MainActor (Bool) -> Void) {
        guard !terminating else { return }
        terminating = true
        enqueue { model in
            var allow = !model.uncertainSave
            if allow && model.runningEntry != nil {
                if model.blocked { allow = model.confirmQuitPreservingRestoredTimer() }
                else if model.confirmQuit() { allow = await model.applyQuitStop() }
                else { allow = false }
            }
            if allow { await model.library?.close() }
            else { model.terminating = false }
            reply(allow)
        }
    }
    private func applyQuitStop() async -> Bool {
        await applyTimer(timerPaused ? .stopAtCheckpoint : .stop)
    }
}

struct EditorRoute: Identifiable {
    enum Kind { case project, task }
    let id: UUID
    let kind: Kind
    let isNew: Bool
    var projectID: UUID?
    var parentID: UUID?
    var name: String
    var rate: String
    var currency: String
    var confirmCurrency: String?
    var currencyAccepted = false
    var migrationAccepted = false
    var archiveRequested = false
    static func project(_ project: Project?) -> Self {
        Self(id: project?.id ?? UUID(), kind: .project, isNew: project == nil,
             name: project?.name ?? "", rate: RateInput.text(project?.hourlyRate ?? 0),
             currency: project?.currencyCode ?? Locale.current.currency?.identifier ?? "EUR")
    }
    static func task(_ task: TaskRecord?, project: UUID, parent: UUID?) -> Self {
        Self(id: task?.id ?? UUID(), kind: .task, isNew: task == nil,
             projectID: project, parentID: parent, name: task?.name ?? "", rate: "", currency: "")
    }
}
```

```swift
private struct TrackDetail: View {
    @Bindable var model: WorkspaceModel
    @AppStorage("expandedTaskIDs") private var expansion = ""
    private var expanded: Set<String> { Set(expansion.split(separator: ",").map(String.init)) }
    private func toggle(_ id: UUID) {
        var ids = expanded
        if !ids.insert(id.uuidString).inserted { ids.remove(id.uuidString) }
        expansion = ids.sorted().joined(separator: ",")
    }
    private func rows(_ project: Project) -> [(task: TaskRecord, depth: Int, path: String)] {
        var result: [(TaskRecord, Int, String)] = []
        var stack = model.tasks(project: project.id, parent: nil).reversed().map { ($0, 0, project.name) }
        while let (task, depth, prefix) = stack.popLast() {
            let path = prefix + " › " + task.name
            if model.search.isEmpty || path.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(model.search) { result.append((task, depth, path)) }
            if !model.search.isEmpty || expanded.contains(task.id.uuidString) {
                stack.append(contentsOf: model.tasks(project: project.id, parent: task.id).reversed().map { ($0, depth + 1, path) })
            }
        }
        return result
    }

If blocked after a save, quit and reopen, inspect the saved state before re-entering anything; do not replay blindly.                     Button("Retry library opening") { model.retryOpen() }.disabled(!model.canRetryOpen)
                }.textSelection(.enabled).padding(.horizontal)
            }
            if let message = model.migrationMessage {
                VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                    Text(message).textSelection(.enabled)
                    Text("Undo is session-only and refuses relevant changes; checkpointing or new time can make it unavailable.")
                    Button("Undo Generic migration") { model.undoTaskMigration() }
                        .disabled(!model.canUndoMigration || model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating)
```

```swift
import Foundation

public struct BudgetAllocation: Equatable, Sendable {
    public let taskID: UUID
    public let limitSeconds: Int64
    public let allocatedSeconds: Decimal
}

public enum BudgetInput {
    public static func parseHours(_ text: String, locale: Locale = .current) -> Int64? {
        guard let hours = RateInput.parse(text, locale: locale), hours > 0 else { return nil }
        var input = hours, multiplier = Decimal(3600), seconds = Decimal()
        guard NSDecimalMultiply(&seconds, &input, &multiplier, .plain) == .noError,
              seconds > 0, seconds <= Decimal(Int64.max) else { return nil }
        var whole = Decimal()
        NSDecimalRound(&whole, &seconds, 0, .down)
        guard whole == seconds else { return nil }
        return NSDecimalNumber(decimal: whole).int64Value
    }

    public static func text(_ seconds: Int64, locale: Locale = .current) -> String {
        // An exact whole-second value need not have a terminating decimal in hours.
        // The form preserves the original value unless the user edits the field.
        let hours = Decimal(seconds) / Decimal(3600)
        return RateInput.text(hours, locale: locale)
    }
}

public enum BudgetRules {
    public static func allocations(in snapshot: LibrarySnapshot) -> [BudgetAllocation] {
        let tasks = Dictionary(snapshot.tasks.map { ($0.id, $0) }, uniquingKeysWith: { first, _ in first })
        var children: [UUID: [UUID]] = [:]
        for task in snapshot.tasks {
            if let parent = task.parentTaskID { children[parent, default: []].append(task.id) }
        }
        return snapshot.tasks.compactMap { task in
            guard let limit = task.budgetSeconds else { return nil }
            var pending = children[task.id, default: []], visited: Set<UUID> = [task.id]
            var total = Decimal(0)
            while let id = pending.popLast(), visited.insert(id).inserted, let child = tasks[id] {
                if let budget = child.budgetSeconds { total += Decimal(budget) }
                else { pending.append(contentsOf: children[id, default: []]) }
            }
            return BudgetAllocation(taskID: task.id, limitSeconds: limit, allocatedSeconds: total)
        }
    }

    // A caller may substitute a live end only for this process's healthy timer.
    public static func usage(in snapshot: LibrarySnapshot, liveEnd: Int64? = nil) throws -> [UUID: Decimal] {
        let tasks = Dictionary(snapshot.tasks.map { ($0.id, $0) }, uniquingKeysWith: { first, _ in first })
        var usage: [UUID: Decimal] = [:]
        for entry in snapshot.entries {
            let end: Int64?
            if let closed = entry.endAt { end = closed }
            else if snapshot.activeTimer?.entryID == entry.id {
                end = liveEnd ?? snapshot.activeTimer?.checkpointAt
            } else { throw LibraryError.invalid([Violation(.timer, entry.id)]) }
            guard let end else { throw LibraryError.invalid([Violation(.timer, entry.id)]) }
            if end == entry.startAt && entry.endAt == nil { continue }
            let duration: Int64
            do { duration = try EntryInterval(startAt: entry.startAt, endAt: end).durationSeconds }
            catch { throw LibraryError.invalid([Violation(.interval, entry.id)]) }
            var cursor: UUID? = entry.taskID, seen = Set<UUID>()
            while let id = cursor {
                guard seen.insert(id).inserted, let task = tasks[id] else {
                    throw LibraryError.invalid([Violation(.hierarchy, id)])
                }
                usage[id, default: 0] += Decimal(duration)
                cursor = task.parentTaskID
            }
        }
        return usage
    }

    public static func band(used: Decimal, budget: Int64?) -> WarningThreshold {
        guard let budget, budget > 0 else { return .none }
        if used >= Decimal(budget) { return .hundred }
        if used * 100 >= Decimal(budget) * 80 { return .eighty }
        return .none
    }
}

// Call once after a mutation and before the validating load, inside its transaction.
func reconcileWarnings(_ db: SQLConnection) throws {
    let state = try decodeSnapshot(db)
    let problems = SnapshotValidator.violations(in: state).filter { $0.code != .warning }
    if !problems.isEmpty { throw LibraryError.invalid(problems) }
    let usage = try BudgetRules.usage(in: state)
    for task in state.tasks {
        let band = BudgetRules.band(used: usage[task.id, default: 0], budget: task.budgetSeconds)
        if band != task.lastWarnedThreshold {
            try db.run("UPDATE tasks SET last_warned_threshold=? WHERE id=?",
                       [.integer(band.rawValue), .text(task.id.uuidString.lowercased())])
        }
    }
}

public struct BudgetWarningBatch: Identifiable, Sendable {
    public let id = UUID()
    public let taskIDs: [UUID]
    public let summary: String
    public init(taskIDs: [UUID], summary: String) { self.taskIDs = taskIDs; self.summary = summary }

    public static func crossings(from before: LibrarySnapshot, to after: LibrarySnapshot) -> [TaskRecord] {
        guard after.revision > before.revision else { return [] }
        let old = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: before.tasks.map { ($0.id, $0.lastWarnedThreshold) })
        return after.tasks.filter { $0.lastWarnedThreshold.rawValue > (old[$0.id] ?? .none).rawValue }
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import Testing
@testable import LibraryStore

private struct BudgetFixture {
    let url: URL
    let store: Storage
    let project = UUID(), parent = UUID(), middle = UUID(), leaf = UUID()
    init() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: root, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        url = root.appendingPathComponent("budget.sqlite")
        try Storage.createPrivateDatabase(at: url)
        store = try Storage(privateDatabaseAt: url)
    }
    func seed() async throws {
        _ = try await store.perform(.saveProject(id: project, name: "Client", rate: 0, currency: "EUR", confirmedPreviousCurrency: nil))
        _ = try await store.createTask(id: parent, projectID: project, parentID: nil, name: "Parent", confirmMigration: false, start: false, budgetSeconds: 100)
        _ = try await store.createTask(id: middle, projectID: project, parentID: parent, name: "Middle", confirmMigration: false, start: false)
        _ = try await store.createTask(id: leaf, projectID: project, parentID: middle, name: "Leaf", confirmMigration: false, start: false, budgetSeconds: 100)
    }
    func remove() { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: url.deletingLastPathComponent()) }
}

@Test func budgetHoursAreExactLocaleWholeSeconds() {
    #expect(BudgetInput.parseHours("1.5", locale: Locale(identifier: "en_US")) == 5400)
    #expect(BudgetInput.parseHours("1,5", locale: Locale(identifier: "nl_NL")) == 5400)
    #expect(BudgetInput.parseHours("0.01", locale: Locale(identifier: "en_US")) == 36)
    for input in ["", "0", "-1", "nan", "inf", "1h", "1,000", "0.0001", "999999999999999999999999999", "0.01000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001"] {
        #expect(BudgetInput.parseHours(input, locale: Locale(identifier: "en_US")) == nil)
    }
}

@Test func budgetBandsAreExactEvenAtInt64Limits() {
    #expect(BudgetRules.band(used: 79, budget: 100) == .none)
    #expect(BudgetRules.band(used: 80, budget: 100) == .eighty)
    #expect(BudgetRules.band(used: 99, budget: 100) == .eighty)
    #expect(BudgetRules.band(used: 100, budget: 100) == .hundred)
    #expect(BudgetRules.band(used: 0, budget: 1) == .none)
    #expect(BudgetRules.band(used: 1, budget: 1) == .hundred)
    #expect(BudgetRules.band(used: Decimal(Int64.max), budget: Int64.max) == .hundred)
    #expect(BudgetRules.band(used: Decimal(Int64.max) - 1, budget: Int64.max) == .eighty)
    #expect(BudgetRules.band(used: 1000, budget: nil) == .none)
}

    let f = try BudgetFixture(); defer { f.remove() }; try await f.seed()
    let before = try await f.store.snapshot()
    #expect(BudgetRules.allocations(in: before).first { $0.taskID == f.parent }?.allocatedSeconds == 100)
    await #expect(throws: LibraryError.self) {
        try await f.store.perform(.saveTask(id: f.leaf, name: "Rejected", budgetSeconds: 101))
    }
    await #expect(throws: LibraryError.self) {
        try await f.store.perform(.saveTask(id: f.parent, name: "Rejected", budgetSeconds: 99))
    }
    #expect(try await f.store.snapshot() == before)

    _ = try await f.store.perform(.saveTask(id: f.middle, name: "Middle", budgetSeconds: 100))
    let same = try await f.store.snapshot()
    #expect(BudgetRules.allocations(in: same).first { $0.taskID == f.parent }?.allocatedSeconds == 100)
    let removed = try await f.store.perform(.saveTask(id: f.middle, name: "Middle", budgetSeconds: nil)).snapshot
    #expect(BudgetRules.allocations(in: removed).first { $0.taskID == f.parent }?.allocatedSeconds == 100)
}

    #expect(exceeded.activeTimer != nil)

@Test func budgetFailuresNeverPublishCrossingsOrPartialState() async throws {
    for fault in [CommitFault.beforeCommit, .commitRejected, .acknowledgementLost] {

        let before = try await f.store.performTimer(.start(taskID: f.leaf), now: { 1000 })

        } else { #expect(try await f.store.snapshot() == before) }
    }
```

```swift
import Foundation

public enum CommandError: Error, Equatable, Sendable, LocalizedError {
    case missingRecord, archivedProject, migrationRequired, recoveryRequired
    case currencyConfirmationRequired(String), currencyChanged
    case migrationConfirmationRequired, genericNameConflict, undoUnavailable
    public var errorDescription: String? {
        switch self {
        case .missingRecord: "The record no longer exists. Reopen the form."
        case .archivedProject: "Restore this project before editing its tasks."
        case .migrationRequired: "Adding a child to a task with time requires Generic migration."
        case .recoveryRequired: "Existing timer or sleep state needs review before editing."
        case .currencyConfirmationRequired: "Confirm currency relabeling; this does not convert the rate."
        case .currencyChanged: "The project currency changed. Reopen the form and confirm again."
        case .migrationConfirmationRequired: "Confirm moving existing time and pending sleep to Generic."
        case .genericNameConflict: "Generic is needed for existing time. Choose another child name."
        case .undoUnavailable: "Cannot undo: relevant tasks, time or sleep state changed, or this session has no migration receipt."
        }
    }
}

public enum WorkspaceCommand: Sendable {
    case saveProject(id: UUID, name: String, rate: Decimal, currency: String, confirmedPreviousCurrency: String?)
    case setArchived(id: UUID, archived: Bool)
    case createTask(id: UUID, projectID: UUID, parentID: UUID?, name: String)
    case renameTask(id: UUID, name: String)
    case saveTask(id: UUID, name: String, budgetSeconds: Int64?)
}

extension Storage {
    func perform(_ command: WorkspaceCommand,
                 now: @Sendable () -> Int64 = { Int64(Date().timeIntervalSince1970.rounded(.down)) },
                 fault: CommitFault = .none) throws -> Committed<Bool> {
        let liveID = liveEntryID
        let initial = try snapshot()
        var sampled: Int64?
        if case let .saveTask(id, _, budget) = command,
           initial.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == id })?.budgetSeconds != budget,
           let active = initial.activeTimer {
            guard active.entryID == liveID, !timerNeedsReview, initial.pendingSleepIntervals.isEmpty else {
                throw CommandError.recoveryRequired
            }
            do {
                let timestamp = try timerGate.sample(now)
                guard timestamp >= active.checkpointAt else { throw TimerError.clockRollback }
                sampled = timestamp
            } catch { timerNeedsReview = true; throw error }
        }
        let timestamp = sampled
        do { return try transact(fault: fault) { db, before in
            // Only a timer established by this process can be edited around.
            guard (before.activeTimer == nil || before.activeTimer?.entryID == liveID), before.pendingSleepIntervals.isEmpty else {
                throw CommandError.recoveryRequired
            }
            func key(_ id: UUID) -> SQLValue { .text(id.uuidString.lowercased()) }
            func name(_ value: String) -> SQLValue {
                .text(value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines))
            }
            switch command {
            case let .saveProject(id, title, rate, currency, confirmed):
                let old = before.projects.first { $0.id == id }
                if let confirmed, old?.currencyCode != confirmed { throw CommandError.currencyChanged }
                if let old, old.currencyCode != currency,
                   before.entries.contains(where: { entry in before.tasks.contains { $0.id == entry.taskID && $0.projectID == id } }),
                   confirmed != old.currencyCode {
                    throw CommandError.currencyConfirmationRequired(old.currencyCode)
                }
                let values: [SQLValue] = [name(title), .text(try canonicalRate(rate)), .text(currency)]
                if old != nil {
                    try db.run("UPDATE projects SET name=?,hourly_rate=?,currency_code=? WHERE id=?", values + [key(id)])
                } else {
                    try db.run("INSERT INTO projects(name,hourly_rate,currency_code,id) VALUES (?,?,?,?)", values + [key(id)])
                }
            case let .setArchived(id, archived):
                guard before.projects.contains(where: { $0.id == id }) else { throw CommandError.missingRecord }
                if archived, let activeID = before.activeTimer?.entryID,
                   let active = before.entries.first(where: { $0.id == activeID }),
                   before.tasks.contains(where: { $0.id == active.taskID && $0.projectID == id }) {
                    throw CommandError.recoveryRequired
                }
                try db.run("UPDATE projects SET is_archived=? WHERE id=?", [.integer(archived ? 1 : 0), key(id)])
            case let .createTask(id, projectID, parentID, title):
                guard let project = before.projects.first(where: { $0.id == projectID }) else { throw CommandError.missingRecord }
                guard !project.isArchived else { throw CommandError.archivedProject }
                if let parentID {
                    guard before.tasks.contains(where: { $0.id == parentID && $0.projectID == projectID }) else {
                        throw CommandError.missingRecord
                    }
                    if before.entries.contains(where: { $0.taskID == parentID }) {
                        throw CommandError.migrationRequired
                    }
                }
                try db.run("INSERT INTO tasks(id,project_id,parent_task_id,name) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                           [key(id), key(projectID), parentID.map(key) ?? .null, name(title)])
            case let .renameTask(id, title):
                guard let task = before.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == id }),
                      let project = before.projects.first(where: { $0.id == task.projectID }) else { throw CommandError.missingRecord }
                guard !project.isArchived else { throw CommandError.archivedProject }
                try db.run("UPDATE tasks SET name=? WHERE id=?", [name(title), key(id)])
            case let .saveTask(id, title, budget):
                guard let task = before.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == id }),
                      let project = before.projects.first(where: { $0.id == task.projectID }) else { throw CommandError.missingRecord }
                guard !project.isArchived else { throw CommandError.archivedProject }
                if let timestamp { try applyTimerTransition(.checkpoint, at: timestamp, db: db, state: before) }
                try db.run("UPDATE tasks SET name=?,budget_seconds=? WHERE id=?",
                           [name(title), budget.map(SQLValue.integer) ?? .null, key(id)])
            }
            return true
        } } catch {
            if timestamp != nil, !(error is LibraryError), !(error is CommandError) { timerNeedsReview = true }
            throw error
        }
    }
}

public enum RateInput {
    public static func parse(_ text: String, locale: Locale = .current) -> Decimal? {
        let input = text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        let separator = locale.decimalSeparator ?? "."
        let parts = input.components(separatedBy: separator)
        guard (1...2).contains(parts.count),
              parts.allSatisfy({ !$0.isEmpty && $0.unicodeScalars.allSatisfy { $0.properties.generalCategory == .decimalNumber } }) else { return nil }
        let canonical = parts.map { $0.map { String($0.wholeNumberValue!) }.joined() }.joined(separator: ".")
        guard let value = Decimal(string: canonical, locale: Locale(identifier: "en_US_POSIX")),
              !value.isNaN, value >= 0 else { return nil }
        // Reject silent Decimal precision loss, while allowing redundant zeroes in user input.
        func normalized(_ string: String) -> String {
            let pieces = string.split(separator: ".", omittingEmptySubsequences: false)
            let whole = String(pieces[0].drop(while: { $0 == "0" }))
            let fraction = pieces.count == 2 ? String(String(pieces[1].reversed().drop(while: { $0 == "0" })).reversed()) : ""
            return (whole.isEmpty ? "0" : whole) + (fraction.isEmpty ? "" : "." + fraction)
        }
        guard let stored = try? canonicalRate(value), normalized(canonical) == normalized(stored) else { return nil }
        return value
    }
    public static func text(_ value: Decimal, locale: Locale = .current) -> String {
        (try? canonicalRate(value))?.replacingOccurrences(of: ".", with: locale.decimalSeparator ?? ".") ?? ""
    }
}

public struct TaskCreation: Sendable {
    public let snapshot: LibrarySnapshot
    public let genericID: UUID?
    public let movedEntryCount: Int
    public let movedPendingCount: Int
}

// Only the affected neighborhood is compared: unrelated edits must survive undo.
struct MigrationState: Equatable, Sendable {
    let tasks: [TaskRecord]
    let entries: [TimeEntry]
    let pending: [PendingSleepInterval]
    let active: ActiveTimer?

    init(_ snapshot: LibrarySnapshot, taskIDs: Set<UUID>, entryIDs: Set<UUID>, pendingIDs: Set<UUID>) {
        tasks = snapshot.tasks.filter { taskIDs.contains($0.id) || $0.parentTaskID.map(taskIDs.contains) == true }
        entries = snapshot.entries.filter { taskIDs.contains($0.taskID) || entryIDs.contains($0.id) }
        pending = snapshot.pendingSleepIntervals.filter { taskIDs.contains($0.taskID) || pendingIDs.contains($0.id) }
        let affectedEntries = entries
        active = snapshot.activeTimer.flatMap { timer in affectedEntries.contains { $0.id == timer.entryID } ? timer : nil }
    }
}

struct TaskMigrationReceipt: Sendable {
    let parentID: UUID
    let genericID: UUID
    let childID: UUID
    let expected: MigrationState
    var taskIDs: Set<UUID> { [parentID, genericID, childID] }
    var entryIDs: Set<UUID> { Set(expected.entries.map(\.id)) }
    var pendingIDs: Set<UUID> { Set(expected.pending.map(\.id)) }
}

extension Storage {
    func createTask(id: UUID, projectID: UUID, parentID: UUID?, name: String,
                    confirmMigration: Bool, start: Bool, budgetSeconds: Int64? = nil,
                    now: @Sendable () -> Int64 = { Int64(Date().timeIntervalSince1970.rounded(.down)) },
                    fault: CommitFault = .none) throws -> TaskCreation {
        let before = try snapshot()
        // Pure ownership migration may move pending references; it never resolves or bills them.
        // Restored timers remain blocked, and starting still requires all time to be reviewed.
        guard before.activeTimer == nil || before.activeTimer?.entryID == liveEntryID else { throw CommandError.recoveryRequired }
        guard !start || (!timerNeedsReview && before.pendingSleepIntervals.isEmpty) else { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
        if !before.pendingSleepIntervals.isEmpty {
            guard budgetSeconds == nil, let parentID,
                  before.pendingSleepIntervals.contains(where: { $0.taskID == parentID }) else {
                throw CommandError.recoveryRequired
            }
        }
        let needsCheckpoint = budgetSeconds != nil && before.activeTimer != nil && before.pendingSleepIntervals.isEmpty
        if needsCheckpoint && timerNeedsReview { throw CommandError.recoveryRequired }
        let timestamp: Int64?
        do { timestamp = (start || needsCheckpoint) ? try timerGate.sample(now) : nil }
        catch { timerNeedsReview = true; throw error }
        let genericID = UUID()
        do {
            let result = try transact(fault: fault) { db, state -> (UUID?, Int, Int) in
                func key(_ id: UUID) -> SQLValue { .text(id.uuidString.lowercased()) }
                guard let project = state.projects.first(where: { $0.id == projectID }) else { throw CommandError.missingRecord }
                guard !project.isArchived else { throw CommandError.archivedProject }
                var movedEntries = 0, movedPending = 0
                if let parentID {
                    guard state.tasks.contains(where: { $0.id == parentID && $0.projectID == projectID }) else { throw CommandError.missingRecord }
                    movedEntries = state.entries.filter { $0.taskID == parentID }.count
                    movedPending = state.pendingSleepIntervals.filter { $0.taskID == parentID }.count
                }
                let migrating = movedEntries + movedPending > 0
                if migrating {
                    guard confirmMigration else { throw CommandError.migrationConfirmationRequired }
                    guard NameKey.make(name) != NameKey.make("Generic") else { throw CommandError.genericNameConflict }
                    try db.run("INSERT INTO tasks(id,project_id,parent_task_id,name) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                               [key(genericID), key(projectID), key(parentID!), .text("Generic")])
                    try db.run("UPDATE time_entries SET task_id=? WHERE task_id=?", [key(genericID), key(parentID!)])
                    try db.run("UPDATE pending_sleep_intervals SET task_id=? WHERE task_id=?", [key(genericID), key(parentID!)])
                }
                try db.run("INSERT INTO tasks(id,project_id,parent_task_id,name) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                           [key(id), key(projectID), parentID.map(key) ?? .null, .text(name.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines))])
                if let budgetSeconds {
                    try db.run("UPDATE tasks SET budget_seconds=? WHERE id=?", [.integer(budgetSeconds), key(id)])
                }
                if let timestamp {
                    if let active = state.activeTimer, timestamp < active.checkpointAt { throw TimerError.clockRollback }
                    // Validate the intermediate tree only after reconciling the new budget.
                    try reconcileWarnings(db)
                    let interim = try load(db)
                    try applyTimerTransition(start ? .start(taskID: id) : .checkpoint,
                                             at: timestamp, db: db, state: interim)
                }
                return (migrating ? genericID : nil, movedEntries, movedPending)
            }
            if let generic = result.value.0, let parentID {
                migrationReceipt = TaskMigrationReceipt(parentID: parentID, genericID: generic, childID: id,
                    expected: MigrationState(result.snapshot, taskIDs: [parentID, generic, id], entryIDs: [], pendingIDs: []))
            }
            if start { liveEntryID = result.snapshot.activeTimer?.entryID; timerNeedsReview = false }
            return TaskCreation(snapshot: result.snapshot, genericID: result.value.0,
                                movedEntryCount: result.value.1, movedPendingCount: result.value.2)
        } catch {
            if start || needsCheckpoint { timerNeedsReview = true }
            throw error
        }
    }

    func undoTaskMigration(fault: CommitFault = .none) throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
        guard let receipt = migrationReceipt else { throw CommandError.undoUnavailable }
        let result = try transact(fault: fault) { db, state in
            let current = MigrationState(state, taskIDs: receipt.taskIDs, entryIDs: receipt.entryIDs, pendingIDs: receipt.pendingIDs)
            guard current == receipt.expected,
                  !current.entries.contains(where: { $0.taskID == receipt.childID }),
                  !current.pending.contains(where: { $0.taskID == receipt.childID }),
                  !current.tasks.contains(where: { $0.parentTaskID == receipt.childID || $0.parentTaskID == receipt.genericID }),
                  state.projects.contains(where: { project in
                      project.id == current.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == receipt.parentID })?.projectID && !project.isArchived
                  }) else { throw CommandError.undoUnavailable }
            func key(_ id: UUID) -> SQLValue { .text(id.uuidString.lowercased()) }
            try db.run("UPDATE time_entries SET task_id=? WHERE task_id=?", [key(receipt.parentID), key(receipt.genericID)])
            try db.run("UPDATE pending_sleep_intervals SET task_id=? WHERE task_id=?", [key(receipt.parentID), key(receipt.genericID)])
            try db.run("DELETE FROM tasks WHERE id IN (?,?)", [key(receipt.childID), key(receipt.genericID)])
            return true
        }
        migrationReceipt = nil
        return result.snapshot
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation

public enum TimerCommand: Sendable {
    case start(taskID: UUID), stop, checkpoint, stopAtCheckpoint
}

public enum TimerError: Error, Equatable, Sendable, LocalizedError {
    case reviewRequired, missingTask, notALeaf, archivedProject, clockRollback
    public var errorDescription: String? {
        switch self {
        case .reviewRequired: "Time needs review; no uncertain gap was added."
        case .missingTask: "The task no longer exists."
        case .notALeaf: "Choose a leaf task to start."
        case .archivedProject: "Restore the project before starting its timer."
        case .clockRollback: "The clock moved behind saved time. Stop at the last saved checkpoint and review."
        }
    }
}

// A synchronous notification latch reaches storage before queued actor work resumes.
final class TimerGate: @unchecked Sendable {
    private let lock = NSLock()
    private var suspended = false
    private var generation: UInt64 = 0
    @discardableResult func suspend() -> UInt64 {
        lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }
        generation &+= 1
        suspended = true
        return generation
    }
    func currentGeneration() -> UInt64 { lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }; return generation }
    func reset(ifCurrent value: UInt64) {
        lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }
        if generation == value { suspended = false }
    }
    func sample(_ now: @Sendable () -> Int64) throws -> Int64 {
        lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }
        guard !suspended else { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
        return now()
    }
    func check() throws {
        lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }
        guard !suspended else { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
    }
}

extension Storage {
    // Process provenance is deliberately not reconstructed from persisted rows.
    func suspendTimer() throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
        timerNeedsReview = true
        return try snapshot()
    }

    func performTimer(_ command: TimerCommand, now: @Sendable () -> Int64 = {
        Int64(Date().timeIntervalSince1970.rounded(.down))
    }, fault: CommitFault = .none) throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
        let before = try snapshot()
        if let active = before.activeTimer, active.entryID != liveEntryID { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
        // Slice 6 cannot resolve any restored or pending sleep; Slice 10 owns that review.
        guard before.pendingSleepIntervals.isEmpty else { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
        let safeStop: Bool
        if case .stopAtCheckpoint = command { safeStop = true } else { safeStop = false }
        guard !timerNeedsReview || safeStop else { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
        do {
            let generation = timerGate.currentGeneration()
            let timestamp = safeStop ? before.activeTimer?.checkpointAt ?? 0 : try timerGate.sample(now)
            // Idempotent clicks and coalesced ticks do not create revisions.
            if case let .start(taskID) = command,
               before.entries.first(where: { $0.id == before.activeTimer?.entryID })?.taskID == taskID {
                if let active = before.activeTimer, timestamp < active.checkpointAt { throw TimerError.clockRollback }
                return before
            }
            if before.activeTimer == nil {
                switch command {
                case .stopAtCheckpoint: timerNeedsReview = false; timerGate.reset(ifCurrent: generation); return before
                case .stop, .checkpoint: return before
                case .start: break
                }
            }
            if let active = before.activeTimer, timestamp < active.checkpointAt { throw TimerError.clockRollback }
            if case .checkpoint = command, before.activeTimer?.checkpointAt == timestamp { return before }
            let result = try transact(fault: fault) { db, state in
                try applyTimerTransition(command, at: timestamp, db: db, state: state)
                return true
            }
            liveEntryID = result.snapshot.activeTimer?.entryID
            timerNeedsReview = false
            if safeStop { timerGate.reset(ifCurrent: generation) }
            return result.snapshot
        } catch {
            // Never extend through an interval after a failed save or reversed clock.
            timerNeedsReview = true
            throw error
        }
    }
}

// Shared by timer commands and atomic Create & Start; callers own gates and commit.
func applyTimerTransition(_ command: TimerCommand, at timestamp: Int64,
                          db: SQLConnection, state: LibrarySnapshot) throws {
    func key(_ id: UUID) -> SQLValue { .text(id.uuidString.lowercased()) }
if case let .start(taskID) = command {
    guard let task = state.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == taskID }),
          let project = state.projects.first(where: { $0.id == task.projectID }) else { throw TimerError.missingTask }
    guard !project.isArchived else { throw TimerError.archivedProject }
    guard !state.tasks.contains(where: { $0.parentTaskID == taskID }) else { throw TimerError.notALeaf }
    // Existing history can appear future-dated after clock rollback.
    guard !state.entries.contains(where: { $0.endAt.map { $0 > timestamp } ?? false }) else {
        throw TimerError.clockRollback
    }
}
if case .checkpoint = command {
    try db.run("UPDATE active_timer SET checkpoint_at=? WHERE id=1", [.integer(timestamp)])
} else {
    if let active = state.activeTimer, let entry = state.entries.first(where: { $0.id == active.entryID }) {
        try db.exec("DELETE FROM active_timer")
        if timestamp == entry.startAt {
            try db.run("DELETE FROM time_entries WHERE id=?", [key(entry.id)])
        } else {
            try db.run("UPDATE time_entries SET end_at=? WHERE id=?", [.integer(timestamp), key(entry.id)])
        }
    }
    if case let .start(taskID) = command {
        let id = UUID()
        try db.run("INSERT INTO time_entries VALUES (?,?,?,NULL)", [key(id), key(taskID), .integer(timestamp)])
        try db.run("INSERT INTO active_timer VALUES (1,?,?)", [key(id), .integer(timestamp)])
    }
}
}
```

```swift
import Foundation

public struct Violation: Equatable, Sendable {
    public enum Code: String, Sendable {
        case metadata, duplicateID, project, task, hierarchy, siblingName
        case ownership, interval, overlap, timer, pending, allocation, warning
    }
    public let code: Code
    public let recordID: UUID?
    public init(_ code: Code, _ recordID: UUID? = nil) {
        self.code = code
        self.recordID = recordID
    }
}

public enum LibraryError: Error, Equatable, Sendable {
    case invalid([Violation])
}

public enum SnapshotValidator {
    public static func validate(_ snapshot: LibrarySnapshot, now: Int64? = nil) throws {
        let problems = violations(in: snapshot, now: now)
        if !problems.isEmpty { throw LibraryError.invalid(problems) }
    }

    public static func violations(in s: LibrarySnapshot, now: Int64? = nil) -> [Violation] {
        var errors: [Violation] = []
        func add(_ code: Violation.Code, _ id: UUID? = nil) { errors.append(Violation(code, id)) }
        func unique(_ ids: [UUID]) -> Bool { Set(ids).count == ids.count }
        guard unique(s.projects.map(\.id)), unique(s.tasks.map(\.id)),
              unique(s.entries.map(\.id)), unique(s.pendingSleepIntervals.map(\.id)) else {
            return [Violation(.duplicateID)]
        }
        if s.schemaVersion != 1 || s.revision < 0 { add(.metadata) }
        let projects = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: s.projects.map { ($0.id, $0) })
        let tasks = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: s.tasks.map { ($0.id, $0) })
        let currencies = Set(Locale.commonISOCurrencyCodes)
        func validName(_ name: String) -> Bool {
            !NameKey.make(name).isEmpty && name == name.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
                && !name.contains("\0")
        }
        for p in s.projects {
            if !validName(p.name) || p.hourlyRate.isNaN || p.hourlyRate < 0
                || !currencies.contains(p.currencyCode) { add(.project, p.id) }
        }
        struct Sibling: Hashable { let project: UUID; let parent: UUID?; let name: String }
        var siblings = Set<Sibling>()
        var children: [UUID: [UUID]] = [:]
        for t in s.tasks {
            if projects[t.projectID] == nil || !validName(t.name)
                || t.budgetSeconds.map({ $0 <= 0 }) == true { add(.task, t.id) }
            if !siblings.insert(Sibling(project: t.projectID, parent: t.parentTaskID,
                                        name: NameKey.make(t.name))).inserted { add(.siblingName, t.id) }
            if let parent = t.parentTaskID {
                if parent == t.id || tasks[parent]?.projectID != t.projectID { add(.hierarchy, t.id) }
                children[parent, default: []].append(t.id)
            }
        }
        // Iterative walks accept arbitrary depth without recursive stack growth.
        for t in s.tasks {
            var seen = Set<UUID>()
            var cursor: UUID? = t.id
            while let id = cursor {
                if !seen.insert(id).inserted { add(.hierarchy, t.id); break }
                cursor = tasks[id]?.parentTaskID
            }
        }
        if errors.contains(where: { $0.code == .hierarchy || $0.code == .task }) { return errors }
        func isLeaf(_ id: UUID) -> Bool { tasks[id] != nil && children[id, default: []].isEmpty }
        var intervals: [(UUID, EntryInterval)] = []
        var usage: [UUID: Decimal] = [:]
        for e in s.entries {
            if !isLeaf(e.taskID) { add(.ownership, e.id) }
            let end = e.endAt ?? s.activeTimer?.checkpointAt
            if let end {
                if e.endAt != nil, let now, end > now { add(.interval, e.id) }
                if end == e.startAt && e.endAt == nil { continue }
                if let interval = try? EntryInterval(startAt: e.startAt, endAt: end) {
                    intervals.append((e.id, interval))
                    var cursor: UUID? = e.taskID
                    while let id = cursor {
                        usage[id, default: 0] += Decimal(interval.durationSeconds)
                        cursor = tasks[id]?.parentTaskID
                    }
                } else { add(.interval, e.id) }
            } else { add(.timer, e.id) }
        }
        intervals.sort { $0.1.startAt < $1.1.startAt }
        var furthest: Int64?
        for (id, interval) in intervals {
            if let end = furthest, interval.startAt < end { add(.overlap, id) }
            furthest = max(furthest ?? interval.endAt, interval.endAt)
        }
        let open = s.entries.filter { $0.endAt == nil }
        if let timer = s.activeTimer {
            if open.count != 1 || open.first?.id != timer.entryID
                || open.first.map({ timer.checkpointAt < $0.startAt }) == true { add(.timer) }
            if let entry = open.first, let task = tasks[entry.taskID], projects[task.projectID]?.isArchived == true {
                add(.timer, entry.id)
            }
            // Reserve the entire open interval, not only its confirmed checkpoint prefix.
            if let entry = open.first,
               s.entries.contains(where: { $0.endAt != nil && $0.id != entry.id && $0.endAt! > entry.startAt }) {
                add(.overlap, entry.id)
            }
        } else if !open.isEmpty { add(.timer) }
        let unknown = s.pendingSleepIntervals.filter { $0.wakeAt == nil }
        if unknown.count > 1 || (!unknown.isEmpty && s.activeTimer != nil) { add(.pending) }
        for p in s.pendingSleepIntervals {
            if !isLeaf(p.taskID) { add(.ownership, p.id) }
            if let end = p.wakeAt, (try? EntryInterval(startAt: p.sleepAt, endAt: end)) == nil {
                add(.pending, p.id)
            }
        }
        for allocation in BudgetRules.allocations(in: s) where allocation.allocatedSeconds > Decimal(allocation.limitSeconds) {
            add(.allocation, allocation.taskID)
        }
        for t in s.tasks {
            let expected = BudgetRules.band(used: usage[t.id, default: 0], budget: t.budgetSeconds)
            if t.lastWarnedThreshold != expected { add(.warning, t.id) }
        }
        return errors
    }
}
```
