```swift
import SwiftUI
import AppKit
import LibraryStore

struct CorrectionRoute: Identifiable {
    enum Mode { case add(UUID), edit(TimeEntry) }
    let id = UUID()
    let mode: Mode
}

@MainActor @Observable final class CorrectionForm {
    var taskID: UUID
    var startText = ""
    var endText = ""
    var startZone = TimeZone.current.identifier
    var endZone = TimeZone.current.identifier
    var startOffset: Int64?
    var endOffset: Int64?
    var preview: CorrectionPreview?
    var applying = false
    let source: TimeEntry?

    init(mode: CorrectionRoute.Mode, now: Date = .now) {
        switch mode {
        case let .add(id):
            source = nil; taskID = id
            let end = Int64(now.timeIntervalSince1970.rounded(.down))
            startText = Self.text(end - 3600, zone: TimeZone.current)
        case let .edit(entry):
            source = entry; taskID = entry.taskID
            startText = Self.text(entry.startAt, zone: TimeZone.current)
            endText = Self.text(entry.endAt ?? entry.startAt, zone: TimeZone.current)
        }
    }

    static func text(_ instant: Int64, zone: TimeZone) -> String {
        var calendar = Calendar(identifier: .gregorian); calendar.timeZone = zone
        let c = calendar.dateComponents(in: zone, from: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: TimeInterval(instant)))
        return String(format: "%04d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d:%02d", c.year!, c.month!, c.day!, c.hour!, c.minute!, c.second!)
    }

    static func duration(_ seconds: Int64) -> String {
        let hours = seconds / 3600, minutes = seconds % 3600 / 60
        return "\(hours)h \(minutes)m \(seconds % 60)s"
    }
    static func display(_ entry: TimeEntry) -> String {
        guard let end = entry.endAt else { return "running" }
        let zone = TimeZone.current
        return "\(text(entry.startAt, zone: zone)) – \(text(end, zone: zone)) (\(duration(end - entry.startAt)))"
    }

    static func components(_ text: String, zoneID: String) -> DateComponents? {
        let parts = text.split(separator: " ", omittingEmptySubsequences: true)
        guard parts.count == 2, parts[0].count == 10, parts[1].count == 8,
              parts[0].filter({ $0 == "-" }).count == 2, parts[1].filter({ $0 == ":" }).count == 2,
              let zone = TimeZone(identifier: zoneID) else { return nil }
        let date = parts[0].split(separator: "-", omittingEmptySubsequences: false)
        let time = parts[1].split(separator: ":", omittingEmptySubsequences: false)
        guard date.count == 3, time.count == 3,
              date.allSatisfy({ !$0.isEmpty && $0.allSatisfy(\.isNumber) }),
              time.allSatisfy({ !$0.isEmpty && $0.allSatisfy(\.isNumber) }),
              let year = Int(date[0]), let month = Int(date[1]), let day = Int(date[2]),
              let hour = Int(time[0]), let minute = Int(time[1]), let second = Int(time[2]) else { return nil }
        return DateComponents(timeZone: zone, year: year, month: month, day: day,
                              hour: hour, minute: minute, second: second)
    }

    func resolution(_ text: String, zoneID: String) -> WallTimeResolution? {
        guard let c = Self.components(text, zoneID: zoneID), let zone = TimeZone(identifier: zoneID) else { return nil }
        var calendar = Calendar(identifier: .gregorian); calendar.timeZone = zone
        return CorrectionClock.resolve(c, calendar: calendar)
    }

    func resolved(_ text: String, zoneID: String, selection: Int64?) -> Int64? {
        switch resolution(text, zoneID: zoneID) {
        case let .unique(value): value
        case let .ambiguous(earlier, later, _, _): selection == earlier || selection == later ? selection : nil
        default: nil
        }
    }

    func makePreview(snapshot: LibrarySnapshot) throws -> CorrectionPreview {
        guard let start = resolved(startText, zoneID: startZone, selection: startOffset),
              let end = resolved(endText, zoneID: endZone, selection: endOffset) else {
            throw CorrectionError.invalidInterval
        }
        let draft: CorrectionDraft
        if let source { draft = .edit(id: source.id, taskID: taskID, startAt: start, endAt: end) }
        else { draft = .add(id: UUID(), taskID: taskID, startAt: start, endAt: end) }
        return try CorrectionPlanner.preview(draft, in: snapshot)
    }
}

struct WallTimeField: View {
    let label: String
    @Binding var text: String
    @Binding var zoneID: String
    @Binding var selection: Int64?
    let resolution: WallTimeResolution?
    var body: some View {
        LabeledContent(label) {
            VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                TextField("YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS", text: $text)
                    .textFieldStyle(.roundedBorder).monospacedDigit()
                    .accessibilityLabel(label + " local date and time")
                TextField("IANA time zone", text: $zoneID)
                    .accessibilityLabel(label + " IANA time zone")
                switch resolution {
                case .nonexistent:
                    Text("This local time does not exist or is incomplete. Enter the full civil date and time; no automatic adjustment is made.").foregroundStyle(.red)
                case let .ambiguous(earlier, later, first, second):
                    Picker("Repeated local time — choose an instant", selection: $selection) {
                        Text("Choose an instant").tag(nil as Int64?)
                        Text(Self.display(earlier, zoneID, first)).tag(Optional(earlier))
                        Text(Self.display(later, zoneID, second)).tag(Optional(later))
                    }
                    .accessibilityLabel(label + " repeated instant")
                case .unique:
                    EmptyView()
                case nil:
                    Text("Use YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS and a valid IANA zone, for example Europe/Amsterdam.")
                }
            }
        }
        .onChange(of: text) { _, _ in selection = nil }
        .onChange(of: zoneID) { _, _ in selection = nil }
    }
    static func display(_ instant: Int64, _ zoneID: String, _ offset: Int) -> String {
        CorrectionForm.text(instant, zone: TimeZone(identifier: zoneID) ?? .current) + " " + CorrectionClock.offsetText(offset)
    }
}

struct CorrectionSheet: View {
    @Bindable var model: WorkspaceModel
    @State private var form: CorrectionForm
    @State private var deletionPreview: DeletionPreview?
    init(model: WorkspaceModel, route: CorrectionRoute) {
        self.model = model
        _form = State(initialValue: CorrectionForm(mode: route.mode))
    }
    private var source: TimeEntry? { form.source }
    @State private var startResolution: WallTimeResolution?
    @State private var endResolution: WallTimeResolution?
    private var valid: Bool {
        switch (startResolution, endResolution) {
        case (.unique, .unique): true
        case let (.ambiguous(earlier, later, _, _), .unique): form.startOffset == earlier || form.startOffset == later
        case let (.unique, .ambiguous(earlier, later, _, _)): form.endOffset == earlier || form.endOffset == later
        case let (.ambiguous(se, sl, _, _), .ambiguous(ee, el, _, _)):
            (form.startOffset == se || form.startOffset == sl) && (form.endOffset == ee || form.endOffset == el)
        default: false
        }
    }
    private var proposed: CorrectionDraft? {
        guard let start = form.resolved(form.startText, zoneID: form.startZone, selection: form.startOffset),
              let end = form.resolved(form.endText, zoneID: form.endZone, selection: form.endOffset) else { return nil }
        if let source { return .edit(id: source.id, taskID: form.taskID, startAt: start, endAt: end) }
        return .add(id: UUID(), taskID: form.taskID, startAt: start, endAt: end)
    }
    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
                Text(source == nil ? "Add time" : "Edit time").font(.title2)
                if let source { Text("Entry ID: \(source.id.uuidString)").font(.caption).textSelection(.enabled) }
                Picker("Leaf task", selection: $form.taskID) {
                    ForEach(model.leafTasks) { Text(model.correctionPath(for: $0.id)).tag($0.id) }
                }.disabled(source != nil && !model.leafTasks.contains { $0.id == form.taskID })
                if let proposed {
                    Text("Duration \(CorrectionForm.duration(proposed.endAt - proposed.startAt))")
                    if let task = model.snapshot?.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == proposed.taskID }),
                       let project = model.snapshot?.projects.first(where: { $0.id == task.projectID }) {
                        Text("Rate \(RateInput.text(project.hourlyRate)) \(project.currencyCode) / hour (current project rate)")
                    }
                }
                WallTimeField(label: "Start", text: $form.startText, zoneID: $form.startZone,
                              selection: $form.startOffset, resolution: startResolution)
                WallTimeField(label: "End", text: $form.endText, zoneID: $form.endZone,
                              selection: $form.endOffset, resolution: endResolution)
                if let error = model.error { Text(error).foregroundStyle(.red).textSelection(.enabled) }
                HStack {
                    Button("Cancel") { model.closeCorrection() }.disabled(form.applying)
                    Button(source == nil ? "Review addition" : "Review changes") { model.reviewCorrection(form: form) }
                        .disabled(!valid || form.applying || model.isBusy || model.blocked)
                    if source != nil { Button("Delete…", role: .destructive) {
                        if let source { deletionPreview = DeletionPreview(entry: source, path: model.correctionPath(for: source.taskID)) }
                    }.disabled(form.applying || model.isBusy) }
                }
                if let preview = form.preview {
                    Divider()
                    Text("Review the complete correction").font(.headline)
                    if let source = preview.source {
                        Text("Original \(model.correctionPath(for: source.taskID)): \(CorrectionForm.display(source))")
                    }
                    Text("Proposed \(preview.targetPath): \(CorrectionForm.display(TimeEntry(id: preview.draft.entryID, taskID: preview.draft.taskID, startAt: preview.draft.startAt, endAt: preview.draft.endAt)))")
                    ForEach(preview.adjustments, id: \.before.id) { row in
                        VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                            Text("\(row.path): \(row.kind.rawValue)").font(.headline)
                            Text("Before \(CorrectionForm.display(row.before))")
                            ForEach(row.retained) { Text("After \(CorrectionForm.display($0)); ID \($0.id.uuidString)") }
                            if row.retained.isEmpty { Text("This entry will be deleted.") }
                        }.accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
                    }
                    if let running = preview.runningConflict {
                        Text("Running entry \(preview.runningPath ?? running.taskID.uuidString) overlaps this correction. It is not automatically trimmed. Stop it, then review again.").foregroundStyle(.red)
                        Button("Stop running entry") { model.stopForCorrection(entryID: running.id) }
                    } else {
                        Button("Confirm and save correction") { model.applyCorrection(form: form) }
                            .disabled(form.applying || model.isBusy || model.blocked)
                    }
                }
                if let deletionPreview {
                    let source = deletionPreview.entry
                    Divider()
                    Text("Delete \(deletionPreview.path) on \(CorrectionForm.text(source.startAt, zone: .current)) for \(CorrectionForm.duration(source.endAt! - source.startAt))? This removes the entry. Undo remains available only while no relevant time changes.")
                    Button("Confirm deletion", role: .destructive) { model.deleteCorrection(deletionPreview) }
                        .disabled(form.applying || model.isBusy || model.blocked)
                }
            }.padding().frame(maxWidth: 620, alignment: .leading)
        }
        .onAppear {
            startResolution = form.resolution(form.startText, zoneID: form.startZone)
            endResolution = form.resolution(form.endText, zoneID: form.endZone)
        }
        .onChange(of: form.startText) { _, _ in
            form.preview = nil
            startResolution = form.resolution(form.startText, zoneID: form.startZone)
        }
        .onChange(of: form.endText) { _, _ in
            form.preview = nil
            endResolution = form.resolution(form.endText, zoneID: form.endZone)
        }
        .onChange(of: form.startZone) { _, _ in
            form.preview = nil
            startResolution = form.resolution(form.startText, zoneID: form.startZone)
        }
        .onChange(of: form.endZone) { _, _ in
            form.preview = nil
            endResolution = form.resolution(form.endText, zoneID: form.endZone)
        }
        .onChange(of: form.startOffset) { _, _ in form.preview = nil }
        .onChange(of: form.endOffset) { _, _ in form.preview = nil }
        .onChange(of: form.taskID) { _, _ in form.preview = nil }
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import Observation
import AppKit
import LibraryStore

@MainActor @Observable final class WorkspaceModel {
    private(set) var snapshot: LibrarySnapshot?
    private(set) var isBusy = false
    private(set) var blocked = false
    private var uncertainSave = false
    private(set) var migrationMessage: String?
    private(set) var canUndoMigration = false
    var error: String?
    var correctionSheet: CorrectionRoute?
    private(set) var canUndoCorrection = false
    private(set) var correctionMessage: String?
    var sheet: EditorRoute?
    private(set) var budgetWarnings: [BudgetWarningBatch] = []
    var revealedBudgetTask: UUID?
    var pendingBudgetTarget: UUID?
    var openWorkspace: (() -> Void)? {
        didSet {
            if openWorkspace != nil, let target = pendingBudgetTarget {
                revealBudgetTask(target)
            }
        }
    }
    var suspendedBudgetDraft: EditorRoute?

    private func publish(_ next: LibrarySnapshot) {
        let previous = snapshot
        snapshot = next
        guard let previous else { return }
        let crossed = BudgetWarningBatch.crossings(from: previous, to: next)
        if !crossed.isEmpty {
            let batch = BudgetWarningBatch(taskIDs: crossed.map(\.id), summary: crossed.map { task in
                let project = next.projects.first { $0.id == task.projectID }?.name ?? ""
                return project + " › " + path(for: task) + ": " +
                    (task.lastWarnedThreshold == .hundred ? "Budget reached. Tracking continues." : "80% budget warning.")
            }.joined(separator: "\n"))
            budgetWarnings.append(batch)
            NSAccessibility.post(element: NSApp as Any, notification: .announcementRequested,
                userInfo: [.announcement: batch.summary, .priority: NSAccessibilityPriorityLevel.medium.rawValue])
            let enabling = next.tasks.contains { task in
                task.budgetSeconds != nil && previous.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == task.id })?.budgetSeconds == nil
            }
            Task { await BudgetNotifications.shared.deliver(batch, requestPermission: enabling) }
        } else if next.tasks.contains(where: { task in
            task.budgetSeconds != nil && previous.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == task.id })?.budgetSeconds == nil
        }) {
            Task { await BudgetNotifications.shared.requestIfNeeded() }
        }
    }

    func dismissBudgetWarning(_ id: UUID) { budgetWarnings.removeAll { $0.id == id } }

    func revealBudgetTask(_ id: UUID) {
        guard let snapshot, let openWorkspace else { pendingBudgetTarget = id; return }
        pendingBudgetTarget = nil
        openWorkspace()
        NSApp.activate()
        guard let task = snapshot.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == id }) else {
            error = "The budget notification's task is no longer available. No data was changed."
            return
        }
        if snapshot.projects.first(where: { $0.id == task.projectID })?.isArchived == true { showArchived = true }
        selectedProject = task.projectID
        search = ""
        var expanded = Set(UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: "expandedTaskIDs")?.split(separator: ",").map(String.init) ?? [])
        var parent = task.parentTaskID
        while let id = parent, let record = snapshot.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == id }) {
            expanded.insert(id.uuidString); parent = record.parentTaskID
        }
        UserDefaults.standard.set(expanded.sorted().joined(separator: ","), forKey: "expandedTaskIDs")
        revealedBudgetTask = nil
        revealedBudgetTask = id
    }

    func budgetTick(at date: Date = .now) {
        guard !timerPaused, !blocked, !sleepObserved, !terminating, let snapshot,
              let checkpoint = snapshot.activeTimer?.checkpointAt else { return }
        let now = Int64(date.timeIntervalSince1970.rounded(.down))
        guard now >= checkpoint, let usage = try? BudgetRules.usage(in: snapshot, liveEnd: now) else { return }
        if snapshot.tasks.contains(where: {
            BudgetRules.band(used: usage[$0.id, default: 0], budget: $0.budgetSeconds).rawValue > $0.lastWarnedThreshold.rawValue
        }) { self.checkpoint() }
    }

    func budgetUsage(at date: Date) -> [UUID: Decimal] {
        guard let snapshot else { return [:] }
        let now = Int64(date.timeIntervalSince1970.rounded(.down))
        let live = !timerPaused && !blocked && !sleepObserved && !terminating && snapshot.activeTimer.map { now >= $0.checkpointAt } == true
        return (try? BudgetRules.usage(in: snapshot, liveEnd: live ? now : nil)) ?? [:]
    }

    func editConstrainingBudget(_ id: UUID) {
        guard let task = snapshot?.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == id }), let draft = sheet else { return }
        suspendedBudgetDraft = draft
        editTask(task)
    }

    func finishTaskSheet() {
        sheet = suspendedBudgetDraft
        suspendedBudgetDraft = nil
    }
    var showArchived = false
    var search = ""
    var selectedProject: UUID? {
        didSet { UserDefaults.standard.set(selectedProject?.uuidString, forKey: "selectedProject") }
    }
    private var library: Library?
    private(set) var timerPaused = false
    private(set) var terminating = false
    private(set) var sleepObserved = false
    private var sleepGeneration: UInt64 = 0
    private var checkpointQueued = false
    var runningEntry: TimeEntry? { snapshot?.entries.first { $0.id == snapshot?.activeTimer?.entryID } }
    var timerLabel: String {
        guard let entry = runningEntry,
              let task = snapshot?.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == entry.taskID }) else { return "Choose a task to start" }
        let project = snapshot?.projects.first(where: { $0.id == task.projectID })?.name ?? ""
        return project + " › " + path(for: task) + (timerPaused || blocked ? " — paused for review" : " — running")
    }
    func elapsed(at date: Date) -> String {
        guard let entry = runningEntry, let checkpoint = snapshot?.activeTimer?.checkpointAt else { return "00:00:00" }
        let end = timerPaused || blocked ? checkpoint : max(checkpoint, Int64(date.timeIntervalSince1970.rounded(.down)))
        let seconds = end.subtractingReportingOverflow(entry.startAt)
        guard !seconds.overflow else { return "Duration requires review" }
        return String(format: "%02lld:%02lld:%02lld", seconds.partialValue / 3600, seconds.partialValue % 3600 / 60, seconds.partialValue % 60)
    }
    var recentTasks: [TaskRecord] {
        guard let snapshot else { return [] }
        let ordered = snapshot.entries.sorted { $0.startAt > $1.startAt }.map(\.taskID)
        var seen = Set<UUID>()
        return ordered.compactMap { id in
            guard seen.insert(id).inserted,
                  let task = snapshot.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == id }),
                  !snapshot.tasks.contains(where: { $0.parentTaskID == id }),
                  snapshot.projects.contains(where: { $0.id == task.projectID && !$0.isArchived }) else { return nil }
            return task
        }.prefix(8).map { $0 }
    }
    private(set) var libraryLocation = "Application Support/UurtjeFactuurtje/library.sqlite (inside the app sandbox)"
    var canRetryOpen: Bool { library == nil && !isBusy }
    private var tail: Task<Void, Never>?
    private var queued = 0

    init() {
        selectedProject = UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: "selectedProject").flatMap(UUID.init(uuidString:))
        retryOpen()
    }

    func retryOpen() {
        guard library == nil else { return }
        enqueue { model in
            do {
                let directory = try FileManager.default.url(for: .applicationSupportDirectory, in: .userDomainMask,
                                                           appropriateFor: nil, create: true).appendingPathComponent("UurtjeFactuurtje", isDirectory: true)
                model.libraryLocation = directory.appendingPathComponent("library.sqlite").path
                let library = try await Task.detached {
                    try Library.open(at: directory)
                }.value
                model.library = library
                model.snapshot = try await library.snapshot()
                // Restored time has no process provenance and cannot be edited here.
                model.blocked = model.snapshot?.activeTimer != nil || model.snapshot?.pendingSleepIntervals.isEmpty == false
                model.timerPaused = model.blocked
                model.error = model.timerPaused ? "Existing timer or sleep state needs review. Tracking is paused; no uncertain time is billed." : nil
                if let target = model.pendingBudgetTarget {
                    model.pendingBudgetTarget = nil
                    model.revealBudgetTask(target)
                }
            } catch { model.blocked = true; model.error = String(describing: error) }
        }
    }

    private func enqueue(_ operation: @escaping @MainActor (WorkspaceModel) async -> Void) {
        let previous = tail
        queued += 1
        isBusy = true
        tail = Task { @MainActor in
            await previous?.value
            await operation(self)
            queued -= 1
            isBusy = queued != 0
        }
    }

    func submit(_ command: WorkspaceCommand, next: EditorRoute? = nil) {
        enqueue { model in
            guard !model.blocked, !model.terminating, let library = model.library else { return }
            do {
                model.publish(try await library.perform(command))
                if model.suspendedBudgetDraft != nil { model.finishTaskSheet() }
                else { model.sheet = next }
                model.error = nil
            } catch let CommandError.currencyConfirmationRequired(previous) {
                model.sheet?.confirmCurrency = previous
            } catch {
                // A poisoned store cannot supply a snapshot: stop writes, never replay the form.
                if (try? await library.snapshot()) == nil { model.blocked = true; model.uncertainSave = true }
                if error is TimerError { model.timerPaused = true }
                if !(error is LibraryError) && !(error is CommandError), case .saveTask = command { model.timerPaused = true }
                if let invalid = error as? LibraryError, case let .invalid(violations) = invalid {
                    model.error = violations.map {
                        switch $0.code {
                        case .siblingName: "Name: another task at this location has the same name."
                        case .project: "Project: enter a trimmed name, nonnegative rate and supported currency."
                        case .task: "Task: check the name, positive whole-second budget and selected project."
                        case .allocation: "Budget allocation exceeds the constraining task’s limit. Reduce allocations or edit that task’s budget. No changes were saved."
                        default: "The edit was rejected (\($0.code.rawValue)). No changes were saved."
                        }
                    }.joined(separator: "\n")
                } else { model.error = (error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? String(describing: error) }
            }
        }
    }

    func createTask(start: Bool) {
        guard let form = sheet, let projectID = form.projectID else { return }
        guard !form.budgetEnabled || form.parsedBudget != nil else {
            error = "Budget: enter positive hours that equal whole seconds, without grouping or rounding."
            return
        }
        enqueue { model in
            guard !model.blocked, !model.terminating, let library = model.library else { return }
            guard !start || !(model.timerPaused || model.sleepObserved) else { return }
            do {
                let result = try await library.createTask(id: form.id, projectID: projectID, parentID: form.parentID,
                    name: form.name, confirmMigration: form.migrationAccepted, start: start,
                    budgetSeconds: form.budgetEnabled ? form.parsedBudget : nil)
                model.publish(result.snapshot)
                model.sheet = nil
                model.error = nil
                if let genericID = result.genericID,
                   let generic = result.snapshot.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == genericID }) {
                    model.migrationMessage = "Moved \(result.movedEntryCount) time entries and \(result.movedPendingCount) pending sleep intervals to \(model.path(for: generic)). " +
                        (start ? "Switched to the new child as requested. Undo requires the new child to have no time." : "The existing timer, if any, continues on Generic. The new child is stopped.")
                    model.canUndoMigration = true
                }
            } catch {
                if start || (form.budgetEnabled && model.runningEntry != nil) { model.timerPaused = true }
                if (try? await library.snapshot()) == nil { model.blocked = true; model.uncertainSave = true }
                let detail = (error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? String(describing: error)
                model.error = start ? "Create & Start was not confirmed. Tracking paused. Last saved checkpoint: \(model.snapshot?.activeTimer?.checkpointAt.description ?? "none"). \(detail) Stop at saved checkpoint before restarting. If blocked, reopen and inspect; never replay blindly. Your draft is preserved." : detail
            }
        }
    }
    func undoTaskMigration() {
        enqueue { model in
            guard !model.blocked, !model.terminating, let library = model.library else { return }
            do {
                model.publish(try await library.undoTaskMigration())
                model.migrationMessage = nil
                model.canUndoMigration = false
                model.error = nil
            } catch {
                if (try? await library.snapshot()) == nil { model.blocked = true; model.uncertainSave = true }
                model.error = (error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? String(describing: error)
            }
        }
    }

    var correctionEntries: [TimeEntry] {
        (snapshot?.entries ?? []).filter { $0.endAt != nil }.sorted { $0.startAt > $1.startAt }
    }
    var leafTasks: [TaskRecord] {
        (snapshot?.tasks ?? []).filter { task in
            !(snapshot?.tasks.contains { $0.parentTaskID == task.id } ?? false)
        }.sorted { path(for: $0) < path(for: $1) }
    }
    func addCorrection() {
        error = nil
        guard let task = leafTasks.first else { self.error = "Create a leaf task before adding time."; return }
        correctionSheet = CorrectionRoute(mode: .add(task.id))
    }
    func editCorrection(_ entry: TimeEntry) {
        error = nil; correctionSheet = CorrectionRoute(mode: .edit(entry))
    }
    func closeCorrection() { correctionSheet = nil; error = nil }
    func path(for taskID: UUID) -> String {
        snapshot?.tasks.first { $0.id == taskID }.map { path(for: $0) } ?? "Unavailable task"
    }
    func correctionPath(for taskID: UUID) -> String {
        guard let snapshot else { return "Unavailable task" }
        return CorrectionPlanner.path(for: taskID, in: snapshot) ?? "Unavailable task"
    }
    func reviewCorrection(form: CorrectionForm) {
        form.preview = nil
        guard let snapshot else { return }
        do {
            form.preview = try form.makePreview(snapshot: snapshot)
            error = nil
        } catch { self.error = (error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? String(describing: error) }
    }
    func stopForCorrection(entryID: UUID) {
        enqueue { model in
            guard model.runningEntry?.id == entryID else {
                model.error = "The running entry changed. Review the correction again."
                return
            }
            _ = await model.applyTimer(.stop)
        }
    }
    func applyCorrection(form: CorrectionForm) {
        guard let preview = form.preview else { return }
        form.applying = true
        enqueue { model in
            defer { form.applying = false }
            guard !model.blocked, !model.terminating, let library = model.library else { return }
            do {
                model.publish(try await library.applyCorrection(preview))
                model.canUndoCorrection = true
                model.correctionMessage = "Correction saved. Undo checks all resulting and restored rows before committing."
                model.correctionSheet = nil
                model.error = nil
            } catch { await model.correctionFailure(error, library: library) }
        }
    }
    func deleteCorrection(_ preview: DeletionPreview) {
        enqueue { model in
            guard !model.blocked, !model.terminating, let library = model.library else { return }
            do {
                model.publish(try await library.deleteCorrection(preview))
                model.canUndoCorrection = true
                model.correctionMessage = "Entry deleted. Undo is session-only and guarded against relevant changes."
                model.correctionSheet = nil
                model.error = nil
            } catch { await model.correctionFailure(error, library: library) }
        }
    }
    func undoCorrection() {
        enqueue { model in
            guard !model.blocked, !model.terminating, let library = model.library else { return }
            do {
                model.publish(try await library.undoCorrection())
                model.canUndoCorrection = false
                model.correctionMessage = "The last correction was undone."
                model.error = nil
            } catch { await model.correctionFailure(error, library: library) }
        }
    }
    private func correctionFailure(_ error: Error, library: Library) async {
        if (try? await library.snapshot()) == nil { blocked = true; uncertainSave = true }
        if error is TimerError { timerPaused = true }
        self.error = (error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? String(describing: error)
    }

    func editProject(_ project: Project? = nil) { error = nil; sheet = .project(project) }
    func newTask(project: UUID, parent: UUID? = nil) { error = nil; sheet = .task(nil, project: project, parent: parent) }
    func editTask(_ task: TaskRecord) { error = nil; sheet = .task(task, project: task.projectID, parent: task.parentTaskID) }
    func path(for task: TaskRecord) -> String {
        var names = [task.name]
        var parent = task.parentTaskID
        while let id = parent, let record = snapshot?.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == id }) {
            names.append(record.name); parent = record.parentTaskID
        }
        return names.reversed().joined(separator: " › ")
    }
    var projects: [Project] {
        (snapshot?.projects ?? []).filter { showArchived || !$0.isArchived }
            .sorted { $0.name.localizedStandardCompare($1.name) == .orderedAscending }
    }
    func tasks(project: UUID, parent: UUID?) -> [TaskRecord] {
        (snapshot?.tasks ?? []).filter { $0.projectID == project && $0.parentTaskID == parent }
            .sorted { $0.name.localizedStandardCompare($1.name) == .orderedAscending }
    }

    func timer(_ command: TimerCommand) {
        guard !terminating else { return }
        let generation = sleepGeneration
        enqueue { model in
            guard generation == model.sleepGeneration else { return }
            _ = await model.applyTimer(command)
        }
    }
    private func applyTimer(_ command: TimerCommand) async -> Bool {
        guard !blocked, let library else { return false }
        let safeStop: Bool
        if case .stopAtCheckpoint = command { safeStop = true } else { safeStop = false }
        guard !(timerPaused || sleepObserved) || safeStop else { return false }
        let generation = sleepGeneration
        do {
            publish(try await library.performTimer(command))
            if safeStop && generation == sleepGeneration { sleepObserved = false }
            timerPaused = sleepObserved
            if !sleepObserved { error = nil }
            return true
        } catch {
            timerPaused = true
            if (try? await library.snapshot()) == nil { blocked = true; uncertainSave = true }
            self.error = "Tracking paused. Last saved checkpoint: \(snapshot?.activeTimer?.checkpointAt.description ?? "none"). Attempted action: \(String(describing: command)). \((error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? String(describing: error)) Stop at saved checkpoint before restarting. If blocked, reopen and inspect; never replay blindly."
            return false
        }
    }
    func checkpoint() {
        guard !checkpointQueued, !terminating else { return }
        checkpointQueued = true
        enqueue { model in
            defer { model.checkpointQueued = false }
            guard !model.timerPaused, !model.blocked, model.runningEntry != nil else { return }
            _ = await model.applyTimer(.checkpoint)
        }
    }
    var needsTimeReview: Bool {
        timerPaused || !(snapshot?.pendingSleepIntervals.isEmpty ?? true)
    }
    // The latch is taken synchronously so an intent already queued cannot sample after sleep.
    func suspendForSleep() {
        guard let library else { return }
        library.signalSleep()
        sleepGeneration &+= 1
        sleepObserved = true
        timerPaused = true
        enqueue { model in
            guard let library = model.library else { return }
            do { model.publish(try await library.suspendTimer()) }
            catch { await model.recoveryFailure(error, library: library) }
        }
    }
    private func recoveryFailure(_ error: Error, library: Library) async {
        if (try? await library.snapshot()) == nil { blocked = true }
        timerPaused = true
        self.error = "Tracking paused. " + ((error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? String(describing: error))
    }
    func requestQuit(_ reply: @escaping @MainActor (Bool) -> Void) {
        guard !terminating else { return }
        terminating = true
        enqueue { model in
            var allow = !model.uncertainSave
            if allow && model.runningEntry != nil {
                if model.blocked { allow = model.confirmQuitPreservingRestoredTimer() }
                else if model.confirmQuit() { allow = await model.applyQuitStop() }
                else { allow = false }
            }
            if allow { await model.library?.close() }
            else { model.terminating = false }
            reply(allow)
        }
    }
    private func applyQuitStop() async -> Bool {
        await applyTimer(timerPaused ? .stopAtCheckpoint : .stop)
    }
}

struct EditorRoute: Identifiable {
    enum Kind { case project, task }
    let id: UUID
    let kind: Kind
    let isNew: Bool
    var projectID: UUID?
    var parentID: UUID?
    var name: String
    var rate: String
    var currency: String
    var confirmCurrency: String?
    var currencyAccepted = false
    var archiveRequested = false
    var migrationAccepted = false
    var budgetEnabled = false
    var budgetHours = ""
    var originalBudgetSeconds: Int64?
    var originalBudgetText = ""
    var parsedBudget: Int64? {
        if budgetHours == originalBudgetText, let originalBudgetSeconds { return originalBudgetSeconds }
        return BudgetInput.parseHours(budgetHours)
    }

    static func project(_ project: Project?) -> Self {
        Self(id: project?.id ?? UUID(), kind: .project, isNew: project == nil,
             name: project?.name ?? "", rate: RateInput.text(project?.hourlyRate ?? 0),
             currency: project?.currencyCode ?? Locale.current.currency?.identifier ?? "EUR")
    }
    static func task(_ task: TaskRecord?, project: UUID, parent: UUID?) -> Self {
        var form = Self(id: task?.id ?? UUID(), kind: .task, isNew: task == nil,
                        projectID: project, parentID: parent, name: task?.name ?? "", rate: "", currency: "")
        form.budgetEnabled = task?.budgetSeconds != nil
        form.originalBudgetSeconds = task?.budgetSeconds
        form.budgetHours = task?.budgetSeconds.map { BudgetInput.text($0) } ?? ""
        form.originalBudgetText = form.budgetHours
        return form
    }
}
```

```swift
        .onAppear { model.openWorkspace = { openWindow(id: "workspace") } }
        .sheet(item: $model.correctionSheet) { route in
            CorrectionSheet(model: model, route: route).interactiveDismissDisabled(model.isBusy)
        }

}

private struct TrackDetail: View {
    @Bindable var model: WorkspaceModel
    @AppStorage("expandedTaskIDs") private var expansion = ""
    private var expanded: Set<String> { Set(expansion.split(separator: ",").map(String.init)) }
    private func toggle(_ id: UUID) {
        var ids = expanded
        if !ids.insert(id.uuidString).inserted { ids.remove(id.uuidString) }
        expansion = ids.sorted().joined(separator: ",")
    }
    private func rows(_ project: Project) -> [(task: TaskRecord, depth: Int, path: String)] {
        var result: [(TaskRecord, Int, String)] = []
        var stack = model.tasks(project: project.id, parent: nil).reversed().map { ($0, 0, project.name) }
        while let (task, depth, prefix) = stack.popLast() {
            let path = prefix + " › " + task.name
            if model.search.isEmpty || path.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(model.search) { result.append((task, depth, path)) }
            if !model.search.isEmpty || expanded.contains(task.id.uuidString) {
                stack.append(contentsOf: model.tasks(project: project.id, parent: task.id).reversed().map { ($0, depth + 1, path) })
            }
        }
        return result
    }
    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading) {
            HStack {
                Picker("Project", selection: $model.selectedProject) {
                    Text("All projects").tag(nil as UUID?)
                    ForEach(model.projects) { project in Text(project.name).tag(Optional(project.id)) }
                }
                Toggle("Show archived projects", isOn: $model.showArchived)
            }.padding([.horizontal, .top])
            TimerControls(model: model).padding([.horizontal, .bottom])
            if let message = model.migrationMessage {
                VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                    Text(message).textSelection(.enabled)
                    Text("Undo is session-only and refuses relevant changes; checkpointing or new time can make it unavailable.")
                    Button("Undo Generic migration") { model.undoTaskMigration() }
                        .disabled(!model.canUndoMigration || model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating)
                }.padding(.horizontal).accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
            }
            if let message = model.correctionMessage {
                HStack { Text(message); Button("Undo last correction") { model.undoCorrection() }
                    .disabled(!model.canUndoCorrection || model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating) }
                    .padding(.horizontal)
            }
            if let error = model.error {
                VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                    Text(error).foregroundStyle(.red)
                    Text("Library: " + model.libraryLocation)
                    Text("For a failed edit, retry Save only while editing remains enabled. If blocked after a save, quit and reopen, inspect the saved state before re-entering anything; do not replay blindly. To restore a backup, quit all app instances and restore the entire library directory, including any journal, using Time Machine or Arq. Never replace only one file while the app is running.")
                    Button("Retry library opening") { model.retryOpen() }.disabled(!model.canRetryOpen)
                }.textSelection(.enabled).padding(.horizontal)
            }
            if model.blocked { Text("Library unavailable or existing time needs review. Editing is blocked; no uncertain time is billed.").padding(.horizontal) }
            if model.isBusy { ProgressView().controlSize(.small).padding(.horizontal) }
            if model.snapshot?.projects.isEmpty == true {
                ContentUnavailableView {
                    Label("Track your first project", systemImage: "folder.badge.plus")
                } description: { Text("Create a project, then add a task.") } actions: {
                    Button("New project…") { model.editProject() }.disabled(model.blocked || model.isBusy)
                }
            } else {
                ScrollViewReader { reader in
                    List {
                        ForEach(model.projects.filter { model.selectedProject == nil || $0.id == model.selectedProject }) { project in
                            Section {
                                ForEach(rows(project), id: \.task.id) { row in
                                    HStack {
                                        if !model.tasks(project: project.id, parent: row.task.id).isEmpty {
                                            Button { toggle(row.task.id) } label: {
                                                Image(systemName: expanded.contains(row.task.id.uuidString) ? "chevron.down" : "chevron.right")
                                            }.buttonStyle(.plain).accessibilityLabel("Toggle subtasks of \(row.task.name)")
                                        }
                                        VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                                            Text(model.search.isEmpty ? row.task.name : row.path)
                                            BudgetIndicator(model: model, task: row.task)
                                        }
                                        Spacer()
                                        if model.tasks(project: project.id, parent: row.task.id).isEmpty {
                                            Button(model.runningEntry?.taskID == row.task.id ? "Stop" : "Start") {
                                                model.timer(model.runningEntry?.taskID == row.task.id ? .stop : .start(taskID: row.task.id))
                                            }.disabled(model.timerPaused || model.terminating)
                                            .accessibilityLabel((model.runningEntry?.taskID == row.task.id ? "Stop " : "Start ") + row.path)
                                        }
                                        Button("Edit…") { model.editTask(row.task) }
                                        Button("Add subtask…") { model.newTask(project: project.id, parent: row.task.id) }
                                    }
                                    .id(row.task.id).padding(.leading, CGFloat(min(row.depth, 12)) * 14)
                                    .disabled(project.isArchived || model.blocked || model.isBusy)
                                }
                            } header: {
                                HStack {
                                    Text(project.name + (project.isArchived ? " (Archived)" : ""))
                                    Spacer()
                                    Text("\(RateInput.text(project.hourlyRate)) \(project.currencyCode)/hour")
                                    Button("Edit project…") { model.editProject(project) }
                                    if project.isArchived { Button("Restore") { model.submit(.setArchived(id: project.id, archived: false)) } }

                }

        .toolbar { Button("New project…", systemImage: "folder.badge.plus") { model.editProject() }.disabled(model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating) }
    }
}

struct TimerControls: View {
    let model: WorkspaceModel
    @Environment(\.openWindow) private var openWindow
    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading) {
            BudgetBanner(model: model)
                .onAppear { model.openWorkspace = { openWindow(id: "workspace") } }
            if model.needsTimeReview {
                Text("Unconfirmed time needs review; pending sleep is not billed.")
            }
            Text(model.timerLabel)
            if let snapshot = model.snapshot, let running = model.runningEntry {
                ForEach(snapshot.tasks.filter { task in
                    guard task.budgetSeconds != nil else { return false }
                    var cursor: UUID? = running.taskID
                    while let id = cursor {
                        if id == task.id { return true }
                        cursor = snapshot.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == id })?.parentTaskID
                    }
                    return false
                }) { BudgetIndicator(model: model, task: $0) }
            }
            TimelineView(.periodic(from: .now, by: 1)) { context in
                Text(model.elapsed(at: context.date)).monospacedDigit()
                    .accessibilityLabel("Elapsed time " + model.elapsed(at: context.date))
            }
            if model.runningEntry != nil || model.timerPaused {
                Button(model.timerPaused ? (model.runningEntry == nil ? "Reset paused timer" : "Stop at saved checkpoint") : "Stop timer") {
                    model.timer(model.timerPaused ? .stopAtCheckpoint : .stop)
                }.disabled(model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating)
            }
        }
    }
}


struct BudgetIndicator: View {
    let model: WorkspaceModel
    let task: TaskRecord
    var body: some View {
        if let budget = task.budgetSeconds {
            TimelineView(.periodic(from: .now, by: 1)) { context in
                let used = model.budgetUsage(at: context.date)[task.id, default: 0]
                let band = BudgetRules.band(used: used, budget: budget)
                let status = band == .hundred ? "Budget reached — tracking continues; overrun " + RateInput.text(max(0, used - Decimal(budget))) + " seconds" : band == .eighty ? "Budget warning — 80%" : "Below warning threshold"
                let text = model.path(for: task) + ": lifetime " + RateInput.text(used) + " / " + String(budget) + " seconds. " + status + (model.runningEntry != nil && !model.timerPaused && !model.blocked ? ". Includes provisional running time where applicable." : ". Saved time only.")
                VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                    Text(text).font(.caption)
                    ProgressView(value: min(1, NSDecimalNumber(decimal: used / Decimal(budget)).doubleValue))
                        .tint(band == .hundred ? .red : band == .eighty ? .orange : .accentColor)
                }.accessibilityElement(children: .ignore).accessibilityLabel(text)
            }
        }
    }
}

struct BudgetBanner: View {
    let model: WorkspaceModel
    @Environment(\.openWindow) private var openWindow
    var body: some View {
        if let batch = model.budgetWarnings.first {
            VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                Text(batch.summary).textSelection(.enabled)
                HStack {
                    Button("View task") {
                        openWindow(id: "workspace")
                        if let id = batch.taskIDs.first { model.revealBudgetTask(id) }
                    }
                    Button("Dismiss budget warning") { model.dismissBudgetWarning(batch.id) }
                }
            }.accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
private struct WorkspaceMenu: View {
    let model: WorkspaceModel
    @Environment(\.openWindow) private var openWindow
    @State private var search = ""
    private var choices: [TaskRecord] {
        if search.isEmpty { return model.recentTasks }
        guard let snapshot = model.snapshot else { return [] }
        return snapshot.tasks.filter { task in
            !snapshot.tasks.contains { $0.parentTaskID == task.id } &&
            snapshot.projects.contains { $0.id == task.projectID && !$0.isArchived } &&
            model.path(for: task).localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(search)
        }.sorted { model.path(for: $0) < model.path(for: $1) }
    }
    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading) {
            TimerControls(model: model)
            TextField("Search tasks", text: $search)
            Text(search.isEmpty ? "Recent tasks" : "Matching tasks").font(.headline)
            ScrollView {
                VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                    ForEach(choices) { task in
                        Button(model.path(for: task)) { model.timer(.start(taskID: task.id)) }
                            .disabled(model.isBusy || model.blocked || model.timerPaused || model.terminating)
                    }
                }
            }.frame(maxHeight: 180)
            if let error = model.error { Text(error).foregroundStyle(.red).textSelection(.enabled) }
            Button("New task…") {
                openWindow(id: "workspace")
                NSApp.activate()
                if let projectID = model.projects.first(where: { $0.id == model.selectedProject && !$0.isArchived })?.id
                    ?? model.projects.first(where: { !$0.isArchived })?.id {
                    model.newTask(project: projectID)
                }
            }.disabled(model.sheet != nil || model.correctionSheet != nil || model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating
                       || !model.projects.contains { !$0.isArchived })
            Button("New project…") {
                openWindow(id: "workspace")
                NSApp.activate()
                model.editProject()
            }.disabled(model.sheet != nil || model.correctionSheet != nil || model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating)
            Button("Add time…") {
                openWindow(id: "workspace")
                NSApp.activate()
                model.addCorrection()
            }.disabled(model.sheet != nil || model.correctionSheet != nil || model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating || model.leafTasks.isEmpty)
            Button("Open UurtjeFactuurtje") { openWindow(id: "workspace"); NSApp.activate() }
            Button("Quit UurtjeFactuurtje") { NSApp.terminate(nil) }.keyboardShortcut("q")
        }.padding().frame(width: 380)
    }
}
```

### Success Criteria:

#### Automated Verification:
- [ ] `swift test --filter Correction` passes all 11 correction tests: strict DST/offset choices, global trim/split/delete, exact displayed split IDs, stale plans, explicit running conflicts, rollback-safe undo, budget rearming, pending-sleep gates and receipt fault tests.
- [ ] Current-stage unsigned host compiles using only approved predecessors and Slice 9: `xcodebuild -project UurtjeFactuurtje.xcodeproj -scheme UurtjeFactuurtje -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS,arch=arm64' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build`. No sleep-review or report symbols are required.
- [ ] Inspect selection: only the ten declared files change; Timer.swift is explicitly unchanged, retaining generation-scoped sleep reset and TimerGate.check. All prior notification, draft recovery and uncertain-save quit guards remain intact.
- [ ] Inspect UI intent guards: changed running IDs cannot be stopped by old previews; deletion submits the displayed row/path, not a path reconstructed after queueing; failed review clears old previews; poisoned correction failures latch uncertainSave and block writes/quit success.

#### Manual Verification:
- [ ] Exact wall-time fields require an explicit instant for a repeated time and reject a gap without adjusting it; hour-plus durations and historical UTC offset labels include seconds.
- [ ] Preview shows original and proposed entry, correct source/destination project/task paths, exact durations, current project rate and all trim/split/delete rows with stable IDs.
- [ ] Running entry requires explicit stop and fresh review; deletion and guarded undo show readable identity and preserve failed-undo receipt. Change the running entry or rename the deletion task while confirmation is pending: the old intent must refuse rather than target the new state.
- [ ] Keyboard/VoiceOver can add/edit/delete/review/undo, errors retain the draft and no automatic replay occurs. Menu Add time opens the shared workspace, and cannot stack another editor. Pending/restored/paused time remains gated until Slice 10.

```swift
import Foundation

public enum SleepError: Error, Equatable, Sendable, LocalizedError {
    case staleReview, missingEnd
    public var errorDescription: String? {
        switch self {
        case .staleReview: "Time changed. Review the current interval again; nothing was applied."
        case .missingEnd: "Enter an explicit end after the sleep boundary before including time."
        }
    }
}

public struct SleepInclusion: Equatable, Sendable {
    public let pending: PendingSleepInterval
    public let correction: CorrectionPreview
    public init(pending: PendingSleepInterval, correction: CorrectionPreview) {
        self.pending = pending; self.correction = correction
    }
}

public struct InterruptionReview: Equatable, Sendable {
    public let active: ActiveTimer
    public let requestedEnd: Int64?
    public let entry: TimeEntry
    public let path: String
    public let correction: CorrectionPreview?
    public init(active: ActiveTimer, entry: TimeEntry, path: String, correction: CorrectionPreview?, requestedEnd: Int64? = nil) {
        self.active = active; self.entry = entry; self.path = path; self.correction = correction
        self.requestedEnd = requestedEnd
    }
}

struct TimeReviewReceipt: Sendable {
    let entries: CorrectionReceipt
    let pending: PendingSleepInterval?
    let active: ActiveTimer?
}

public enum SleepPlanner {
    public static func include(_ pending: PendingSleepInterval, endAt: Int64?,
                               in state: LibrarySnapshot) throws -> SleepInclusion {
        guard state.pendingSleepIntervals.contains(pending) else { throw SleepError.staleReview }
        guard let end = pending.wakeAt ?? endAt else { throw SleepError.missingEnd }
        let plan = try CorrectionPlanner.preview(.add(id: UUID(), taskID: pending.taskID,
            startAt: pending.sleepAt, endAt: end), in: state)
        return SleepInclusion(pending: pending, correction: plan)
    }

    public static func interruption(endAt: Int64?, in state: LibrarySnapshot) throws -> InterruptionReview {
        guard let active = state.activeTimer,
              let entry = state.entries.first(where: { $0.id == active.entryID }),
              let path = CorrectionPlanner.path(for: entry.taskID, in: state) else { throw SleepError.staleReview }
        let stopped = withoutRunningEntry(state)
        // nil is an explicitly confirmed discard; a same-second end is also empty.
        let correction = try endAt.flatMap { end in
            if end == entry.startAt { return nil as CorrectionPreview? }
            return try CorrectionPlanner.preview(.add(id: entry.id, taskID: entry.taskID,
                startAt: entry.startAt, endAt: end), in: stopped)
        }
        return InterruptionReview(active: active, entry: entry, path: path, correction: correction, requestedEnd: endAt)
    }

    static func withoutRunningEntry(_ state: LibrarySnapshot) -> LibrarySnapshot {
        LibrarySnapshot(schemaVersion: state.schemaVersion, revision: state.revision,
            projects: state.projects, tasks: state.tasks,
            entries: state.entries.filter { $0.id != state.activeTimer?.entryID },
            activeTimer: nil, pendingSleepIntervals: state.pendingSleepIntervals)
    }
}

extension Storage {
    func recordSleep(at timestamp: Int64, observation: UInt64, fault: CommitFault = .none) throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
        let state = try snapshot()
        guard timerGate.isCurrent(observation) else { timerNeedsReview = true; throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
        // A callback is not evidence for an already restored or failed timer.
        guard let active = state.activeTimer else { return state }
        guard active.entryID == liveEntryID, !timerNeedsReview else { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
        guard timestamp >= active.checkpointAt else { timerNeedsReview = true; throw TimerError.clockRollback }
        let id = UUID()
        do {
            let result = try transact(fault: fault) { db, before in
                guard let entry = before.entries.first(where: { $0.id == active.entryID }) else { throw SleepError.staleReview }
                try applyTimerTransition(.stop, at: timestamp, db: db, state: before)
                try db.run("INSERT INTO pending_sleep_intervals VALUES (?,?,?,NULL)",
                    [.text(id.uuidString.lowercased()), .text(entry.taskID.uuidString.lowercased()), .integer(timestamp)])
                return true
            }
            observedSleep = (id, observation)
            liveEntryID = nil
            return result.snapshot
        } catch { timerNeedsReview = true; throw error }
    }

    func recordWake(at timestamp: Int64, observation: UInt64? = nil, fault: CommitFault = .none) throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
        let generation = observation ?? timerGate.currentGeneration()
        guard timerGate.isCurrent(generation) else { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
        let state = try snapshot()
        guard let observedSleep else {
            // Idle sleep may release the gate, but never a restored/failed timer.
            if state.activeTimer == nil && state.pendingSleepIntervals.allSatisfy({ $0.wakeAt != nil }) && !timerNeedsReview {
                timerGate.reset(ifCurrent: generation)
                return state
            }
            throw TimerError.reviewRequired
        }
        guard timerGate.isCurrent(observedSleep.generation), !timerNeedsReview,
              let pending = state.pendingSleepIntervals.first(where: { $0.id == observedSleep.id && $0.wakeAt == nil }) else {
            throw TimerError.reviewRequired
        }
        guard timestamp >= pending.sleepAt else { timerNeedsReview = true; throw TimerError.clockRollback }
        do {
            let result = try transact(fault: fault) { db, before in
                let key = SQLValue.text(pending.id.uuidString.lowercased())
                if timestamp == pending.sleepAt {
                    try db.run("DELETE FROM pending_sleep_intervals WHERE id=?", [key])
                } else {
                    try db.run("UPDATE pending_sleep_intervals SET wake_at=? WHERE id=?", [.integer(timestamp), key])
                }
                try applyTimerTransition(.start(taskID: pending.taskID), at: timestamp, db: db, state: before)
                return true
            }
            self.observedSleep = nil
            liveEntryID = result.snapshot.activeTimer?.entryID
            // A later notification must remain latched even if it arrived during COMMIT.
            timerGate.reset(ifCurrent: observedSleep.generation)
            return result.snapshot
        } catch { timerNeedsReview = true; throw error }
    }

    func skipSleep(_ pending: PendingSleepInterval, observation: UInt64? = nil, fault: CommitFault = .none) throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
        let generation = observation ?? timerGate.currentGeneration()
        guard timerGate.isCurrent(generation) else { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
        let result = try transact(fault: fault) { db, state in
            guard state.pendingSleepIntervals.contains(pending) else { throw SleepError.staleReview }
            try db.run("DELETE FROM pending_sleep_intervals WHERE id=?", [.text(pending.id.uuidString.lowercased())])
            return true
        }
        timeReviewReceipt = TimeReviewReceipt(entries: CorrectionReceipt(before: [], after: []), pending: pending, active: nil)
        if observedSleep?.id == pending.id { observedSleep = nil }
        releaseReviewedGate(result.snapshot, generation: generation)
        return result.snapshot
    }

    func includeSleep(_ preview: SleepInclusion, observation: UInt64? = nil,
                      now: @Sendable () -> Int64 = { Int64(Date().timeIntervalSince1970.rounded(.down)) },
                      fault: CommitFault = .none) throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
        let timestamp = now(), generation = observation ?? timerGate.currentGeneration()
        guard timerGate.isCurrent(generation) else { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
        let liveID = liveEntryID, needsReview = timerNeedsReview
        let result = try transact(fault: fault) { db, state in
            guard state.pendingSleepIntervals.contains(preview.pending),
                  preview.correction.draft.taskID == preview.pending.taskID,
                  preview.correction.draft.startAt == preview.pending.sleepAt,
                  preview.correction.source == nil,
                  preview.pending.wakeAt == nil || preview.correction.draft.endAt == preview.pending.wakeAt else {
                throw SleepError.staleReview
            }
            guard state.activeTimer == nil || (state.activeTimer?.entryID == liveID && !needsReview) else {
                throw TimerError.reviewRequired
            }
            guard preview.correction.draft.endAt <= timestamp else { throw CorrectionError.futureEnd }
            let plan = try Self.correctionPlan(preview.correction, state: state)
            let receipt = try Self.apply(plan, db: db, state: state)
            try db.run("DELETE FROM pending_sleep_intervals WHERE id=?", [.text(preview.pending.id.uuidString.lowercased())])
            return receipt
        }
        timeReviewReceipt = TimeReviewReceipt(entries: result.value, pending: preview.pending, active: nil)
        if observedSleep?.id == preview.pending.id { observedSleep = nil }
        releaseReviewedGate(result.snapshot, generation: generation)
        return result.snapshot
    }

    func resolveInterruption(_ preview: InterruptionReview, observation: UInt64? = nil,
                             now: @Sendable () -> Int64 = { Int64(Date().timeIntervalSince1970.rounded(.down)) },
                             fault: CommitFault = .none) throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
        let timestamp = now(), generation = observation ?? timerGate.currentGeneration()
        guard timerGate.isCurrent(generation) else { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
        let result = try transact(fault: fault) { db, state in
            guard state.activeTimer == preview.active, state.entries.contains(preview.entry),
                  CorrectionPlanner.path(for: preview.entry.taskID, in: state) == preview.path else { throw SleepError.staleReview }
            guard preview.requestedEnd != nil || preview.correction == nil else { throw SleepError.staleReview }
            if let end = preview.requestedEnd {
                guard end == preview.active.checkpointAt || end <= timestamp else { throw CorrectionError.futureEnd }
                guard preview.correction?.draft.endAt == end || (end == preview.entry.startAt && preview.correction == nil) else { throw SleepError.staleReview }
            }
            let stopped = SleepPlanner.withoutRunningEntry(state)
            if let correction = preview.correction {
                guard case .add = correction.draft,
                      correction.draft.entryID == preview.entry.id,
                      correction.draft.taskID == preview.entry.taskID,
                      correction.draft.startAt == preview.entry.startAt else { throw SleepError.staleReview }
                // The durable checkpoint remains safe even after a wall-clock rollback.
                guard correction.draft.endAt == preview.active.checkpointAt || correction.draft.endAt <= timestamp else {
                    throw CorrectionError.futureEnd
                }
            }
            try db.exec("DELETE FROM active_timer")
            try db.run("DELETE FROM time_entries WHERE id=?", [.text(preview.entry.id.uuidString.lowercased())])
            let applied: CorrectionReceipt
            if let correction = preview.correction {
                applied = try Self.apply(Self.correctionPlan(correction, state: stopped), db: db, state: stopped)
            } else { applied = CorrectionReceipt(before: [], after: []) }
            return CorrectionReceipt(before: applied.before + [preview.entry], after: applied.after)
        }
        timeReviewReceipt = TimeReviewReceipt(entries: result.value, pending: nil, active: preview.active)
        liveEntryID = nil
        releaseReviewedGate(result.snapshot, generation: generation)
        return result.snapshot
    }

    func undoTimeReview(observation: UInt64? = nil, fault: CommitFault = .none) throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
        guard let receipt = timeReviewReceipt else { throw CorrectionError.undoUnavailable }
        let generation = observation ?? timerGate.currentGeneration()
        guard timerGate.isCurrent(generation) else { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
        let result = try transact(fault: fault) { db, state in
            // Restoring an interrupted timer never displaces another timer or unknown sleep.
            if receipt.active != nil {
                guard state.activeTimer == nil,
                      state.pendingSleepIntervals.allSatisfy({ $0.wakeAt != nil }) else { throw CorrectionError.undoUnavailable }
            }
            let ids = Set(receipt.entries.after.map(\.id))
            guard receipt.entries.after.allSatisfy({ state.entries.contains($0) }),
                  receipt.entries.before.allSatisfy({ row in ids.contains(row.id) || !state.entries.contains(where: { $0.id == row.id }) }) else {
                throw CorrectionError.undoUnavailable
            }
            // Validator checks restored ownership, overlap and singleton constraints before COMMIT.
            func key(_ id: UUID) -> SQLValue { .text(id.uuidString.lowercased()) }
            for row in receipt.entries.after { try db.run("DELETE FROM time_entries WHERE id=?", [key(row.id)]) }
            for row in receipt.entries.before {
                try db.run("INSERT INTO time_entries VALUES (?,?,?,?)", [key(row.id), key(row.taskID), .integer(row.startAt), row.endAt.map(SQLValue.integer) ?? .null])
            }
            if let pending = receipt.pending {
                guard !state.pendingSleepIntervals.contains(where: { $0.id == pending.id }) else { throw CorrectionError.undoUnavailable }
                try db.run("INSERT INTO pending_sleep_intervals VALUES (?,?,?,?)", [key(pending.id), key(pending.taskID), .integer(pending.sleepAt), pending.wakeAt.map(SQLValue.integer) ?? .null])
            }
            if let active = receipt.active {
                try db.run("INSERT INTO active_timer VALUES (1,?,?)", [key(active.entryID), .integer(active.checkpointAt)])
            }
            return true
        }
        timeReviewReceipt = nil
        if receipt.active != nil {
            liveEntryID = nil
            timerNeedsReview = true
        }
        if receipt.active != nil || receipt.pending?.wakeAt == nil && receipt.pending != nil {
            _ = timerGate.suspend()
            observedSleep = nil
        } else { releaseReviewedGate(result.snapshot, generation: generation) }
        return result.snapshot
    }

    private func releaseReviewedGate(_ state: LibrarySnapshot, generation: UInt64) {
        if state.activeTimer == nil && state.pendingSleepIntervals.allSatisfy({ $0.wakeAt != nil }) {
            timerNeedsReview = false
            timerGate.reset(ifCurrent: generation)
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import Testing
@testable import LibraryStore

private func sleepStore() async throws -> (Storage, URL, UUID, UUID) {
    let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
    let store = try Recovery.open(at: root), project = UUID(), a = UUID(), b = UUID()
    _ = try await store.perform(.saveProject(id: project, name: "Client", rate: 10, currency: "EUR", confirmedPreviousCurrency: nil))
    for (id, name) in [(a, "A"), (b, "B")] {
        _ = try await store.perform(.createTask(id: id, projectID: project, parentID: nil, name: name))
    }
    _ = try await store.performTimer(.start(taskID: a), now: { 100 })
    return (store, root, a, b)
}

@Test func sleepKnownIncludeSkipAndRepeatedSwitchKeepPostWakeTime() async throws {
    let (store, root, a, b) = try await sleepStore()
    defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
    let sleeping = try await store.recordSleep(at: 120, observation: store.timerGate.suspend())
    #expect(sleeping.entries[0].endAt == 120 && sleeping.activeTimer == nil)
    let wake = try await store.recordWake(at: 200)
    #expect(wake.pendingSleepIntervals[0].wakeAt == 200)
    #expect(wake.entries.first { $0.endAt == nil }?.startAt == 200)
    #expect(try BudgetRules.usage(in: wake)[a] == 20)
    _ = try await store.performTimer(.start(taskID: b), now: { 220 })
    let second = try await store.recordSleep(at: 240, observation: store.timerGate.suspend())
    #expect(second.pendingSleepIntervals.count == 2)
    let awake = try await store.recordWake(at: 300)
    let firstPending = try #require(awake.pendingSleepIntervals.first { $0.taskID == a })
    let inclusion = try SleepPlanner.include(firstPending, endAt: nil, in: awake)
    let included = try await store.includeSleep(inclusion, now: { 310 })
    #expect(included.entries.contains { $0.taskID == a && $0.startAt == 120 && $0.endAt == 200 })
    let pending = try #require(included.pendingSleepIntervals.first)
    let skipped = try await store.skipSleep(pending)
    #expect(skipped.pendingSleepIntervals.isEmpty && skipped.activeTimer == included.activeTimer)
    #expect(skipped.entries == included.entries)
    await store.close()
}
```
