```swift
import SwiftUI
import LibraryStore

struct WorkspaceView: View {
    @Bindable var model: WorkspaceModel
    @Environment(\.openWindow) private var openWindow
    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack { TrackDetail(model: model) }
        .sheet(item: $model.sheet) { _ in ProjectTaskSheets(model: model).interactiveDismissDisabled(model.isBusy) }
        .onAppear { model.openWorkspace = { openWindow(id: "workspace") } }
        .sheet(item: $model.correctionSheet) { route in
            CorrectionSheet(model: model, route: route).interactiveDismissDisabled(model.isBusy)
        }
        .frame(minWidth: 750, minHeight: 480)
    }
}

private struct TrackDetail: View {
    @Bindable var model: WorkspaceModel
    @AppStorage("expandedTaskIDs") private var expansion = ""
    private var expanded: Set<String> { Set(expansion.split(separator: ",").map(String.init)) }
    private func toggle(_ id: UUID) {
        var ids = expanded
        if !ids.insert(id.uuidString).inserted { ids.remove(id.uuidString) }
        expansion = ids.sorted().joined(separator: ",")
    }
    private func rows(_ project: Project) -> [(task: TaskRecord, depth: Int, path: String)] {
        var result: [(TaskRecord, Int, String)] = []
        var stack = model.tasks(project: project.id, parent: nil).reversed().map { ($0, 0, project.name) }
        while let (task, depth, prefix) = stack.popLast() {
            let path = prefix + " › " + task.name
            if model.search.isEmpty || path.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(model.search) { result.append((task, depth, path)) }
            if !model.search.isEmpty || expanded.contains(task.id.uuidString) {
                stack.append(contentsOf: model.tasks(project: project.id, parent: task.id).reversed().map { ($0, depth + 1, path) })
            }
        }
        return result
    }
    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading) {
            HStack {
                Picker("Project", selection: $model.selectedProject) {
                    Text("All projects").tag(nil as UUID?)
                    ForEach(model.projects) { project in Text(project.name).tag(Optional(project.id)) }
                }
                Toggle("Show archived projects", isOn: $model.showArchived)
            }.padding([.horizontal, .top])
            TimerControls(model: model).padding([.horizontal, .bottom])
            if let message = model.migrationMessage {
                VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                    Text(message).textSelection(.enabled)
                    Text("Undo is session-only and refuses relevant changes; checkpointing or new time can make it unavailable.")
                    Button("Undo Generic migration") { model.undoTaskMigration() }
                        .disabled(!model.canUndoMigration || model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating)
                }.padding(.horizontal).accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
            }
            if let message = model.correctionMessage {
                HStack { Text(message); Button("Undo last correction") { model.undoCorrection() }
                    .disabled(!model.canUndoCorrection || model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating) }
                    .padding(.horizontal)
            }
            if let error = model.error {
                VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                    Text(error).foregroundStyle(.red)
                    Text("Library: " + model.libraryLocation)
                    Text("For a failed edit, retry Save only while editing remains enabled. If blocked after a save, quit and reopen, inspect the saved state before re-entering anything; do not replay blindly. To restore a backup, quit all app instances and restore the entire library directory, including any journal, using Time Machine or Arq. Never replace only one file while the app is running.")
                    Button("Retry library opening") { model.retryOpen() }.disabled(!model.canRetryOpen)
                }.textSelection(.enabled).padding(.horizontal)
            }
            if model.blocked { Text("Library unavailable or existing time needs review. Editing is blocked; no uncertain time is billed.").padding(.horizontal) }
            if model.isBusy { ProgressView().controlSize(.small).padding(.horizontal) }
            if model.snapshot?.projects.isEmpty == true {
                ContentUnavailableView {
                    Label("Track your first project", systemImage: "folder.badge.plus")
                } description: { Text("Create a project, then add a task.") } actions: {
                    Button("New project…") { model.editProject() }.disabled(model.blocked || model.isBusy)
                }
            } else {
                ScrollViewReader { reader in
                    List {
                        ForEach(model.projects.filter { model.selectedProject == nil || $0.id == model.selectedProject }) { project in
                            Section {
                                ForEach(rows(project), id: \.task.id) { row in
                                    HStack {
                                        if !model.tasks(project: project.id, parent: row.task.id).isEmpty {
                                            Button { toggle(row.task.id) } label: {
                                                Image(systemName: expanded.contains(row.task.id.uuidString) ? "chevron.down" : "chevron.right")
                                            }.buttonStyle(.plain).accessibilityLabel("Toggle subtasks of \(row.task.name)")
                                        }
                                        VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                                            Text(model.search.isEmpty ? row.task.name : row.path)
                                            BudgetIndicator(model: model, task: row.task)
                                        }
                                        Spacer()
                                        if model.tasks(project: project.id, parent: row.task.id).isEmpty {
                                            Button(model.runningEntry?.taskID == row.task.id ? "Stop" : "Start") {
                                                model.timer(model.runningEntry?.taskID == row.task.id ? .stop : .start(taskID: row.task.id))
                                            }.disabled(model.timerPaused || model.terminating)
                                            .accessibilityLabel((model.runningEntry?.taskID == row.task.id ? "Stop " : "Start ") + row.path)
                                        }
                                        Button("Edit…") { model.editTask(row.task) }
                                        Button("Add subtask…") { model.newTask(project: project.id, parent: row.task.id) }
                                    }
                                    .id(row.task.id).padding(.leading, CGFloat(min(row.depth, 12)) * 14)
                                    .disabled(project.isArchived || model.blocked || model.isBusy)
                                }
                            } header: {
                                HStack {
                                    Text(project.name + (project.isArchived ? " (Archived)" : ""))
                                    Spacer()
                                    Text("\(RateInput.text(project.hourlyRate)) \(project.currencyCode)/hour")
                                    Button("Edit project…") { model.editProject(project) }
                                    if project.isArchived { Button("Restore") { model.submit(.setArchived(id: project.id, archived: false)) } }
                                    else { Button("New task…") { model.newTask(project: project.id) } }
                                }.disabled(model.blocked || model.isBusy)
                            }
                        }
                        Section("Time entries") {
                            Button("Add time…") { model.addCorrection() }
                                .disabled(model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating || model.leafTasks.isEmpty)
                            ForEach(model.correctionEntries) { entry in
                                HStack {
                                    VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                                        Text(model.correctionPath(for: entry.taskID))
                                        Text(CorrectionForm.display(entry))
                                    }
                                    Spacer()
                                    Button("Edit time…") { model.editCorrection(entry) }
                                }.disabled(model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating)
                            }
                        }
                    }.onChange(of: model.revealedBudgetTask, initial: true) { _, id in if let id { reader.scrollTo(id, anchor: .center) } }
                }
            }

        }
        .navigationTitle("Track")
        .searchable(text: $model.search, prompt: "Search tasks")
        .toolbar { Button("New project…", systemImage: "folder.badge.plus") { model.editProject() }.disabled(model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating) }
    }
}

struct TimerControls: View {
    let model: WorkspaceModel
    @Environment(\.openWindow) private var openWindow
    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading) {
            BudgetBanner(model: model)
                .onAppear { model.openWorkspace = { openWindow(id: "workspace") } }
            if model.needsTimeReview {
                Text("Unconfirmed time needs review; pending sleep is not billed.")
            }
            if model.needsTimeReview || model.canUndoTimeReview {
                Button("Review sleep or interrupted time…") { openWindow(id: "time-review") }
            }
            Text(model.timerLabel)
            if let snapshot = model.snapshot, let running = model.runningEntry {
                ForEach(snapshot.tasks.filter { task in
                    guard task.budgetSeconds != nil else { return false }
                    var cursor: UUID? = running.taskID
                    while let id = cursor {
                        if id == task.id { return true }
                        cursor = snapshot.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == id })?.parentTaskID
                    }
                    return false
                }) { BudgetIndicator(model: model, task: $0) }
            }
            TimelineView(.periodic(from: .now, by: 1)) { context in
                Text(model.elapsed(at: context.date)).monospacedDigit()
                    .accessibilityLabel("Elapsed time " + model.elapsed(at: context.date))
            }
            if model.runningEntry != nil || model.timerPaused {
                Button(model.timerPaused ? (model.runningEntry == nil ? "Reset paused timer" : "Stop at saved checkpoint") : "Stop timer") {
                    model.timer(model.timerPaused ? .stopAtCheckpoint : .stop)
                }.disabled(model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating)
            }
        }
    }
}


struct BudgetIndicator: View {
    let model: WorkspaceModel
    let task: TaskRecord
    var body: some View {
        if let budget = task.budgetSeconds {
            TimelineView(.periodic(from: .now, by: 1)) { context in
                let used = model.budgetUsage(at: context.date)[task.id, default: 0]
                let band = BudgetRules.band(used: used, budget: budget)
                let status = band == .hundred ? "Budget reached — tracking continues; overrun " + RateInput.text(max(0, used - Decimal(budget))) + " seconds" : band == .eighty ? "Budget warning — 80%" : "Below warning threshold"
                let text = model.path(for: task) + ": lifetime " + RateInput.text(used) + " / " + String(budget) + " seconds. " + status + (model.runningEntry != nil && !model.timerPaused && !model.blocked ? ". Includes provisional running time where applicable." : ". Saved time only.")
                VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                    Text(text).font(.caption)
                    ProgressView(value: min(1, NSDecimalNumber(decimal: used / Decimal(budget)).doubleValue))
                        .tint(band == .hundred ? .red : band == .eighty ? .orange : .accentColor)
                }.accessibilityElement(children: .ignore).accessibilityLabel(text)
            }
        }
    }
}

struct BudgetBanner: View {
    let model: WorkspaceModel
    @Environment(\.openWindow) private var openWindow
    var body: some View {
        if let batch = model.budgetWarnings.first {
            VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                Text(batch.summary).textSelection(.enabled)
                HStack {
                    Button("View task") {
                        openWindow(id: "workspace")
                        if let id = batch.taskIDs.first { model.revealBudgetTask(id) }
                    }
                    Button("Dismiss budget warning") { model.dismissBudgetWarning(batch.id) }
                }
            }.accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import Testing
@testable import LibraryStore

private func timerStore() async throws -> (Storage, URL, UUID, UUID, UUID) {
    let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
    let store = try Recovery.open(at: root)
    let p = UUID(), a = UUID(), b = UUID()
    _ = try await store.perform(.saveProject(id: p, name: "Client", rate: 10, currency: "EUR", confirmedPreviousCurrency: nil))
```

```swift
import Foundation

public enum CommandError: Error, Equatable, Sendable, LocalizedError {
    case missingRecord, archivedProject, migrationRequired, recoveryRequired
    case currencyConfirmationRequired(String), currencyChanged
    case migrationConfirmationRequired, genericNameConflict, undoUnavailable
    public var errorDescription: String? {
        switch self {
        case .missingRecord: "The record no longer exists. Reopen the form."
        case .archivedProject: "Restore this project before editing its tasks."
        case .migrationRequired: "Adding a child to a task with time requires Generic migration."
        case .recoveryRequired: "Existing timer or sleep state needs review before editing."
        case .currencyConfirmationRequired: "Confirm currency relabeling; this does not convert the rate."
        case .currencyChanged: "The project currency changed. Reopen the form and confirm again."
        case .migrationConfirmationRequired: "Confirm moving existing time and pending sleep to Generic."
        case .genericNameConflict: "Generic is needed for existing time. Choose another child name."
        case .undoUnavailable: "Cannot undo: relevant tasks, time or sleep state changed, or this session has no migration receipt."
        }
    }
}

public enum WorkspaceCommand: Sendable {
    case saveProject(id: UUID, name: String, rate: Decimal, currency: String, confirmedPreviousCurrency: String?)
    case setArchived(id: UUID, archived: Bool)
    case createTask(id: UUID, projectID: UUID, parentID: UUID?, name: String)
    case renameTask(id: UUID, name: String)
    case saveTask(id: UUID, name: String, budgetSeconds: Int64?)
}

extension Storage {
    func perform(_ command: WorkspaceCommand,
                 now: @Sendable () -> Int64 = { Int64(Date().timeIntervalSince1970.rounded(.down)) },
                 fault: CommitFault = .none) throws -> Committed<Bool> {
        let liveID = liveEntryID
        let initial = try snapshot()
        var sampled: Int64?
        if case let .saveTask(id, _, budget) = command,
           initial.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == id })?.budgetSeconds != budget,
           let active = initial.activeTimer {
            guard active.entryID == liveID, !timerNeedsReview, initial.pendingSleepIntervals.isEmpty else {
                throw CommandError.recoveryRequired
            }
            do {
                let timestamp = try timerGate.sample(now)
                guard timestamp >= active.checkpointAt else { throw TimerError.clockRollback }
                sampled = timestamp
            } catch { timerNeedsReview = true; throw error }
        }
        let timestamp = sampled
        do { return try transact(fault: fault) { db, before in
            // Only a timer established by this process can be edited around.
            guard (before.activeTimer == nil || before.activeTimer?.entryID == liveID), before.pendingSleepIntervals.isEmpty else {
                throw CommandError.recoveryRequired
            }
            func key(_ id: UUID) -> SQLValue { .text(id.uuidString.lowercased()) }
            func name(_ value: String) -> SQLValue {
                .text(value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines))
            }
            switch command {
            case let .saveProject(id, title, rate, currency, confirmed):
                let old = before.projects.first { $0.id == id }
                if let confirmed, old?.currencyCode != confirmed { throw CommandError.currencyChanged }
                if let old, old.currencyCode != currency,
                   before.entries.contains(where: { entry in before.tasks.contains { $0.id == entry.taskID && $0.projectID == id } }),
                   confirmed != old.currencyCode {
                    throw CommandError.currencyConfirmationRequired(old.currencyCode)
                }
                let values: [SQLValue] = [name(title), .text(try canonicalRate(rate)), .text(currency)]
                if old != nil {
                    try db.run("UPDATE projects SET name=?,hourly_rate=?,currency_code=? WHERE id=?", values + [key(id)])
                } else {
                    try db.run("INSERT INTO projects(name,hourly_rate,currency_code,id) VALUES (?,?,?,?)", values + [key(id)])
                }
            case let .setArchived(id, archived):
                guard before.projects.contains(where: { $0.id == id }) else { throw CommandError.missingRecord }
                if archived, let activeID = before.activeTimer?.entryID,
                   let active = before.entries.first(where: { $0.id == activeID }),
                   before.tasks.contains(where: { $0.id == active.taskID && $0.projectID == id }) {
                    throw CommandError.recoveryRequired
                }
                try db.run("UPDATE projects SET is_archived=? WHERE id=?", [.integer(archived ? 1 : 0), key(id)])
            case let .createTask(id, projectID, parentID, title):
                guard let project = before.projects.first(where: { $0.id == projectID }) else { throw CommandError.missingRecord }
                guard !project.isArchived else { throw CommandError.archivedProject }
                if let parentID {
                    guard before.tasks.contains(where: { $0.id == parentID && $0.projectID == projectID }) else {
                        throw CommandError.missingRecord
                    }
                    if before.entries.contains(where: { $0.taskID == parentID }) {
                        throw CommandError.migrationRequired
                    }
                }
                try db.run("INSERT INTO tasks(id,project_id,parent_task_id,name) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                           [key(id), key(projectID), parentID.map(key) ?? .null, name(title)])
            case let .renameTask(id, title):
                guard let task = before.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == id }),
                      let project = before.projects.first(where: { $0.id == task.projectID }) else { throw CommandError.missingRecord }
                guard !project.isArchived else { throw CommandError.archivedProject }
                try db.run("UPDATE tasks SET name=? WHERE id=?", [name(title), key(id)])
            case let .saveTask(id, title, budget):
                guard let task = before.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == id }),
                      let project = before.projects.first(where: { $0.id == task.projectID }) else { throw CommandError.missingRecord }
                guard !project.isArchived else { throw CommandError.archivedProject }
                if let timestamp { try applyTimerTransition(.checkpoint, at: timestamp, db: db, state: before) }
                try db.run("UPDATE tasks SET name=?,budget_seconds=? WHERE id=?",
                           [name(title), budget.map(SQLValue.integer) ?? .null, key(id)])
            }
            return true
        } } catch {
            if timestamp != nil, !(error is LibraryError), !(error is CommandError) { timerNeedsReview = true }
            throw error
        }
    }
}

public enum RateInput {
    public static func parse(_ text: String, locale: Locale = .current) -> Decimal? {
        let input = text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        let separator = locale.decimalSeparator ?? "."
        let parts = input.components(separatedBy: separator)
        guard (1...2).contains(parts.count),
              parts.allSatisfy({ !$0.isEmpty && $0.unicodeScalars.allSatisfy { $0.properties.generalCategory == .decimalNumber } }) else { return nil }
        let canonical = parts.map { $0.map { String($0.wholeNumberValue!) }.joined() }.joined(separator: ".")
        guard let value = Decimal(string: canonical, locale: Locale(identifier: "en_US_POSIX")),
              !value.isNaN, value >= 0 else { return nil }
        // Reject silent Decimal precision loss, while allowing redundant zeroes in user input.
        func normalized(_ string: String) -> String {
            let pieces = string.split(separator: ".", omittingEmptySubsequences: false)
            let whole = String(pieces[0].drop(while: { $0 == "0" }))
            let fraction = pieces.count == 2 ? String(String(pieces[1].reversed().drop(while: { $0 == "0" })).reversed()) : ""
            return (whole.isEmpty ? "0" : whole) + (fraction.isEmpty ? "" : "." + fraction)
        }
        guard let stored = try? canonicalRate(value), normalized(canonical) == normalized(stored) else { return nil }
        return value
    }
    public static func text(_ value: Decimal, locale: Locale = .current) -> String {
        (try? canonicalRate(value))?.replacingOccurrences(of: ".", with: locale.decimalSeparator ?? ".") ?? ""
    }
}

public struct TaskCreation: Sendable {
    public let snapshot: LibrarySnapshot
    public let genericID: UUID?
    public let movedEntryCount: Int
    public let movedPendingCount: Int
}

// Only the affected neighborhood is compared: unrelated edits must survive undo.
struct MigrationState: Equatable, Sendable {
    let tasks: [TaskRecord]
    let entries: [TimeEntry]
    let pending: [PendingSleepInterval]
    let active: ActiveTimer?

    init(_ snapshot: LibrarySnapshot, taskIDs: Set<UUID>, entryIDs: Set<UUID>, pendingIDs: Set<UUID>) {
        tasks = snapshot.tasks.filter { taskIDs.contains($0.id) || $0.parentTaskID.map(taskIDs.contains) == true }
        entries = snapshot.entries.filter { taskIDs.contains($0.taskID) || entryIDs.contains($0.id) }
        pending = snapshot.pendingSleepIntervals.filter { taskIDs.contains($0.taskID) || pendingIDs.contains($0.id) }
        let affectedEntries = entries
        active = snapshot.activeTimer.flatMap { timer in affectedEntries.contains { $0.id == timer.entryID } ? timer : nil }
    }
}

struct TaskMigrationReceipt: Sendable {
    let parentID: UUID
    let genericID: UUID
    let childID: UUID
    let expected: MigrationState
    var taskIDs: Set<UUID> { [parentID, genericID, childID] }
    var entryIDs: Set<UUID> { Set(expected.entries.map(\.id)) }
    var pendingIDs: Set<UUID> { Set(expected.pending.map(\.id)) }
}

extension Storage {
    func createTask(id: UUID, projectID: UUID, parentID: UUID?, name: String,
                    confirmMigration: Bool, start: Bool, budgetSeconds: Int64? = nil,
                    now: @Sendable () -> Int64 = { Int64(Date().timeIntervalSince1970.rounded(.down)) },
                    fault: CommitFault = .none) throws -> TaskCreation {
        let before = try snapshot()
        // Pure ownership migration may move pending references; it never resolves or bills them.
        // Restored timers and unknown ends remain blocked; known sleep stays excluded.
        guard before.activeTimer == nil || before.activeTimer?.entryID == liveEntryID else { throw CommandError.recoveryRequired }
        guard !start || (!timerNeedsReview && before.pendingSleepIntervals.allSatisfy({ $0.wakeAt != nil })) else { throw TimerError.reviewRequired }
        if before.pendingSleepIntervals.contains(where: { $0.wakeAt == nil }) {
            guard budgetSeconds == nil, let parentID,
                  before.pendingSleepIntervals.contains(where: { $0.taskID == parentID }) else {
                throw CommandError.recoveryRequired
            }
        }
        let needsCheckpoint = budgetSeconds != nil && before.activeTimer != nil && before.pendingSleepIntervals.allSatisfy({ $0.wakeAt != nil })
        if needsCheckpoint && timerNeedsReview { throw CommandError.recoveryRequired }
        let timestamp: Int64?
        do { timestamp = (start || needsCheckpoint) ? try timerGate.sample(now) : nil }
        catch { timerNeedsReview = true; throw error }
        let genericID = UUID()
        do {
            let result = try transact(fault: fault) { db, state -> (UUID?, Int, Int) in
                func key(_ id: UUID) -> SQLValue { .text(id.uuidString.lowercased()) }
                guard let project = state.projects.first(where: { $0.id == projectID }) else { throw CommandError.missingRecord }
                guard !project.isArchived else { throw CommandError.archivedProject }
                var movedEntries = 0, movedPending = 0
                if let parentID {
                    guard state.tasks.contains(where: { $0.id == parentID && $0.projectID == projectID }) else { throw CommandError.missingRecord }
                    movedEntries = state.entries.filter { $0.taskID == parentID }.count
                    movedPending = state.pendingSleepIntervals.filter { $0.taskID == parentID }.count
                }
                let migrating = movedEntries + movedPending > 0
                if migrating {
                    guard confirmMigration else { throw CommandError.migrationConfirmationRequired }
                    guard NameKey.make(name) != NameKey.make("Generic") else { throw CommandError.genericNameConflict }
                    try db.run("INSERT INTO tasks(id,project_id,parent_task_id,name) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                               [key(genericID), key(projectID), key(parentID!), .text("Generic")])
                    try db.run("UPDATE time_entries SET task_id=? WHERE task_id=?", [key(genericID), key(parentID!)])
                    try db.run("UPDATE pending_sleep_intervals SET task_id=? WHERE task_id=?", [key(genericID), key(parentID!)])
                }
                try db.run("INSERT INTO tasks(id,project_id,parent_task_id,name) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                           [key(id), key(projectID), parentID.map(key) ?? .null, .text(name.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines))])
                if let budgetSeconds {
                    try db.run("UPDATE tasks SET budget_seconds=? WHERE id=?", [.integer(budgetSeconds), key(id)])
                }
                if let timestamp {
                    if let active = state.activeTimer, timestamp < active.checkpointAt { throw TimerError.clockRollback }
                    // Validate the intermediate tree only after reconciling the new budget.
                    try reconcileWarnings(db)
                    let interim = try load(db)
                    try applyTimerTransition(start ? .start(taskID: id) : .checkpoint,
                                             at: timestamp, db: db, state: interim)
                }
                return (migrating ? genericID : nil, movedEntries, movedPending)
            }
            if let generic = result.value.0, let parentID {
                migrationReceipt = TaskMigrationReceipt(parentID: parentID, genericID: generic, childID: id,
                    expected: MigrationState(result.snapshot, taskIDs: [parentID, generic, id], entryIDs: [], pendingIDs: []))
            }
            if start { liveEntryID = result.snapshot.activeTimer?.entryID; timerNeedsReview = false }
            return TaskCreation(snapshot: result.snapshot, genericID: result.value.0,
                                movedEntryCount: result.value.1, movedPendingCount: result.value.2)
        } catch {
            if start || needsCheckpoint { timerNeedsReview = true }
            throw error
        }
    }

    func undoTaskMigration(fault: CommitFault = .none) throws -> LibrarySnapshot {
        guard let receipt = migrationReceipt else { throw CommandError.undoUnavailable }
        let result = try transact(fault: fault) { db, state in
            let current = MigrationState(state, taskIDs: receipt.taskIDs, entryIDs: receipt.entryIDs, pendingIDs: receipt.pendingIDs)
            guard current == receipt.expected,
                  !current.entries.contains(where: { $0.taskID == receipt.childID }),
                  !current.pending.contains(where: { $0.taskID == receipt.childID }),
                  !current.tasks.contains(where: { $0.parentTaskID == receipt.childID || $0.parentTaskID == receipt.genericID }),
                  state.projects.contains(where: { project in
                      project.id == current.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == receipt.parentID })?.projectID && !project.isArchived
                  }) else { throw CommandError.undoUnavailable }
            func key(_ id: UUID) -> SQLValue { .text(id.uuidString.lowercased()) }
            try db.run("UPDATE time_entries SET task_id=? WHERE task_id=?", [key(receipt.parentID), key(receipt.genericID)])
            try db.run("UPDATE pending_sleep_intervals SET task_id=? WHERE task_id=?", [key(receipt.parentID), key(receipt.genericID)])
            try db.run("DELETE FROM tasks WHERE id IN (?,?)", [key(receipt.childID), key(receipt.genericID)])
            return true
        }
        migrationReceipt = nil
        return result.snapshot
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import Testing
@testable import LibraryStore

private func wall(_ year: Int, _ month: Int, _ day: Int, _ hour: Int, _ minute: Int = 0,
                  _ second: Int = 0, zone: String) -> DateComponents {
    DateComponents(timeZone: TimeZone(identifier: zone), year: year, month: month, day: day,
                   hour: hour, minute: minute, second: second)
}

@Test func strictWallTimeRejectsGapsAndRequiresBothDSTOffsets() throws {
    let amsterdam = try #require(TimeZone(identifier: "Europe/Amsterdam"))
    var calendar = Calendar(identifier: .gregorian); calendar.timeZone = amsterdam
    #expect(CorrectionClock.resolve(wall(2026, 3, 29, 2, 30, zone: amsterdam.identifier), calendar: calendar) == .nonexistent)
    let repeated = CorrectionClock.resolve(wall(2026, 10, 25, 2, 30, zone: amsterdam.identifier), calendar: calendar)
    guard case let .ambiguous(earlier, later, firstOffset, secondOffset) = repeated else {
        Issue.record("Expected repeated local time"); return
    }
    #expect(later - earlier == 3600)
    #expect(firstOffset == 7200 && secondOffset == 3600)
    #expect(CorrectionClock.offsetText(firstOffset) == "UTC+02:00:00")
    #expect(CorrectionClock.offsetText(3600 + 19 * 60 + 32) == "UTC+01:19:32")
    var local = LocalCorrectionTime(components: wall(2026, 10, 25, 2, 30, zone: amsterdam.identifier))
    #expect(throws: CorrectionError.invalidInterval) { try local.resolve(calendar: calendar) }
    local.select(later)
    #expect(try local.resolve(calendar: calendar) == later)
    // Lord Howe uses a non-hour DST transition and a +10:30/+11:00 offset.
    let lordHowe = try #require(TimeZone(identifier: "Australia/Lord_Howe"))
    calendar.timeZone = lordHowe
    let unusual = CorrectionClock.resolve(wall(2026, 10, 4, 2, 15, zone: lordHowe.identifier), calendar: calendar)
    #expect(unusual == .nonexistent)
    guard case let .unique(normal) = CorrectionClock.resolve(wall(2026, 11, 6, 9, 0, 1, zone: amsterdam.identifier), calendar: calendar) else {
        Issue.record("Expected ordinary instant"); return
    }
    #expect(normal == 1793952001)
}
```

```swift
import Foundation

public enum ReportPeriod: Equatable, Sendable {
    case allTime, thisWeek, thisMonth
    case custom(first: DateComponents, last: DateComponents)
    case day(containing: Int64)
}

public enum ReportError: Error, Equatable, LocalizedError {
    case unavailableProject, invalidDate, reversedDates, intervalOverflow, invalidActiveEntry
    public var errorDescription: String? {
        switch self {
        case .unavailableProject: "The selected project is no longer available."
        case .invalidDate: "Choose a calendar date that exists in the displayed time zone."
        case .reversedDates: "The custom range ends before it starts."
        case .intervalOverflow: "This interval is too large to total. Correct the original time entry."
        case .invalidActiveEntry: "The running entry needs review before it can be included."
        }
    }
}

public struct ReportBounds: Equatable, Sendable {
    public let start: Int64
    public let end: Int64
    public var interval: EntryInterval? { try? EntryInterval(startAt: start, endAt: end) }
}

public enum ReportCalendar {
    public static func bounds(for period: ReportPeriod, now: Int64, calendar: Calendar,
                              firstWeekday: Int = 2) throws -> ReportBounds? {
        var calendar = calendar
        calendar.firstWeekday = firstWeekday
        func instant(_ date: Date) -> Int64 {
            Int64(date.timeIntervalSince1970.rounded(.down))
        }
        func date(_ components: DateComponents) -> Date? {
            var c = components
            c.timeZone = calendar.timeZone
            c.hour = 0; c.minute = 0; c.second = 0; c.nanosecond = 0
            guard let date = calendar.date(from: c) else { return nil }
            let check = calendar.dateComponents([.era, .year, .month, .day, .isLeapMonth], from: date)
            return (components.era == nil || check.era == components.era) && check.year == components.year &&
                check.month == components.month && check.day == components.day &&
                (components.isLeapMonth == nil || check.isLeapMonth == components.isLeapMonth) ? date : nil
        }
        func startOfDay(_ date: Date) throws -> Date {
            var components = calendar.dateComponents([.era, .year, .month, .day], from: date)
            components.hour = 0; components.minute = 0; components.second = 0; components.nanosecond = 0
            guard let start = calendar.date(from: components) else { throw ReportError.invalidDate }
            return start
        }
        func dayAfter(_ date: Date) throws -> Date {
            let start = try startOfDay(date)
            guard let next = calendar.date(byAdding: .day, value: 1, to: date) else { throw ReportError.invalidDate }
            return try startOfDay(next)
        }
        switch period {
        case .allTime: return nil
        case let .day(containing):
            let date = Date(timeIntervalSince1970: TimeInterval(containing))
            let start = try startOfDay(date)
            return ReportBounds(start: instant(start), end: instant(try dayAfter(date)))
        case .thisWeek, .thisMonth:
            let date = Date(timeIntervalSince1970: TimeInterval(now))
            let component: Calendar.Component = period == .thisWeek ? .weekOfYear : .month
            guard let interval = calendar.dateInterval(of: component, for: date) else {
                throw ReportError.invalidDate
            }
            return ReportBounds(start: instant(interval.start), end: instant(interval.end))
        case let .custom(first, last):
            guard let first = date(first), let last = date(last) else { throw ReportError.invalidDate }
            guard first <= last else { throw ReportError.reversedDates }
            return ReportBounds(start: instant(first), end: instant(try dayAfter(last)))
        }
    }

    public static func dateComponents(for date: Date, calendar: Calendar) -> DateComponents {
        calendar.dateComponents([.era, .year, .month, .day, .isLeapMonth], from: date)
    }
}

public struct ReportValue: Equatable, Sendable {
    public let closedSeconds: Int64
    public let provisionalSeconds: Int64
    public let totalSeconds: Int64
    public static let zero = ReportValue(closedSeconds: 0, provisionalSeconds: 0, totalSeconds: 0)
}

public struct ReportEntryRow: Identifiable, Equatable, Sendable {
    public var id: UUID { entry.id }
    public let entry: TimeEntry
    public let included: EntryInterval?
    public let isProvisional: Bool
    public var seconds: Int64 { included?.durationSeconds ?? 0 }
}

public struct ProjectReport: Equatable, Sendable {
    public let project: Project
    public let bounds: ReportBounds?
    public let total: ReportValue
    public let taskTotals: [UUID: ReportValue]
    public let lifetimeUsage: [UUID: Decimal]
    public let entriesByLeaf: [UUID: [ReportEntryRow]]
    public let hasRunningEntry: Bool
}

public enum ReportProjection {
    public static func project(_ projectID: UUID, in snapshot: LibrarySnapshot,
                               bounds: ReportBounds?, liveEnd: Int64? = nil) throws -> ProjectReport {
        guard let project = snapshot.projects.first(where: { $0.id == projectID }) else {
            throw ReportError.unavailableProject
        }
        let tasks = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: snapshot.tasks.map { ($0.id, $0) })
        let filter: EntryInterval?
        if let bounds {
            guard let interval = try? EntryInterval(startAt: bounds.start, endAt: bounds.end) else {
                throw ReportError.invalidDate
            }
            filter = interval
        } else { filter = nil }
        var taskTotals: [UUID: ReportValue] = [:]
        var leaves: [UUID: [ReportEntryRow]] = [:]
        var hasRunning = false
        func add(_ seconds: Int64, to id: UUID, provisional: Bool) throws {
            var cursor: UUID? = id
            var visited = Set<UUID>()
            while let taskID = cursor {
                guard visited.insert(taskID).inserted, let task = tasks[taskID] else {
                    throw LibraryError.invalid([Violation(.hierarchy, taskID)])
                }
                let old = taskTotals[taskID] ?? .zero
                let (closed, closedOverflow) = old.closedSeconds.addingReportingOverflow(provisional ? 0 : seconds)
                let (open, openOverflow) = old.provisionalSeconds.addingReportingOverflow(provisional ? seconds : 0)
                let (total, totalOverflow) = closed.addingReportingOverflow(open)
                guard !closedOverflow, !openOverflow, !totalOverflow else { throw ReportError.intervalOverflow }
                taskTotals[taskID] = ReportValue(closedSeconds: closed, provisionalSeconds: open, totalSeconds: total)
                cursor = task.parentTaskID
            }
        }
        for entry in snapshot.entries where tasks[entry.taskID]?.projectID == projectID {
            let open = entry.endAt == nil
            let end: Int64
            if let closed = entry.endAt { end = closed }
            else if snapshot.activeTimer?.entryID == entry.id {
                end = liveEnd ?? snapshot.activeTimer!.checkpointAt
            } else { throw ReportError.invalidActiveEntry }
            if open && end == entry.startAt {
                let visible = filter == nil || (entry.startAt >= bounds!.start && entry.startAt < bounds!.end)
                if visible {
                    hasRunning = true
                    leaves[entry.taskID, default: []].append(ReportEntryRow(
                        entry: entry, included: nil, isProvisional: true))
                }
                continue
            }
            guard let full = try? EntryInterval(startAt: entry.startAt, endAt: end) else {
                throw open ? ReportError.invalidActiveEntry : ReportError.intervalOverflow
            }
            guard let included = filter.map({ full.intersection($0) }) ?? full else { continue }
            if open { hasRunning = true }
            let row = ReportEntryRow(entry: entry, included: included, isProvisional: open)
            leaves[entry.taskID, default: []].append(row)
            try add(included.durationSeconds, to: entry.taskID, provisional: open)
        }
        for id in leaves.keys { leaves[id]?.sort { ($0.included?.startAt ?? $0.entry.startAt, $0.id.uuidString) < ($1.included?.startAt ?? $1.entry.startAt, $1.id.uuidString) } }
        let rootIDs = Set(snapshot.tasks.filter { $0.parentTaskID == nil }.map(\.id))
        var confirmed = Int64(0), provisional = Int64(0)
        for (id, value) in taskTotals where rootIDs.contains(id) {
            let closed = confirmed.addingReportingOverflow(value.closedSeconds)
            let open = provisional.addingReportingOverflow(value.provisionalSeconds)
            let subtotal = closed.partialValue.addingReportingOverflow(open.partialValue)
            guard !closed.overflow, !open.overflow, !subtotal.overflow else { throw ReportError.intervalOverflow }
            confirmed = closed.partialValue; provisional = open.partialValue
        }
        let total = confirmed.addingReportingOverflow(provisional)
        guard !total.overflow else { throw ReportError.intervalOverflow }
        return ProjectReport(project: project, bounds: bounds,
                             total: ReportValue(closedSeconds: confirmed, provisionalSeconds: provisional, totalSeconds: total.partialValue),
                             taskTotals: taskTotals, lifetimeUsage: try BudgetRules.usage(in: snapshot, liveEnd: liveEnd),
             entriesByLeaf: leaves, hasRunningEntry: hasRunning)
    }

    public static func amount(seconds: Int64, project: Project) -> Decimal? {
        var seconds = Decimal(seconds), rate = project.hourlyRate, product = Decimal()
        guard NSDecimalMultiply(&product, &seconds, &rate, .plain) == .noError else { return nil }
        var divisor = Decimal(3600), result = Decimal()
        let division = NSDecimalDivide(&result, &product, &divisor, .plain)
        guard division != .overflow && division != .divideByZero && division != .underflow,
              !result.isNaN else { return nil }
        return result
    }

    private static func roundedAmount(seconds: Int64, rate: Decimal, fractionDigits: Int) -> String? {
        guard !rate.isNaN, (0...38).contains(fractionDigits) else { return nil }
        var coefficient = rate.significand.magnitude
        let text = NSDecimalString(&coefficient, Locale(identifier: "en_US_POSIX"))
        guard text.utf8.allSatisfy({ (48...57).contains($0) }) else { return nil }
        let a = text.utf8.reversed().map { Int($0 - 48) }
        let b = String(seconds.magnitude).utf8.reversed().map { Int($0 - 48) }
        var digits = [Int](repeating: 0, count: a.count + b.count)
        for i in a.indices { for j in b.indices { digits[i + j] += a[i] * b[j] } }
        for i in 0..<(digits.count - 1) {
            digits[i + 1] += digits[i] / 10
            digits[i] %= 10
        }
        while digits.count > 1 && digits.last == 0 { digits.removeLast() }
        digits.reverse()
        let shift = rate.exponent + fractionDigits
        if shift > 0 { digits += repeatElement(0, count: shift) }
        var remainder = 0
        for i in digits.indices {
            let n = remainder * 10 + digits[i]
            digits[i] = n / 3600
            remainder = n % 3600
        }
        let roundUp: Bool
        if shift < 0 {
            let cut = -shift
            roundUp = cut <= digits.count && digits[digits.count - cut] >= 5
            if cut >= digits.count { digits = [0] } else { digits.removeLast(cut) }
        } else { roundUp = remainder >= 1800 }
        if roundUp {
            var i = digits.count - 1
            while i > 0 && digits[i] == 9 { digits[i] = 0; i -= 1 }
            digits[i] += 1
            if digits[0] == 10 { digits[0] = 0; digits.insert(1, at: 0) }
        }
        while digits.count > 1 && digits.first == 0 { digits.removeFirst() }
        let nonzero = digits.contains { $0 != 0 }
        if digits.count <= fractionDigits {
            digits.insert(contentsOf: repeatElement(0, count: fractionDigits + 1 - digits.count), at: 0)
        }
        var result = digits.map(String.init).joined()
        if fractionDigits > 0 { result.insert(".", at: result.index(result.endIndex, offsetBy: -fractionDigits)) }
        if nonzero && ((rate < 0) != (seconds < 0)) { result.insert("-", at: result.startIndex) }
        return result
    }

    public static func amountText(seconds: Int64, project: Project, locale: Locale = .current) -> String {
        let formatter = NumberFormatter()
        formatter.locale = locale
        formatter.numberStyle = .currency
        formatter.currencyCode = project.currencyCode
        guard let exact = roundedAmount(seconds: seconds, rate: project.hourlyRate, fractionDigits: formatter.maximumFractionDigits) else { return "Amount unavailable" }
        let negative = exact.hasPrefix("-")
        let parts = (negative ? String(exact.dropFirst()) : exact).split(separator: ".", omittingEmptySubsequences: false)
        let digitFormatter = NumberFormatter()
        digitFormatter.locale = locale
        digitFormatter.numberStyle = .decimal
        digitFormatter.usesGroupingSeparator = false
        let localized = (0...9).map { digitFormatter.string(from: NSNumber(value: $0)) ?? String($0) }
        let integer = Array(parts[0])
        let primary = formatter.groupingSize
        let secondary = formatter.secondaryGroupingSize > 0 ? formatter.secondaryGroupingSize : primary
        var rendered = ""
        for (index, digit) in integer.enumerated() {
            let remaining = integer.count - index
            if index > 0 && formatter.usesGroupingSeparator && primary > 0 && remaining >= primary && (remaining - primary) % secondary == 0 {
                rendered += formatter.groupingSeparator ?? ","
            }
            rendered += localized[digit.wholeNumberValue!]
        }
        if parts.count > 1 {
            rendered += formatter.decimalSeparator ?? "."
            for digit in parts[1] { rendered += localized[digit.wholeNumberValue!] }
        }
        if negative { rendered = (formatter.minusSign ?? "-") + rendered }
        return rendered + " " + project.currencyCode
    }

    public static func durationText(_ seconds: Int64) -> String {
        "\(seconds / 3600)h \(seconds % 3600 / 60)m \(seconds % 60)s"
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import Testing
@testable import LibraryStore

private func reportFixture(entries: [TimeEntry] = [], active: ActiveTimer? = nil,
                           pending: [PendingSleepInterval] = [],
                           rate: Decimal = 100, currency: String = "EUR") -> (LibrarySnapshot, UUID, UUID, UUID, UUID) {
    let projectID = UUID(), root = UUID(), leaf = UUID(), otherLeaf = UUID()
    let project = Project(id: projectID, name: "Client", hourlyRate: rate, currencyCode: currency)
    let tasks = [TaskRecord(id: root, projectID: projectID, name: "Root", budgetSeconds: 1000),
                 TaskRecord(id: leaf, projectID: projectID, parentTaskID: root, name: "Leaf"),
                 TaskRecord(id: otherLeaf, projectID: projectID, parentTaskID: root, name: "Other")]
    return (LibrarySnapshot(schemaVersion: 1, revision: 0, projects: [project], tasks: tasks,
                            entries: entries, activeTimer: active, pendingSleepIntervals: pending),
            projectID, root, leaf, otherLeaf)
}

private func withEntries(_ state: LibrarySnapshot, _ entries: [TimeEntry],
                         active: ActiveTimer? = nil, pending: [PendingSleepInterval] = []) -> LibrarySnapshot {
    LibrarySnapshot(schemaVersion: state.schemaVersion, revision: state.revision, projects: state.projects,
                    tasks: state.tasks, entries: entries, activeTimer: active, pendingSleepIntervals: pending)
}

private func reportCalendar(_ zone: String) -> Calendar {
    var calendar = Calendar(identifier: .gregorian)
    calendar.timeZone = TimeZone(identifier: zone)!
    calendar.locale = Locale(identifier: "en_US_POSIX")
    return calendar
}

private func reportDate(_ year: Int, _ month: Int, _ day: Int, _ hour: Int = 0, _ minute: Int = 0,
                        calendar: Calendar) -> Int64 {
    Int64(calendar.date(from: DateComponents(year: year, month: month, day: day, hour: hour, minute: minute))!.timeIntervalSince1970)
}

    let first = DateComponents(year: 2025, month: 3, day: 29)
```

```swift
import SwiftUI
import LibraryStore

struct ReportsView: View {
    @Environment(\.openWindow) private var openWindow
    @Bindable var model: WorkspaceModel
    private var expandedText: String {
        get { model.reportExpandedText }
        nonmutating set { model.reportExpandedText = newValue }
    }
    private var selectedLeaf: UUID? {
        get { model.reportSelectedLeaf }
        nonmutating set { model.reportSelectedLeaf = newValue }
    }
    @State private var customStart = Date()
    @State private var customEnd = Date()
    private var calendar: Calendar { Calendar.current }
    private var expanded: Set<UUID> { Set(expandedText.split(separator: ",").compactMap { UUID(uuidString: String($0)) }) }
    private func evaluate(at date: Date) -> Result<ProjectReport?, Error> {
        Result {
            guard let id = model.reportProjectID, let snapshot = model.snapshot else { return nil }
            let bounds = try ReportCalendar.bounds(for: model.reportPeriod, now: model.reportNow(at: date),
                                                   calendar: calendar, firstWeekday: 2)
            return try ReportProjection.project(id, in: snapshot, bounds: bounds, liveEnd: model.reportLiveEnd(at: date))
        }
    }
    private func periodBinding() -> Binding<Int> {
        Binding(get: {
            switch model.reportPeriod { case .allTime: 0; case .thisWeek: 1; case .thisMonth: 2; case .custom: 3; case .day: 4 }
        }, set: { choice in
            model.reportPeriod = switch choice { case 0: .allTime; case 1: .thisWeek; case 2: .thisMonth;
                default: .custom(first: ReportCalendar.dateComponents(for: customStart, calendar: calendar),
                                 last: ReportCalendar.dateComponents(for: customEnd, calendar: calendar)) }
        })
    }
    private func taskRows(_ projectID: UUID) -> [(task: TaskRecord, depth: Int)] {
        var result: [(TaskRecord, Int)] = []
        var stack = model.tasks(project: projectID, parent: nil).reversed().map { ($0, 0) }
        while let (task, depth) = stack.popLast() {
            result.append((task, depth))
            if expanded.contains(task.id) {
                stack.append(contentsOf: model.tasks(project: projectID, parent: task.id).reversed().map { ($0, depth + 1) })
            }
        }
        return result
    }
    var body: some View {
        TimelineView(.periodic(from: .now, by: 1)) { context in
            ScrollView(.vertical) { content(at: context.date) }
        }
        .padding().navigationTitle("Reports · Project")
        .onAppear {
            if let dates = model.reportCustomDates { customStart = dates.first; customEnd = dates.last }
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder private func content(at date: Date) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
            BudgetBanner(model: model)
            if model.needsTimeReview || model.canUndoTimeReview {
                Button("Review sleep or interrupted time…") { openWindow(id: "time-review") }
            }
            if let message = model.correctionMessage {
                HStack { Text(message); Button("Undo last correction") { model.undoCorrection() }
                    .disabled(!model.canUndoCorrection || model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating) }
            }
            if let error = model.error { Text(error).foregroundStyle(.red).textSelection(.enabled) }
            ScrollView(.horizontal) {
              HStack {
                Picker("Project", selection: Binding(get: { model.reportProjectID }, set: {
                    model.openProjectReport($0)
                })) {
                    Text("Choose a project").tag(Optional<UUID>.none)
                    ForEach(model.reportProjects) { project in
                        Text(project.name + (project.isArchived ? " (Archived)" : "")).tag(Optional(project.id))
                    }
                }
                if model.reportProjects.isEmpty { Text("No project available").foregroundStyle(.secondary) }
                Picker("Period", selection: periodBinding()) {
                    Text("All time").tag(0); Text("This week").tag(1); Text("This month").tag(2); Text("Custom range").tag(3)
                    if case .day = model.reportPeriod { Text("Selected day").tag(4) }
                }
                Toggle("Show archived projects", isOn: $model.showReportArchived)
              }.fixedSize(horizontal: true, vertical: false)
            }
            if case .custom = model.reportPeriod {
              ScrollView(.horizontal) {
                HStack {
                    DatePicker("First day", selection: $customStart, displayedComponents: .date)
                    DatePicker("Last day", selection: $customEnd, displayedComponents: .date)
                    Button("Apply range") {
                        model.reportPeriod = .custom(first: ReportCalendar.dateComponents(for: customStart, calendar: calendar),
                                                    last: ReportCalendar.dateComponents(for: customEnd, calendar: calendar))
                    }
                }.fixedSize(horizontal: true, vertical: false)
              }
            }
            if let bounds = try? ReportCalendar.bounds(for: model.reportPeriod, now: model.reportNow(at: date), calendar: calendar) {
                Text("Period: \(CorrectionForm.text(bounds.start, zone: calendar.timeZone)) through \(CorrectionForm.text(bounds.end, zone: calendar.timeZone)) (end excluded)")
                    .font(.caption)
            }
            Text("Time zone: \(calendar.timeZone.identifier). Budget column shows lifetime usage, not this period. Current project rates apply to all tracked hours.").font(.caption)
            switch evaluate(at: date) {
            case let .success(report):
                if let report { reportContent(report, at: date) }
                else { ContentUnavailableView("No project report", systemImage: "chart.bar",
                    description: Text(model.reportProjects.isEmpty ? "Create a project, or show archived projects." : "Choose a project.")) }
            case let .failure(error): Text(error.localizedDescription).foregroundStyle(.red)
            }
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder private func reportContent(_ report: ProjectReport, at date: Date) -> some View {
        summary(report, at: date)
        if report.project.isArchived {
            Button("Restore project") { model.submit(.setArchived(id: report.project.id, archived: false)) }
                .disabled(model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating)
        }
        ScrollView(.horizontal) {
            VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                HStack { Text("Task"); Spacer(); Text("Hours"); Text("Amount"); Text("Budget — lifetime") }.font(.headline)
                List {
                    ForEach(taskRows(report.project.id), id: \.task.id) { row in taskRow(row.task, depth: row.depth, report: report) }
                }.frame(minWidth: 760, minHeight: 150)
            }
        }
        if let selectedLeaf, let task = model.snapshot?.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == selectedLeaf && $0.projectID == report.project.id }),
           model.tasks(project: task.projectID, parent: task.id).isEmpty {
            entryDetails(task, report: report)
        } else { Text("Select a leaf task to inspect its entries.").foregroundStyle(.secondary) }
    }

    @ViewBuilder private func summary(_ report: ProjectReport, at date: Date) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading) {
            Text("Total \(ReportProjection.durationText(report.total.totalSeconds)) · \(ReportProjection.amountText(seconds: report.total.totalSeconds, project: report.project))").font(.title2)
            Text("Confirmed closed: \(ReportProjection.durationText(report.total.closedSeconds)) · \(ReportProjection.amountText(seconds: report.total.closedSeconds, project: report.project))")
            if report.total.provisionalSeconds > 0 || report.hasRunningEntry {
                Text("Running — entire open entry provisional: \(ReportProjection.durationText(report.total.provisionalSeconds)) · \(ReportProjection.amountText(seconds: report.total.provisionalSeconds, project: report.project))")
            }
            if model.reportLiveEnd(at: date) == nil && report.hasRunningEntry {
                Text("Tracking paused/review required; recorded through the durable checkpoint.")
            }
            Text("Current rate \(RateInput.text(report.project.hourlyRate)) \(report.project.currencyCode)/hour. Rows are rounded independently; displayed child amounts may not add exactly to the parent.").font(.caption)
        }.accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
    }

    @ViewBuilder private func taskRow(_ task: TaskRecord, depth: Int, report: ProjectReport) -> some View {
        let children = model.tasks(project: task.projectID, parent: task.id)
        let seconds = report.taskTotals[task.id]?.totalSeconds ?? 0
        HStack {
            if !children.isEmpty {
                Button {
                    var ids = expanded
                    if !ids.insert(task.id).inserted { ids.remove(task.id) }
                    expandedText = ids.map(\.uuidString).sorted().joined(separator: ",")
                } label: { Image(systemName: expanded.contains(task.id) ? "chevron.down" : "chevron.right") }
                    .buttonStyle(.plain).accessibilityLabel("Toggle subtasks of \(task.name)")
                    .accessibilityValue(expanded.contains(task.id) ? "Expanded" : "Collapsed")
            }
            Text("Level \(depth + 1)").font(.caption)
            Button { if children.isEmpty { selectedLeaf = task.id } } label: { Text(task.name).foregroundStyle(.primary) }
                .buttonStyle(.plain).disabled(!children.isEmpty)
            Spacer()
            Text(ReportProjection.durationText(seconds))
            Text(ReportProjection.amountText(seconds: seconds, project: report.project))
            if let budget = task.budgetSeconds {
                let used = report.lifetimeUsage[task.id, default: 0]
                let band = BudgetRules.band(used: used, budget: budget)
                let over = max(0, used - Decimal(budget))
                let hours = RateInput.text(used / 3600)
                let status = band == .hundred ? "100% reached; overrun " + RateInput.text(over / 3600) + " hours, tracking continues" : band == .eighty ? "80% warning" : "below 80%"
                Text("\(hours) / \(BudgetInput.text(budget)) hours; \(status)")
            } else { Text("—") }
        }.padding(.leading, CGFloat(min(depth, 12)) * 14)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
        .accessibilityHint(children.isEmpty ? "Leaf task; select for entry details" : "Parent subtotal; entries are counted once")
    }

    @ViewBuilder private func entryDetails(_ task: TaskRecord, report: ProjectReport) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading) {
            Text("Entries · \(model.path(for: task))").font(.headline)
            let rows = report.entriesByLeaf[task.id] ?? []
            if rows.isEmpty { Text("No entries in this period. Lifetime budgets are unchanged.") }
            ScrollView(.horizontal) {
              List(rows) { row in
                HStack {
                    VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                        Text(row.isProvisional ? CorrectionForm.text(row.entry.startAt, zone: .current) + " · running · UTC second \(row.entry.startAt)" : CorrectionForm.display(row.entry) + " · UTC seconds \(row.entry.startAt)–\(row.entry.endAt!)")
                        Text("In selected period: \(ReportProjection.durationText(row.seconds)) · current rate \(RateInput.text(report.project.hourlyRate)) \(report.project.currencyCode)/hour" + (row.isProvisional ? " · Running — provisional; full open entry" : ""))
                    }
                    Text(ReportProjection.amountText(seconds: row.seconds, project: report.project))
                    if !row.isProvisional { Button("Edit selected…") { model.editCorrection(row.entry) }
                        .disabled(model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating) }
                    else { Text("Stop and review before editing").font(.caption) }
                }.accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
              }.frame(minWidth: 760, minHeight: 100, maxHeight: 220)
            }
            if let running = rows.first(where: \.isProvisional)?.entry {
                if !model.timerPaused {
                    Button("Stop running timer") { model.stopReportTimer(entryID: running.id) }
                        .disabled(model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating)
                }
            }
            HStack {
                Button("Add time…") { model.addCorrection(taskID: task.id) }
                    .disabled(model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating || model.timerPaused)
                Button("Stop timer") { model.stopReportTimer(entryID: rows.first(where: \.isProvisional)?.entry.id) }
                    .disabled(model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating || model.timerPaused || !rows.contains(where: \.isProvisional))
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
            timerPaused = true
            if (try? await library.snapshot()) == nil { blocked = true; uncertainSave = true }
            self.error = "Tracking paused. Last saved checkpoint: \(snapshot?.activeTimer?.checkpointAt.description ?? "none"). Attempted action: \(String(describing: command)). \((error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? String(describing: error)) Stop at saved checkpoint before restarting. If blocked, reopen and inspect; never replay blindly."
            return false
        }
    }
    func checkpoint() {
        guard !checkpointQueued, !terminating else { return }
        checkpointQueued = true
        enqueue { model in
            defer { model.checkpointQueued = false }
            guard !model.timerPaused, !model.blocked, model.runningEntry != nil else { return }
            _ = await model.applyTimer(.checkpoint)
        }
    }
    var needsTimeReview: Bool {
        timerPaused || !(snapshot?.pendingSleepIntervals.isEmpty ?? true)
    }
    func suspendForSleep(at timestamp: Int64) {
        guard let library else { return }
        let observation = library.signalSleep()
        sleepGeneration &+= 1
        let generation = sleepGeneration
        sleepObserved = true
        timerPaused = true
        enqueue { model in
            do { model.publish(try await library.recordSleep(at: timestamp, observation: observation)) }
            catch { await model.recoveryFailure(error, library: library, generation: generation) }
        }
    }
    func wakeFromSleep(at timestamp: Int64) {
        guard let library else { return }
        let observation = library.sleepObservation()
        let generation = sleepGeneration
        enqueue { model in
            guard generation == model.sleepGeneration, let library = model.library else { return }
            do {
                model.publish(try await library.recordWake(at: timestamp, observation: observation))
                guard generation == model.sleepGeneration else { return }
                model.sleepObserved = false
                // A failed sleep save is not repaired by a later wake observation.
                model.timerPaused = false
            } catch { await model.recoveryFailure(error, library: library, generation: generation) }
        }
    }
    func resolveSleep(_ pending: PendingSleepInterval, inclusion: SleepInclusion?) {
        guard let library else { return }
        let observation = library.sleepObservation()
        let generation = sleepGeneration
        enqueue { model in
            guard generation == model.sleepGeneration, !model.blocked, !model.terminating, let library = model.library else { return }
            do {
                let next: LibrarySnapshot
                if let inclusion { next = try await library.includeSleep(inclusion, observation: observation) }
                else { next = try await library.skipSleep(pending, observation: observation) }
                model.publish(next)
                model.canUndoTimeReview = true
                model.finishTimeReview(generation: generation)
            } catch { await model.recoveryFailure(error, library: library, generation: generation) }
        }
    }
    func resolveInterrupted(_ preview: InterruptionReview) {
        guard let library else { return }
        let observation = library.sleepObservation()
        let generation = sleepGeneration
        enqueue { model in
            guard generation == model.sleepGeneration, !model.blocked, !model.terminating, let library = model.library else { return }
            do {
                model.publish(try await library.resolveInterruption(preview, observation: observation))
                model.restoredTimer = false
                model.canUndoTimeReview = true
                model.finishTimeReview(generation: generation)
            } catch { await model.recoveryFailure(error, library: library, generation: generation) }
        }
    }
    func undoTimeReview() {
        guard let library else { return }
        let observation = library.sleepObservation()
        let generation = sleepGeneration
        enqueue { model in
            guard generation == model.sleepGeneration, !model.blocked, !model.terminating, let library = model.library else { return }
            do {
                let previousActive = model.snapshot?.activeTimer
                model.publish(try await library.undoTimeReview(observation: observation))
                model.canUndoTimeReview = false
                if previousActive == nil && model.snapshot?.activeTimer != nil {
                    // Storage returns no live provenance for a restored interrupted entry.
                    model.restoredTimer = true
                    model.timerPaused = true
                }
                if model.snapshot?.pendingSleepIntervals.contains(where: { $0.wakeAt == nil }) == true { model.timerPaused = true }
                model.error = nil
            } catch { await model.recoveryFailure(error, library: library, generation: generation) }
        }
    }
    private func finishTimeReview(generation: UInt64) {
        guard generation == sleepGeneration else { return }
        if snapshot?.activeTimer == nil && snapshot?.pendingSleepIntervals.allSatisfy({ $0.wakeAt != nil }) == true {
            timerPaused = false; sleepObserved = false
        }
        error = nil
    }
    private func recoveryFailure(_ error: Error, library: Library, generation: UInt64) async {
        guard generation == sleepGeneration else { return }
        // A review failure pauses the same process timer in storage as well as presentation.
        _ = library.signalSleep()
        _ = try? await library.suspendTimer()
        if (try? await library.snapshot()) == nil { blocked = true; uncertainSave = true }
        timerPaused = true
        recoveryFailureID &+= 1
        self.error = "Time review was not confirmed. Your input is retained. Reopen and inspect if the library is unavailable; never replay blindly. " +
            ((error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? String(describing: error))
    }
    func requestQuit(_ reply: @escaping @MainActor (Bool) -> Void) {
        guard !terminating else { return }
        terminating = true
        enqueue { model in
            var allow = !model.uncertainSave
            if allow && model.runningEntry != nil {
                if model.restoredTimer { allow = model.confirmQuitPreservingRestoredTimer() }
                else if model.confirmQuit() { allow = await model.applyQuitStop() }
                else { allow = false }
            }
            if allow { await model.library?.close() }
            else { model.terminating = false }
            reply(allow)
        }
    }
    private func applyQuitStop() async -> Bool {
        await applyTimer(timerPaused ? .stopAtCheckpoint : .stop)
    }
}

struct EditorRoute: Identifiable {
    enum Kind { case project, task }
    let id: UUID
    let kind: Kind
    let isNew: Bool
    var projectID: UUID?
    var parentID: UUID?
    var name: String
    var rate: String
    var currency: String
    var confirmCurrency: String?
    var currencyAccepted = false
    var archiveRequested = false
    var migrationAccepted = false
    var budgetEnabled = false
    var budgetHours = ""
    var originalBudgetSeconds: Int64?
    var originalBudgetText = ""
    var parsedBudget: Int64? {
        if budgetHours == originalBudgetText, let originalBudgetSeconds { return originalBudgetSeconds }
        return BudgetInput.parseHours(budgetHours)
    }

    static func project(_ project: Project?) -> Self {
        Self(id: project?.id ?? UUID(), kind: .project, isNew: project == nil,
             name: project?.name ?? "", rate: RateInput.text(project?.hourlyRate ?? 0),
             currency: project?.currencyCode ?? Locale.current.currency?.identifier ?? "EUR")
    }
    static func task(_ task: TaskRecord?, project: UUID, parent: UUID?) -> Self {
        var form = Self(id: task?.id ?? UUID(), kind: .task, isNew: task == nil,
                        projectID: project, parentID: parent, name: task?.name ?? "", rate: "", currency: "")
        form.budgetEnabled = task?.budgetSeconds != nil
        form.originalBudgetSeconds = task?.budgetSeconds
        form.budgetHours = task?.budgetSeconds.map { BudgetInput.text($0) } ?? ""
        form.originalBudgetText = form.budgetHours
        return form
    }
}
```
