    func retryOpen() {
        guard library == nil else { return }
        enqueue { model in
            do {
                let directory = try FileManager.default.url(for: .applicationSupportDirectory, in: .userDomainMask,
                                                           appropriateFor: nil, create: true).appendingPathComponent("UurtjeFactuurtje", isDirectory: true)
                model.libraryLocation = directory.appendingPathComponent("library.sqlite").path
                let library = try await Task.detached {
                    try Library.open(at: directory)
                }.value
                model.library = library
                model.snapshot = try await library.snapshot()
                model.restoredTimer = model.snapshot?.activeTimer != nil
                model.blocked = false
                model.timerPaused = model.restoredTimer || model.snapshot?.pendingSleepIntervals.contains { $0.wakeAt == nil } == true
                model.error = nil

                    model.pendingBudgetTarget = nil
                    model.revealBudgetTask(target)
                }
            } catch { model.blocked = true; model.error = String(describing: error) }
        }
    }

    private func enqueue(_ operation: @escaping @MainActor (WorkspaceModel) async -> Void) {
        let previous = tail
        queued += 1
        isBusy = true
        tail = Task { @MainActor in
            await previous?.value
            await operation(self)
            queued -= 1
            isBusy = queued != 0
        }
    }

    func submit(_ command: WorkspaceCommand, next: EditorRoute? = nil) {
        enqueue { model in
            guard !model.blocked, !model.terminating, let library = model.library else { return }
            do {
                model.publish(try await library.perform(command))
                if model.suspendedBudgetDraft != nil { model.finishTaskSheet() }
                else { model.sheet = next }
                model.error = nil
            } catch let CommandError.currencyConfirmationRequired(previous) {
                model.sheet?.confirmCurrency = previous
            } catch {
                // A poisoned store cannot supply a snapshot: stop writes, never replay the form.
                if (try? await library.snapshot()) == nil { model.blocked = true; model.uncertainSave = true }
                if error is TimerError { model.timerPaused = true }
                if !(error is LibraryError) && !(error is CommandError), case .saveTask = command { model.timerPaused = true }
                if let invalid = error as? LibraryError, case let .invalid(violations) = invalid {
                    model.error = violations.map {
                        switch $0.code {
                        case .siblingName: "Name: another task at this location has the same name."
                        case .project: "Project: enter a trimmed name, nonnegative rate and supported currency."
                        case .task: "Task: check the name, positive whole-second budget and selected project."
                        case .allocation: "Budget allocation exceeds the constraining task’s limit. Reduce allocations or edit that task’s budget. No changes were saved."
                        default: "The edit was rejected (\($0.code.rawValue)). No changes were saved."
                        }
                    }.joined(separator: "\n")
                } else { model.error = (error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? String(describing: error) }
            }
        }
    }

    func createTask(start: Bool) {
        guard let form = sheet, let projectID = form.projectID else { return }
        guard !form.budgetEnabled || form.parsedBudget != nil else {
            error = "Budget: enter positive hours that equal whole seconds, without grouping or rounding."
            return
        }
        enqueue { model in
            guard !model.blocked, !model.terminating, let library = model.library else { return }
            guard !start || !(model.timerPaused || model.sleepObserved) else { return }
            do {
                let result = try await library.createTask(id: form.id, projectID: projectID, parentID: form.parentID,
                    name: form.name, confirmMigration: form.migrationAccepted, start: start,
                    budgetSeconds: form.budgetEnabled ? form.parsedBudget : nil)
                model.publish(result.snapshot)
                model.sheet = nil
                model.error = nil
                if let genericID = result.genericID,
                   let generic = result.snapshot.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == genericID }) {
                    model.migrationMessage = "Moved \(result.movedEntryCount) time entries and \(result.movedPendingCount) pending sleep intervals to \(model.path(for: generic)). " +
                        (start ? "Switched to the new child as requested. Undo requires the new child to have no time." : "The existing timer, if any, continues on Generic. The new child is stopped.")
                    model.canUndoMigration = true
                }
            } catch {
                if start || (form.budgetEnabled && model.runningEntry != nil) { model.timerPaused = true }
                if (try? await library.snapshot()) == nil { model.blocked = true; model.uncertainSave = true }
                let detail = (error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? String(describing: error)
                model.error = start ? "Create & Start was not confirmed. Tracking paused. Last saved checkpoint: \(model.snapshot?.activeTimer?.checkpointAt.description ?? "none"). \(detail) Stop at saved checkpoint before restarting. If blocked, reopen and inspect; never replay blindly. Your draft is preserved." : detail
            }
        }
    }
    func undoTaskMigration() {
        enqueue { model in
            guard !model.blocked, !model.terminating, let library = model.library else { return }
            do {
                model.publish(try await library.undoTaskMigration())
                model.migrationMessage = nil
                model.canUndoMigration = false
                model.error = nil
            } catch {
                if (try? await library.snapshot()) == nil { model.blocked = true; model.uncertainSave = true }
                model.error = (error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? String(describing: error)
            }
        }
    }

    var correctionEntries: [TimeEntry] {
        (snapshot?.entries ?? []).filter { $0.endAt != nil }.sorted { $0.startAt > $1.startAt }

    var leafTasks: [TaskRecord] {
        (snapshot?.tasks ?? []).filter { task in
            !(snapshot?.tasks.contains { $0.parentTaskID == task.id } ?? false)
        }.sorted { path(for: $0) < path(for: $1) }
    }
    func addCorrection() {
        error = nil
        guard let task = leafTasks.first else { self.error = "Create a leaf task before adding time."; return }
        correctionSheet = CorrectionRoute(mode: .add(task.id))
    }
    func editCorrection(_ entry: TimeEntry) {
        error = nil; correctionSheet = CorrectionRoute(mode: .edit(entry))
    }
    func closeCorrection() { correctionSheet = nil; error = nil }
    func path(for taskID: UUID) -> String {

    }
    func correctionPath(for taskID: UUID) -> String {

    func reviewCorrection(form: CorrectionForm) {
        form.preview = nil
        guard let snapshot else { return }

            form.preview = try form.makePreview(snapshot: snapshot)

        } catch { self.error = (error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? String(describing: error) }

    func stopForCorrection(entryID: UUID) {

            guard model.runningEntry?.id == entryID else {

    func applyCorrection(form: CorrectionForm) {
        guard let preview = form.preview else { return }

            defer { form.applying = false }

                model.correctionSheet = nil

    func deleteCorrection(_ preview: DeletionPreview) {

            do {
                model.publish(try await library.deleteCorrection(preview))

    private func correctionFailure(_ error: Error, library: Library) async {

    enum Destination: String { case track, reports }

        let generation = sleepGeneration

    private func applyTimer(_ command: TimerCommand) async -> Bool {
        guard !blocked, let library else { return false }
        let safeStop: Bool
        if case .stopAtCheckpoint = command { safeStop = true } else { safeStop = false }
        guard !(timerPaused || sleepObserved) || safeStop else { return false }
        let generation = sleepGeneration
        do {
            publish(try await library.performTimer(command))
            if safeStop && generation == sleepGeneration { sleepObserved = false }
            timerPaused = sleepObserved
            if !sleepObserved { error = nil }
            return true
        } catch {
            timerPaused = true
            if (try? await library.snapshot()) == nil { blocked = true; uncertainSave = true }
            self.error = "Tracking paused. Last saved checkpoint: \(snapshot?.activeTimer?.checkpointAt.description ?? "none"). Attempted action: \(String(describing: command)). \((error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? String(describing: error)) Stop at saved checkpoint before restarting. If blocked, reopen and inspect; never replay blindly."
            return false
        }
    }
    func checkpoint() {
        guard !checkpointQueued, !terminating else { return }
        checkpointQueued = true
        enqueue { model in
            defer { model.checkpointQueued = false }
            guard !model.timerPaused, !model.blocked, model.runningEntry != nil else { return }
            _ = await model.applyTimer(.checkpoint)

    var needsTimeReview: Bool {

    }
    func suspendForSleep(at timestamp: Int64) {
        guard let library else { return }
        let observation = library.signalSleep()
        sleepGeneration &+= 1
        let generation = sleepGeneration
        sleepObserved = true
        timerPaused = true
        enqueue { model in
            do { model.publish(try await library.recordSleep(at: timestamp, observation: observation)) }
            catch { await model.recoveryFailure(error, library: library, generation: generation) }
        }
    }
    func wakeFromSleep(at timestamp: Int64) {
        guard let library else { return }
        let observation = library.sleepObservation()
        let generation = sleepGeneration
        enqueue { model in
            guard generation == model.sleepGeneration, let library = model.library else { return }
            do {
                model.publish(try await library.recordWake(at: timestamp, observation: observation))
                guard generation == model.sleepGeneration else { return }
                model.sleepObserved = false
                // A failed sleep save is not repaired by a later wake observation.
                model.timerPaused = false
            } catch { await model.recoveryFailure(error, library: library, generation: generation) }
        }
    }
    func resolveSleep(_ pending: PendingSleepInterval, inclusion: SleepInclusion?) {
        guard let library else { return }
        let observation = library.sleepObservation()
        let generation = sleepGeneration
        enqueue { model in
            guard generation == model.sleepGeneration, !model.blocked, !model.terminating, let library = model.library else { return }
            do {
                let next: LibrarySnapshot
                if let inclusion { next = try await library.includeSleep(inclusion, observation: observation) }
                else { next = try await library.skipSleep(pending, observation: observation) }
                model.publish(next)
                model.canUndoTimeReview = true
                model.finishTimeReview(generation: generation)
            } catch { await model.recoveryFailure(error, library: library, generation: generation) }
        }
    }
    func resolveInterrupted(_ preview: InterruptionReview) {
        guard let library else { return }
        let observation = library.sleepObservation()
        let generation = sleepGeneration
        enqueue { model in
            guard generation == model.sleepGeneration, !model.blocked, !model.terminating, let library = model.library else { return }
            do {
                model.publish(try await library.resolveInterruption(preview, observation: observation))
                model.restoredTimer = false
                model.canUndoTimeReview = true
                model.finishTimeReview(generation: generation)
            } catch { await model.recoveryFailure(error, library: library, generation: generation) }
        }
    }
    func undoTimeReview() {
        guard let library else { return }
        let observation = library.sleepObservation()
        let generation = sleepGeneration
        enqueue { model in
            guard generation == model.sleepGeneration, !model.blocked, !model.terminating, let library = model.library else { return }
            do {
                let previousActive = model.snapshot?.activeTimer
                model.publish(try await library.undoTimeReview(observation: observation))
                model.canUndoTimeReview = false
                if previousActive == nil && model.snapshot?.activeTimer != nil {
                    // Storage returns no live provenance for a restored interrupted entry.
                    model.restoredTimer = true
                    model.timerPaused = true
                }
                if model.snapshot?.pendingSleepIntervals.contains(where: { $0.wakeAt == nil }) == true { model.timerPaused = true }
                model.error = nil
            } catch { await model.recoveryFailure(error, library: library, generation: generation) }
        }
    }
    private func finishTimeReview(generation: UInt64) {
        guard generation == sleepGeneration else { return }
        if snapshot?.activeTimer == nil && snapshot?.pendingSleepIntervals.allSatisfy({ $0.wakeAt != nil }) == true {
            timerPaused = false; sleepObserved = false
        }
        error = nil
    }
    private func recoveryFailure(_ error: Error, library: Library, generation: UInt64) async {
        guard generation == sleepGeneration else { return }
        // A review failure pauses the same process timer in storage as well as presentation.
        _ = library.signalSleep()
        _ = try? await library.suspendTimer()
        if (try? await library.snapshot()) == nil { blocked = true; uncertainSave = true }
        timerPaused = true
        recoveryFailureID &+= 1
        self.error = "Time review was not confirmed. Your input is retained. Reopen and inspect if the library is unavailable; never replay blindly. " +
            ((error as? LocalizedError)?.errorDescription ?? String(describing: error))
    }
    func requestQuit(_ reply: @escaping @MainActor (Bool) -> Void) {
        guard !terminating else { return }
        terminating = true
        enqueue { model in
            var allow = !model.uncertainSave
            if allow && model.runningEntry != nil {
                if model.restoredTimer { allow = model.confirmQuitPreservingRestoredTimer() }
                else if model.confirmQuit() { allow = await model.applyQuitStop() }
                else { allow = false }
            }
            if allow { await model.library?.close() }
            else { model.terminating = false }
            reply(allow)
        }
    }
    private func applyQuitStop() async -> Bool {
        await applyTimer(timerPaused ? .stopAtCheckpoint : .stop)
    }
}

struct EditorRoute: Identifiable {
    enum Kind { case project, task }
    let id: UUID
    let kind: Kind
    let isNew: Bool
    var projectID: UUID?
    var parentID: UUID?
    var name: String
    var rate: String
    var currency: String
    var confirmCurrency: String?
    var currencyAccepted = false
    var archiveRequested = false
    var migrationAccepted = false
    var budgetEnabled = false
    var budgetHours = ""
    var originalBudgetSeconds: Int64?
    var originalBudgetText = ""
    var parsedBudget: Int64? {
        if budgetHours == originalBudgetText, let originalBudgetSeconds { return originalBudgetSeconds }
        return BudgetInput.parseHours(budgetHours)
    }

    static func project(_ project: Project?) -> Self {
        Self(id: project?.id ?? UUID(), kind: .project, isNew: project == nil,
             name: project?.name ?? "", rate: RateInput.text(project?.hourlyRate ?? 0),
             currency: project?.currencyCode ?? Locale.current.currency?.identifier ?? "EUR")
    }
    static func task(_ task: TaskRecord?, project: UUID, parent: UUID?) -> Self {
        var form = Self(id: task?.id ?? UUID(), kind: .task, isNew: task == nil,
                        projectID: project, parentID: parent, name: task?.name ?? "", rate: "", currency: "")
        form.budgetEnabled = task?.budgetSeconds != nil
        form.originalBudgetSeconds = task?.budgetSeconds
        form.budgetHours = task?.budgetSeconds.map { BudgetInput.text($0) } ?? ""
        form.originalBudgetText = form.budgetHours
        return form
    }
}

                model.editProject()
            }.disabled(model.sheet != nil || model.correctionSheet != nil || model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating)
            Button("Add time…") {
                openWindow(id: "workspace")
                NSApp.activate()
                model.addCorrection()
            }.disabled(model.sheet != nil || model.correctionSheet != nil || model.blocked || model.isBusy || model.terminating || model.leafTasks.isEmpty)
            Button("Open UurtjeFactuurtje") { openWindow(id: "workspace"); NSApp.activate() }
            Button("Quit UurtjeFactuurtje") { NSApp.terminate(nil) }.keyboardShortcut("q")
        }.padding().frame(width: 380)
    }
}

import Synchronization
import Foundation
import Testing
@testable import LibraryStore

private func commandStore() throws -> (Storage, URL) {
    let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
    return (try Recovery.open(at: root), root)
}
private func save(_ id: UUID, _ name: String = "Client", currency: String = "EUR", confirmed: String? = nil) -> WorkspaceCommand {
    .saveProject(id: id, name: name, rate: Decimal(string: "12.5")!, currency: currency, confirmedPreviousCurrency: confirmed)
}

@Test func typedCommandsTrimNamesPreserveHierarchyAndArchive() async throws {
    let (store, root) = try commandStore()
    defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
    let p = UUID(), parent = UUID(), child = UUID()
    _ = try await store.perform(save(p, " Client "))
    _ = try await store.perform(.createTask(id: parent, projectID: p, parentID: nil, name: " Parent "))
    _ = try await store.perform(.createTask(id: child, projectID: p, parentID: parent, name: " Child "))
    let renamed = try await store.perform(.renameTask(id: child, name: "Renamed"))
    #expect(renamed.snapshot.projects.first?.name == "Client")
    #expect(renamed.snapshot.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == child })?.parentTaskID == parent)
    #expect(renamed.snapshot.tasks.first(where: { $0.id == child })?.name == "Renamed")
    _ = try await store.perform(.setArchived(id: p, archived: true))
    await #expect(throws: CommandError.archivedProject) {
        try await store.perform(.renameTask(id: child, name: "No"))
    }
    let restored = try await store.perform(.setArchived(id: p, archived: false))
    #expect(!restored.snapshot.projects[0].isArchived)
    await store.close()
}

@Test func localeRatesConsumeAllInputWithoutPrecisionLoss() {

        #expect(RateInput.parse(invalid, locale: english) == nil)
    }
}

private func migrationFixture(pending: Bool = false) async throws -> (Storage, URL, UUID, UUID) {

    _ = try await store.perform(.createTask(id: t, projectID: p, parentID: nil, name: "Parent"))
    _ = try await store.transact { db, _ in
        let key = SQLValue.text(t.uuidString.lowercased())
        try db.run("UPDATE tasks SET budget_seconds=1000 WHERE id=?", [key])
        try db.run("INSERT INTO time_entries VALUES (?,?,0,10)", [.text(UUID().uuidString.lowercased()), key])
        if pending {
            try db.run("INSERT INTO pending_sleep_intervals VALUES (?,?,20,30)", [.text(UUID().uuidString.lowercased()), key])
        }
    }
    return (store, root, p, t)
}

    let generic = try #require(result.genericID)
    #expect(result.snapshot.revision == before.revision + 1)
    #expect(result.movedEntryCount == 1 && result.movedPendingCount == 1)
    #expect(result.snapshot.tasks.first { $0.id == parent } == before.tasks.first { $0.id == parent })
    #expect(result.snapshot.tasks.first { $0.id == generic }?.budgetSeconds == nil)
    #expect(result.snapshot.tasks.first { $0.id == generic }?.lastWarnedThreshold == WarningThreshold.none)
    #expect(result.snapshot.entries == before.entries.map { TimeEntry(id: $0.id, taskID: generic, startAt: $0.startAt, endAt: $0.endAt) })
    #expect(result.snapshot.pendingSleepIntervals == before.pendingSleepIntervals.map { PendingSleepInterval(id: $0.id, taskID: generic, sleepAt: $0.sleepAt, wakeAt: $0.wakeAt) })
    // Unrelated project edits survive; pending state is deliberately not relaxed for generic commands.
    let other = UUID()
    _ = try await store.transact { db, _ in
        try db.run("INSERT INTO projects(id,name,hourly_rate,currency_code) VALUES (?,?,'0','USD')", [.text(other.uuidString.lowercased()), .text("Other")])
    }

    #expect(undone.projects.contains { $0.id == other })
    await #expect(throws: CommandError.undoUnavailable) { try await store.undoTaskMigration() }
    await store.close()
}

## Testing Strategy

### Automated:

Execute each phase's inherited Automated Verification commands against that phase's committed predecessor tree plus its own files. Do not add later source to satisfy an early-stage check. Read-only inspection checks remain inspection tasks.

### Final Whole-Plan Verification:

Phase 12 owns these baseline gates; validate reruns them over the finished tree:
- [ ] Complete package suite: `swift test`.
- [ ] Complete unsigned host: `xcodebuild -project UurtjeFactuurtje.xcodeproj -scheme UurtjeFactuurtje -configuration Debug build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO`.
- [ ] Metadata: `plutil -lint UurtjeFactuurtje.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj UurtjeFactuurtje/Info.plist UurtjeFactuurtje/UurtjeFactuurtje.entitlements`.

### Manual Testing Steps:

Use the per-phase Manual Verification checkboxes and the inherited Verification Notes below. Signed sandbox, native lifecycle/accessibility, power-loss and real backup/restore checks remain unchecked until observed; an unsigned build or fault injection cannot substitute.

## Verification Notes

- **Foundation:** test canonical Unicode equivalence, case folding without accent removal, whitespace handling, half-open adjacency, rejection of empty/reversed/overflow-sized intervals and Sendable value round trips in Slice 1.
- **Storage:** exercise six-table shape, storage-class decode, unsupported schema non-modification, complete invariants, `integrity_check`, foreign-key failures, full-flush pragma read-back and malformed rows in Slice 3. Verify the linked SQLite runtime, not just the CLI binary.
- **Recovery (Slice 4):** fault-inject creation and every recovery-install boundary. Retain the untouched original pair, never mix journal generations, never replace invalid data with an empty library, and reject a second writer. Demonstrate interrupted install resumes deterministically; use a subprocess crash fixture rather than raw-copying a live transaction.
- **Atomicity (Slice 3):** each logical operation either commits a validated revision and returns that snapshot, or publishes no success. Test COMMIT error/unknown outcomes without automatic replay; ensure handles and locks survive controlled reopen correctly.
- **Workspace:** sandbox entitlement, stable bundle identity, actual resolved container path, one workspace owner, fully consumed locale rate input, currency confirmation and archive gating in Slice 5. Inspect native controls with VoiceOver and keyboard navigation from Slice 5 onward.
- **Timer:** rapid same-second events, switch boundaries, reverse clock, checkpoint errors, duplicate/coalesced checkpoint intents, window-close continuation, and every quit route in Slice 6. Checkpoint cadence must satisfy the proposal's at-least-every-30-seconds request; no hardware scheduling guarantee is implied.
- **Migration/undo:** atomic entry/active/pending reassignment, Generic collision, no time loss, and rejection of undo after relevant edits without discarding unrelated edits in Slice 7.
- **Budgets:** frontier through unbudgeted nodes, exact equality, 80/100 crossings, rearming after corrections/budget changes, notification denial and click routing in Slice 8. Later mutation modules call the same reconciler before commit.
- **Corrections:** global trim/split/delete, relevant-state stale previews, explicit running stop, preserved IDs, no future entries, strict DST ambiguity input and guarded session undo in Slice 9.
- **Sleep:** live callback provenance, failed sleep/wake saves, forced termination, unknown boundary input, zero-length sleep, restored active state and no invented gap in Slice 10. Native sleep/wake event delivery needs a real-device test with the window closed.
- **Reports:** current-rate changes, EUR/JPY/KWD precision, half-up ties, grouped currencies, collapse-invariant totals, archived routes and all-open provisional contribution in Slice 11; DST weeks, chart/table agreement, empty weeks and back navigation in Slice 12.
- **Release gates:** run the app on the supported Mac; verify real Arq and Time Machine APFS snapshot restore (including a required journal), directory/permission restoration, interruption during commits and recovery installation, notification behavior, and accessibility. Keep these unchecked until observed. No benchmark is requested.
- **Baseline:** terminal Slice 12 runs `swift test` and `xcodebuild -project UurtjeFactuurtje.xcodeproj -scheme UurtjeFactuurtje -configuration Debug build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO`; actual signed sandbox/lifecycle behavior must additionally be tested by launching the signed app.
- **History:** git history unavailable (`no-commit`); no precedent claims inferred from absent history.

## Performance Considerations

Keep synchronous SQLite work off MainActor, with no suspension inside transactions. Recompute authoritative-derived projections from committed snapshots; one-second display updates are read-only, while checkpoint requests coalesce. Full load/domain validation is initially preferred over unmeasured incremental complexity. Cache only if later measured evidence justifies it, never as authoritative totals. Indexes follow the selected schema. SwiftUI chart and table share a weekly projection rather than each scanning entries. There is no benchmark task or latency SLA in this design.

## Migration Notes

Greenfield schema 1 only. The sandbox path replaces the proposal's unsandboxed path; there is no shipped data to migrate. Existing files are treated conservatively: newer versions or invalid schemas open recovery without initialization. Preserve the source database/journal set before any recovery that writes. Future schema changes require a consistent SQLite-backup copy, transactional migration and failure preservation, but no speculative version-2 migration is emitted here. Undo receipts are intentionally session-only and add no persisted schema. Keep authoritative data backup-eligible inside the sandbox container; preferences are non-authoritative.

## Developer Context

The 1.14 MB artifact was persisted from a generated skeleton with phase-by-phase exact payload insertion using a Python transport fallback, avoiding reserializing the entire source through tool arguments. Mechanical checks confirmed unchanged criteria, exact declared file lists and terminal equivalence for all 34 canonical files. No application source was changed. The workspace is not a Git repository; HEAD comparison is unavailable and the supplied no-commit/no-branch/unknown metadata is preserved.

### Claim verification

All seven rows concern the same `var result: [(TaskRecord, Int, String)]` returned from `rows() -> [(task: TaskRecord, depth: Int, path: String)]`. A standalone check with that conversion compiled and ran successfully using `swift /tmp/uurtje-tuple-check.swift`; accessing the returned `.task.id` also succeeded. This refutes the reviewer's alleged language-level compile failure on the installed toolchain. No code fix was applied; the developer dismissed all seven rows based on this counter-evidence. Full app compilation was not performed.
